Third, we close the loop: when the people who write a model's training data can ask the model instead of finding things out, the supply of fresh data becomes endogenous. At equilibrium, the model is exactly as reliable as it is costly for people to find out for themselves, the population is no better off than without the model, and every increase in the share of model-written text must be paid for by more people learning for themselves. Users who check what they are told and relearn when it is wrong break the paradox. Filters that select plausible text are conformist and accelerate collapse; only checks that carry new information act as critical learning.
zh_title: 谁为知识模型的复制买单？模型崩溃即罗杰斯悖论
translation: 生成模型在早期模型的输出上进行训练，会跨代损失知识，首先是稀有知识。所有有效的补救措施都从循环外部引入信息，而模型崩溃理论将这种供应视为给定：一个固定的存档，从固定分布中抽取。我们认为供应才是问题所在，并且文化演化理论对此有解释。我们将模型崩溃解读为罗杰斯悖论：一个依赖复制的群体最终并没有比从未复制的群体更好，因为除非有人持续自主学习，否则复制品会过时。我们分三步验证了这一观点。首先，罗杰斯模型仅通过完全合成训练数据进行拟合，就能在几个百分点的误差范围内预测语言模型（从词语三元组到预训练Transformer）在其他新鲜数据混合下保留多少稀有知识。其次，当世界本身发生变化时，一个复制自身过去的谱系需要更多新鲜数据才能跟上世界变化的速度，这与罗杰斯模型的预测一致，也与假设目标固定的分析不同；一个每代都从固定预训练权重重新开始的谱系在很大程度上是绝缘的，因为这些权重是永不复制的知识。第三，我们闭合了循环：当编写模型训练数据的人可以向模型提问而不是亲自去发现事物时，新鲜数据的供应就变成了内生的。在均衡状态下，模型的可靠性恰好与人们自主发现事物的成本相当，群体状况并没有比没有模型时更好，模型生成文本份额的每一次增加都必须由更多人自主学习来买单。核查所被告知信息并在错误时重新学习的用户打破了悖论。选择貌似合理文本的过滤器是顺从的，会加速崩溃；只有带来新信息的核查才能起到批判性学习的作用。
tldr: 生成模型在复制训练中会丢失知识，尤其稀有知识。本文将模型崩溃解释为罗杰斯悖论：过度依赖复制而不进行独立学习会导致知识停滞。只有用户主动核查和重新学习才能打破这一循环，而筛选器反而会加速崩溃。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将模型崩溃问题与文化演化理论中的罗杰斯悖论相结合，从一个全新的视角解释了生成模型知识流失的深层原因。它不仅指出了现有模型崩溃理论的局限性（将新鲜数据供应视为给定），更深入探讨了当人类与模型交互导致数据供应内生化时，知识生态系统可能面临的风险。研究强调了独立学习和批判性思维在AI时代的重要性，为AI伦理和可持续发展提供了深刻的见解。
motivation: 生成模型在训练过程中会丢失知识，尤其稀有知识，而现有理论将外部信息供应视为给定。本文认为信息供应本身就是问题，并试图通过文化演化理论（罗杰斯悖论）来解释模型崩溃现象。
method: 本文分三步验证了模型崩溃与罗杰斯悖论的关联。首先，将罗杰斯模型应用于纯合成训练数据，预测语言模型在不同新鲜数据混合下的稀有知识保留情况。其次，分析在世界变化时，依赖复制的谱系和从固定预训练权重重启的谱系对新鲜数据的需求。最后，探讨当模型训练数据的来源变得内生（人们向模型提问而非自主发现）时，新鲜数据供应的影响。
results: 1. 罗杰斯模型能准确预测语言模型（从词语三元组到预训练Transformer）在不同新鲜数据混合下保留稀有知识的程度。 2. 当世界变化时，复制自身过去的模型谱系需要更多新鲜数据来跟上变化，而从固定预训练权重重启的谱系则相对不受影响。 3. 当新鲜数据供应内生时，在均衡状态下，模型的可靠性与人们自主发现信息的成本相当，群体状况并未改善，模型生成文本的份额增加需要更多人进行自主学习。 4. 用户的主动核查和重新学习可以打破悖论，而选择貌似合理文本的过滤器则会加速崩溃，只有带来新信息的核查才能起到批判性学习的作用。
conclusion: 模型崩溃是罗杰斯悖论的一种体现：过度依赖复制而非独立学习会导致知识停滞。为了避免模型崩溃和知识流失，必须有人持续进行独立学习以提供新鲜知识。用户的主动核查和重新学习是打破这一悖论的关键，而仅靠过滤机制则会加速问题。

title: Practical Estimation of the Bayes Optimal Fairness-Accuracy Tradeoff with Soft Labels
authors: Mohit Sharma, Okan Koç, Amit Deshpande, Takashi Ishida, Gang Niu, Rajiv Ratn Shah, Masashi Sugiyama
abstract: There is a fundamental limit to the best prediction error of any model for a given data distribution. In classification, the Bayes error quantifies this limit and serves as both a benchmark for trained models and a criterion to detect overfitting. The state-of-the-art Bayes error estimation techniques for binary classification use only soft labels (positive class probabilities) and require no input features or auxiliary training. We extend such notions to constrained classification problems, such as fairness. Fair classification is an important case of constrained or multi-objective classification. It requires a model not only to be accurate but also to yield fair outcomes (equal or near-equal true positive rates) across different demographic groups (e.g., race and gender). This leads to an inherent fairness-accuracy tradeoff or a Pareto frontier that is used to compare fair classifiers against each other. The focus of our work is to estimate the fundamental limit for this fairness-accuracy tradeoff. We derive an explicit expression for the fair Bayes error rate (i.e., best achievable error rate subject to given fairness constraints), and construct consistent, instance-free estimators for it using only soft labels and group information. We provably bound the bias and the sample complexity of our estimators. Empirically, our method produces a robust, low-variance estimate of the optimal fairness-accuracy tradeoff curve, even when the soft labels are noisy and derived from a classification model on hard labels.
zh_title: 使用软标签实用估计贝叶斯最优公平-准确率权衡
translation: 任何给定数据模型的最佳预测误差都存在一个基本极限。在分类中，贝叶斯误差量化了这一极限，并可作为训练模型的基准和检测过拟合的标准。目前最先进的二分类贝叶斯误差估计技术仅使用软标签（正类概率），既不需要输入特征，也不需要辅助训练。我们将这一概念扩展到受约束的分类问题，例如公平性。公平分类是受约束或多目标分类的一个重要案例。它要求模型不仅要准确，还要在不同人口群体（如种族和性别）之间产生公平的结果（相等或接近相等的真正例率）。这导致了固有的公平-准确率权衡或帕累托前沿，用于比较各个公平分类器。我们工作的重点是估计这种公平-准确率权衡的基本极限。我们推导了公平贝叶斯错误率（即在给定公平约束下可实现的最佳错误率）的显式表达式，并仅使用软标签和群体信息为其构建了相合的、无实例的估计器。我们可证明地限制了估计器的偏差和样本复杂度。从经验来看，我们的方法能够对最优的公平-准确率权衡曲线产生稳健、低方差的估计，即使软标签是有噪声的且源自硬标签分类模型时也是如此。
tldr: 本文研究了如何仅使用软标签和群体信息来估计公平分类中不可避免的公平-准确率权衡极限（帕累托前沿）。
ai_comments: 该论文首次将软标签的贝叶斯误差估计技术扩展到公平分类中的受约束优化问题，具有很高的理论价值和实践意义，能够为评估各种公平分类器提供客观的基准。
motivation: 现有的贝叶斯误差估计技术主要针对标准分类，缺乏对受约束分类问题（如公平分类中固有的公平性与准确率权衡帕累托前沿）的基本极限估计方法。
method: 推导了公平贝叶斯错误率的显式表达式，并仅使用软标签和群体信息构建了相合的、无需特征的估计器，同时证明了其偏差和样本复杂度。
results: 理论上证明了估计器的偏差和样本复杂度界限；实验表明，即使在软标签带有噪声的情况下，该方法也能稳健且低方差地估计出最优的公平-准确率权衡曲线。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于软标签和群体信息的公平贝叶斯误差率估计方法，能够有效且稳健地估计最优的公平-准确率权衡边界。

title: CoordX Protocol: Peer to Peer Cryptographically Verified Shared Records
authors: David Hyland-Wood, Rob Ewin
abstract:
People, companies and software agents often must work on shared records even when they do not trust each other. Today they usually give those records to a central server. The server keeps the canonical copy, authenticates users, and decides who has permissions to act on the record. The CoordX Protocol removes the need for that central server.
  In the CoordX protocol the author of a record holds full permission over it. Permission for any other party to create, read or update the record is assigned by explicit grants and keys. An invitation only starts contact between two parties. It gives no permission. Each record is a causal tree of signed entries, and each entry is immutable. Each entry names the permission that allowed it. Any party can get the proof of that permission and check it without help from anyone. Two honest parties that check the same bytes, with the same keys and local settings, always get the same answer. The content is encrypted, so the relays that may carry it in transit see only sealed bytes. To exclude a party from future content, the other parties move to new keys. The protocol does not choose a winning version, does not put entries in time order, and does not need global agreement. Applications decide what the entries mean above the level of the protocol.
zh_title: CoordX协议：点对点加密验证共享记录
translation:
人们、公司和软件代理在不信任彼此的情况下，经常需要处理共享记录。如今，他们通常会将这些记录交给中心服务器。该服务器保存着规范副本，验证用户身份，并决定谁有权对记录进行操作。CoordX协议消除了对该中心服务器的需要。
在CoordX协议中，记录的作者拥有对其的完全权限。任何其他方创建、读取或更新记录的权限，都通过显式授权和密钥进行分配。邀请仅启动双方之间的联系，不授予任何权限。每个记录都是一个包含签名条目的因果树，每个条目都是不可变的。每个条目都标明了允许它存在的权限。任何一方都可以获得该权限的证明并进行检查，无需他人协助。两个诚实方检查相同的字节，使用相同的密钥和本地设置，总是得到相同的结果。内容是加密的，因此可能在传输中携带它的中继者只能看到已密封的字节。要将某一方排除在未来内容之外，其他方会切换到新的密钥。该协议不选择获胜版本，不按时间顺序排列条目，也不需要全局共识。应用程序决定协议之上的条目含义。
tldr: CoordX协议是一种去中心化的共享记录协议，它消除了对中心服务器的需求，通过加密签名和显式授权来确保记录的安全性和可信度。
ai_comments: 该协议在去中心化共享记录方面取得了显著进展，但其在处理大规模并发写入和复杂权限场景下的性能和可扩展性仍有待进一步研究。此外，对于密钥管理和恢复机制的详细设计也需要更深入的探讨。
motivation: 在不信任的环境中，人们、公司和软件代理需要对共享记录进行协作，而当前的中心化服务器方案存在单点故障和信任问题。因此，需要一种去中心化的解决方案来管理共享记录。
method: CoordX协议通过以下方式运作：1. 记录作者拥有完全权限；2. 权限通过显式授权和密钥分配；3. 每个记录由签名的条目组成因果树，条目不可变且包含执行它们所需的权限信息；4. 任何一方都可以独立验证权限；5. 相同数据的诚实参与者总会得到相同的结果；6. 内容加密，传输过程中的中继者只能看到加密字节；7. 通过更换密钥来撤销权限；8. 该协议不选择获胜版本、不排序条目，也不需要全局共识。
results: CoordX协议能够实现去中心化的共享记录管理，确保数据的安全、可信和可验证，同时允许各方独立地管理和检查权限，无需中心服务器的协调。
conclusion: CoordX协议成功地移除中心服务器，通过加密签名和显式授权实现了去中心化的共享记录管理，提高了安全性和可信度，同时保持了数据的可验证性。

title: The Effectiveness of Sliding Mode Control for Robust Vision Stabilization under the Plant-Binding Condition
authors: Sooyeun Yang, Jongseong Brad Choi, Seung Bok choi
abstract: Boundary-layer Sliding Mode Control (SMC) has been applied to vision-based stabilization, but identifying its activation condition against simpler causal baselines (LPF, PID) has been elusive. The operational condition is plant binding: the disturbance velocity approaches or exceeds the actuator slew limit, so the bounded per-step actuation budget binds. We validate this in two independent vision domains: handheld translation stabilization (12 1080p clips; LPF, PID, SMC, L1) and angular re-framing against a virtual slew-rate-limited pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) plant. Outside binding, leave-one-out cross-validation makes SMC and LPF on translation statistically indistinguishable, and PID beats SMC on the angular 99th-percentile pointing offset by 5.85 degrees (95% CI clear of zero); inside binding -- reached only by sweeping the simulated slew limit, as both captured datasets land outside it -- the translation gap stays a tie and SMC beats PID on the angular worst case (Cohen's d up to +0.83). The PTZ plant's 100 degrees/s default sits on the cross-over, which explains a small-margin PID result previously reported in the angular setting. A complementary ablation shows raising the SMC reaching gain k costs mean tracking outside a narrow window.
zh_title: 植物绑定条件下滑模控制对鲁棒视觉稳定的有效性
translation: 边界层滑模控制（SMC）已被应用于基于视觉的稳定，但与更简单的因果基线（LPF、PID）相比，确定其激活条件一直难以捉摸。该操作条件是植物绑定：扰动速度接近或超过执行器摆率限制，因此有界的每步驱动预算受到绑定。我们在两个独立的视觉领域验证了这一点：手持平移稳定（12个1080p视频片段；LPF、PID、SMC、L1）和对抗虚拟摆率受限的云台（PTZ）植物的角重构。在绑定之外，留一法交叉验证使得平移上的SMC和LPF在统计上无法区分，而PID在角度99百分位指向偏移上比SMC高出5.85度（95%置信区间不包含零）；在绑定之内——仅通过扫描模拟摆率限制达到，因为两个捕获的数据集都在其外部——平移差距保持平局，SMC在角度最坏情况下击败了PID（Cohen's d高达+0.83）。PTZ植物默认的100度/秒处于交叉点上，这解释了先前在角度设置中报告的小幅面PID结果。一项补充消融显示，提高SMC的到达增益k在狭窄窗口之外会牺牲平均跟踪性能。
tldr: 本文通过实验证明，滑模控制（SMC）在执行器达到饱和限制的“植物绑定条件”下，其视觉稳定性能优于传统PID控制，但在非绑定条件下则优势不明。
ai_comments: 该论文探讨了滑模控制（SMC）在视觉稳定中的有效性及其激活条件（plant-binding condition），通过严谨的实验和消融研究，明确了SMC与传统控制方法（如LPF、PID）的性能边界，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 尽管边界层滑模控制（SMC）已被应用于基于视觉的稳定，但与更简单的因果基线（如LPF、PID）相比，明确其激活条件一直以来都难以捉摸。作者旨在找出并验证SMC展现出优越性的特定操作条件（即植物绑定条件）。
method: 在两个独立的视觉领域（手持平移稳定和虚拟PTZ平移缩放植物的角重构）中验证边界层滑模控制（SMC），将其与LPF、PID和L1控制器进行对比，并通过改变模拟摆率限制来达到绑定条件，同时进行消融研究。
results: 在植物绑定条件之外，SMC与LPF在统计上无区别，PID在角指向偏移上优于SMC；而在植物绑定条件下，SMC在角最坏情况下优于PID（Cohen's d高达+0.83），同时提高SMC的到达增益会在狭窄窗口外付出平均跟踪代价。
conclusion: 滑模控制在受约束的植物绑定条件下优于传统方法，但在非绑定条件下其优势并不明显，甚至可能带来额外的性能代价。

title: TRACK: Multiple Instance Learning for Anti-Money Laundering in Transaction Networks
authors: Seonkyu Lim, Inwoo Tae, Gwangui Hong, Jaehoon Lee, Jeongwhan Choi, Taehoon Kim, Min-Soo Kim, Yongjae Lee
abstract: Anti-money laundering (AML) investigations are organized around accounts, while the suspicious evidence for an account may reside in only a few of its transactions. Yet many account-level detectors summarize transactions before learning, and message-passing models may aggregate once more over neighboring accounts. We name this discrepancy the aggregation mismatch and study it under an account-window benchmark label defined by the presence of at least one flagged transaction. We recast account-level AML detection as multiple instance learning, in which an account-window is a bag and its transactions are instances. We propose TRACK, which encodes every transaction with a shared encoder and selectively pools the encodings into an account decision. To emulate coarse supervision, we withhold the transaction labels of five AML datasets from TRACK throughout training. Under a time-ordered protocol, TRACK achieves the highest average precision among the tabular and graph baselines trained from account labels on every dataset. Despite using only account-window supervision, it remains competitive with edge classifiers trained directly from transaction labels. Its instance scores also rank flagged transactions well above chance and approach or exceed directly supervised ranking performance across datasets.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 20th ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (WSDM 2027)
zh_title: TRACK：面向交易网络反洗钱的多实例学习方法
translation: 反洗钱（AML）调查是围绕账户进行的，而账户的可疑证据可能只存在于其少数几笔交易中。然而，许多账户级检测器在学习前会先对交易进行汇总，而消息传递模型可能会对相邻账户再次进行聚合。我们将这种差异命名为聚合不匹配，并在由至少一笔被标记交易的存在所定义的账户窗口基准标签下对其进行研究。我们将账户级反洗钱检测重新构建为多实例学习，其中账户窗口是一个包（bag），其交易是实例。我们提出了TRACK，它用共享编码器对每个交易进行编码，并将编码选择性地汇聚成账户决策。为了模拟粗粒度监督，我们在整个训练过程中对TRACK隐去了五个AML数据集的交易标签。在按时间排序的协议下，在每个数据集上使用账户标签训练的表格和图基线中，TRACK实现了最高的平均精度。尽管仅使用账户窗口监督，它在直接从交易标签训练的边缘分类器面前依然具有竞争力。其实例得分也将被标记交易的排名远远甩在随机水平之上，并在各个数据集上接近或超过了直接监督的排名性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多实例学习的反洗钱模型TRACK，解决了交易网络中的聚合不匹配问题，仅凭账户级标签即可实现出色的账户与可疑交易检测。
ai_comments: 本文将洗钱防范中的账户级检测建模为多实例学习（MIL）问题，创新性地提出了TRACK模型，解决了传统图模型和表格模型在聚合交易时面临的聚合不匹配（aggregation mismatch）问题。该方法在仅使用账户级弱监督的情况下，仍能准确识别出可疑交易，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。
motivation: 现有的反洗钱（AML）检测方法通常在学习前对交易进行汇总，或者通过消息传递模型在相邻账户上再次聚合，这导致了“聚合不匹配”问题（即账户级调查需要从少数可疑交易中寻找证据，但汇总方式掩盖了关键细节）。为此，作者希望寻找一种能更好对齐账户和交易证据的方法。
method: 提出名为TRACK的模型，将账户窗口视为“包（bag）”，其交易视为“实例（instance）”。使用共享编码器对每个交易进行编码，并通过选择性池化将编码汇总为账户决策。在训练过程中不使用交易级标签，仅利用账户级监督。
results: 在五个AML数据集的时间排序评测协议下，TRACK在所有基线模型中取得了最高的平均精度（AP）；在仅使用账户窗口监督的情况下，其性能仍能与直接使用交易标签训练的边缘分类器相媲美，且其实例得分能够很好地将标记交易排在随机之上。
conclusion: TRACK通过多实例学习框架有效解决了反洗钱检测中的聚合不匹配问题，在仅依赖账户标签的情况下，实现了出色的账户级及交易级检测性能。

title: Act-HiMotif: Hierarchical Daily Activity Schedule Generation via Learned Activity-Structure Motifs
authors: Yushi Bai, Kang Liu, Ling Yin, Wei Wang, Yilin Lyu
abstract: Generating daily activity schedules from individual attributes (e.g., age and income) is valuable for activity-based travel modeling and human behavior simulation. The task is challenging because exact activity structures follow a highly imbalanced, long-tailed distribution, while the same structure can admit multiple duration allocations under a fixed full-day budget. Direct generation must therefore learn many exact activity structures from highly uneven observations while modeling their possible temporal realizations. However, many exact structures share recurring activity organization. Based on this observation, we propose Act-HiMotif, a hierarchical motif-based generative model that introduces learned, reusable activity-structure motifs as an intermediate representation between individual profiles and specific activity structures. Act-HiMotif first distinguishes home-only days from active days, then samples a motif from a profile-conditioned prior to guide activity-structure generation, and finally applies a budget-constrained duration allocator to generate activity durations that sum exactly to the full-day horizon. This hierarchy models home-only routing, activity-structure generation, and duration allocation at their corresponding levels, while motifs allow related structures to share statistical support without losing their distinct sequences. Experiments on large-scale travel survey data show that Act-HiMotif outperforms strong baselines in both in-distribution and spatial generalization settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of hierarchical generation and reusable activity-structure motifs for producing realistic profile-conditioned daily activity schedules.
zh_title: Act-HiMotif：通过学习活动结构主题的层次化日常活动日程生成
translation: 从个体属性（例如年龄和收入）生成日常活动日程对于基于活动的出行建模和人类行为模拟非常有价值。这项任务具有挑战性，因为精确的活动结构遵循高度不平衡、长尾的分布，而相同的结构在固定的全天预算下可以允许多种持续时间分配。因此，直接生成必须从高度不均匀的观测中学习许多精确的活动结构，同时建模其可能的时间实现。然而，许多精确的结构共享重复的活动组织。基于这一观察，我们提出了Act-HiMotif，一个基于分层主题的生成模型，它引入了学习到的、可重用的活动结构主题作为个体画像和特定活动结构之间的中间表示。Act-HiMotif首先区分仅居家日和活动日，然后从基于画像的先验中采样一个主题来指导活动结构生成，最后应用一个受预算约束的持续时间分配器来生成精确总和为全天时长的活动持续时间。这种层次结构在相应的层面建模了仅居家路线、活动结构生成和持续时间分配，而主题允许相关结构共享统计支持，同时不失去其独特的序列。在大型出行调查数据上的实验表明，Act-HiMotif在分布内和空间泛化设置中均优于强大的基线模型，证明了分层生成和可重用活动结构主题在生成现实的、基于画像的日常活动日程方面的有效性。
tldr: Act-HiMotif是一个分层生成模型，它使用可重用的活动结构主题来从个人属性生成现实的日常活动日程，在实验中表现优于基线模型。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入“活动结构主题”这一中间表示，巧妙地解决了日常活动日程生成中结构多样性和数据稀疏性的问题。其分层生成方法使得模型能够更有效地捕捉不同层面的行为模式，从而在生成现实且个性化的日程方面表现出色。这种可重用主题的概念是其主要创新点。
motivation: 现有方法在生成日常活动日程时面临挑战，因为精确的活动结构分布高度不平衡且长尾，同时相同结构在固定全天预算下可能存在多种持续时间分配。直接生成需要从不均匀的观测中学习许多精确的活动结构并建模其时间实现。
method: 本文提出了Act-HiMotif，一个基于分层主题的生成模型。它引入了可学习、可重用的活动结构主题作为个体画像和特定活动结构之间的中间表示。Act-HiMotif首先区分居家日和活动日，然后从基于画像的先验中采样主题以指导活动结构生成，最后应用预算约束的持续时间分配器生成精确符合全天预算的活动持续时间。这种分层结构允许在相应层面建模居家路线、活动结构生成和持续时间分配，同时主题使得相关结构能够共享统计支持。
results: 在大型出行调查数据上的实验表明，Act-HiMotif在分布内和空间泛化设置中均优于强大的基线模型，证明了分层生成和可重用活动结构主题在生成现实的、基于画像的日常活动日程方面的有效性。
conclusion: Act-HiMotif通过其分层模型和可重用的活动结构主题，有效地解决了日常活动日程生成的挑战，能够生成现实的、基于画像的日常活动日程，并在实验中表现出优越性。

title: USI-Brain: Enhancing Underwater Spatial Intelligence via Spatial Data-Driven Vision-Language Modeling
authors: Zhiliang Zhu, Zhiqiang Zhao, Xie'an Jiang, Yingxin Lai, Kangye Zheng, Dawei Zhao
abstract: Underwater spatial reasoning depends on object boundaries and geometric cues that are obscured by scattering, color distortion, and low visibility. Existing underwater resources capture these cues through images, annotations, and depth maps, but provide fragmented supervision for vision-language models. We present a spatial data engine that connects visual appearance with object-level geometry through enhancement, 2D and geometry-assisted question generation, and expert filtering. It produces 4.27M QA pairs across five capability groups. We use this corpus to train USI-Brain and introduce an Underwater Prior-guided Rectifier (UPR) that applies gated corrections to visual features. USI-Bench evaluates the resulting capabilities with 6,525 held-out QA pairs. On its 15 task metrics, USI-Brain and USI-Brain + UPR improve over Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct by 5.76 and 7.63 points on average, respectively, using signed differences on 100-point scales. Ablations show that geometry-assisted supervision improves depth and ordering by 4.8 and 6.1 points with UPR disabled, while UPR adds 18.0 points in scene description under matched training data. Both variants use raw images at evaluation. Across NautData, UWBench, and MarineEval, USI-Brain achieves the best or joint-best score on 28 of 32 metrics. Model weights and USI-Bench will be released at https://github.com/SKY-Zhu-91/USI-Brain.
zh_title: 水下空间智能增强：通过空间数据驱动的视觉语言建模
translation: 水下空间推理依赖于被散射、颜色失真和低能见度所模糊的物体边界和几何线索。现有的水下资源通过图像、注释和深度图捕获这些线索，但为视觉语言模型提供了零散的监督。我们提出了一个空间数据引擎，通过增强、2D和几何辅助的问题生成以及专家过滤，将视觉外观与物体级几何联系起来。它在五个能力组中生成了4.27M个QA对。我们使用这个语料库来训练USI-Brain，并引入了一个水下先验引导校正器（UPR），它对视觉特征应用门控校正。USI-Bench使用6,525个保留的QA对来评估由此产生的能力。在其15个任务指标上，USI-Brain和USI-Brain + UPR分别比Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct平均提高了5.76和7.63个点，使用100点量表上的符号差异。消融实验表明，在禁用UPR的情况下，几何辅助监督将深度和排序分别提高了4.8和6.1个点，而UPR在匹配的训练数据下将场景描述提高了18.0个点。两个变体在评估时都使用原始图像。在NautData、UWBench和MarineEval上，USI-Brain在32个指标中的28个上取得了最佳或联合最佳分数。模型权重和USI-Bench将在https://github.com/SKY-Zhu-91/USI-Brain发布。
tldr: 该研究提出了USI-Brain，一个通过空间数据引擎训练的视觉语言模型，用于增强水下空间推理能力。该模型通过整合图像、注释和深度图，并引入了水下先验引导校正器（UPR），在多个水下基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。
ai_comments: 该研究有效地解决了水下视觉语言模型面临的挑战，通过构建专门的数据引擎和引入UPR模块，显著提升了模型在水下空间推理任务上的表现。模型的性能提升幅度显著，且在多个基准测试中均取得优异成绩，显示了其广泛的应用前景。然而，关于UPR模块的具体实现细节和其对不同类型水下环境的泛化能力，在摘要中未详细阐述，这可能是未来研究可以进一步探索的方向。
motivation: 水下空间推理因散射、颜色失真和低能见度而受到物体边界和几何线索的阻碍。现有的水下资源提供的监督信息不完整，无法充分训练视觉语言模型。
method: 研究人员构建了一个空间数据引擎，通过增强、2D和几何辅助的问题生成以及专家过滤，将视觉外观与物体级几何联系起来，生成了4.27M个QA对。他们使用该语料库训练了USI-Brain模型，并引入了一个水下先验引导校正器（UPR）来校正视觉特征。最后，使用USI-Bench基准测试评估了模型的性能。
results: USI-Brain及其UPR变体在USI-Bench的15个任务指标上，平均分别比Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct提高了5.76和7.63个点。消融实验表明，几何辅助监督在禁用UPR的情况下，分别将深度和排序提高了4.8和6.1个点，而UPR在匹配的训练数据下将场景描述提高了18.0个点。USI-Brain在NautData、UWBench和MarineEval上的32个指标中，有28个取得了最佳或联合最佳成绩。
conclusion: USI-Brain模型及其UPR变体在水下空间推理任务上取得了优于现有模型的性能，证明了空间数据引擎和UPR的有效性。该模型在多个基准测试中表现出色，并将公开模型权重和USI-Bench。

title: Securing Web Agents with the Compile-Then-Execute Paradigm
authors: Annabella Chow, Jinhao Zhu, Sylvie Venuto, Abdulaziz Alharbi, Basel Alomair, Raluca Popa, David Wagner, Julien Piet
abstract: Web agents commonly follow the ReAct paradigm, selecting each action from runtime observations that inherently mix trusted and untrusted content. This design makes their control flow vulnerable to prompt injections embedded in webpages. We introduce Baya, a compile-then-execute web agent designed to prevent prompt-injection-driven control-flow hijacking by design. Before accessing the live website, Baya compiles the user's request into an executable Python program that calls a Trusted Website API. The planning model does not observe live website content; only the compiled program processes it. Untrusted data may determine program values or select among branches defined during compilation, but it cannot redefine the user task or cause the model to synthesize new website operations at runtime. The Trusted Website API gives the compiler a unified view of the website's action space, enabling ahead-of-time planning without the stepwise action discovery required by reactive agents. Our evaluation across 581 valid WebArena Verified tasks shows that Baya achieves 77.8% aggregate utility, outperforming browser-only ReAct (55.1%) and API-enabled ReAct (66.7%). On WASP, a security benchmark for web agents, Baya achieves 0% attack success rate, compared with 16.2% for API-enabled ReAct and 25.5% for browser-only ReAct.
zh_title: 使用编译-然后-执行范式保护Web智能体
translation: Web智能体通常遵循ReAct范式，从固有地混合了可信和不可信内容的运行时观察中选择每个动作。这种设计使得它们的控制流容易受到嵌入在网页中的提示词注入攻击。我们介绍了Baya，这是一种旨在从设计上防止提示词注入驱动的控制流劫持的“编译-然后-执行”Web智能体。在访问实时网站之前，Baya将用户的请求编译为调用受信任网站API的可执行Python程序。规划模型不观察实时的网站内容；只有编译后的程序处理它。不可信的数据可以决定程序的值或在编译期间定义的各分支之间进行选择，但它不能重新定义用户任务或导致模型在运行时合成新的网站操作。受信任的网站API为编译器提供了对网站动作空间的统一视图，实现了无需反应式智能体所需的逐行动作发现的提前规划。我们在581个有效的WebArena Verified任务上的评估表明，Baya实现了77.8%的聚合效用，优于仅浏览器的ReAct（55.1%）和启用API的ReAct（66.7%）。在Web智能体安全基准测试WASP上，Baya实现了0%的攻击成功率，而启用API的ReAct为16.2%，仅浏览器的ReAct为25.5%。
tldr: 提出了一种名为Baya的Web智能体，采用“先编译后执行”范式，在完全防止提示词注入攻击的同时提升了任务执行效用。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了Compile-Then-Execute（先编译后执行）范式，从设计上解决了Web智能体面临的提示词注入和控制流劫持安全问题，并在实用性和安全性上均超越了传统的ReAct智能体。
motivation: 现有的Web智能体通常遵循ReAct范式，在运行时从混合了可信与不可信内容的观察中选择动作，导致其控制流极易受到网页中嵌入的提示词注入攻击。
method: 引入Baya智能体，采用“先编译后执行”范式。在访问网站前将用户请求编译为调用可信网站API的Python程序，由程序而非规划模型处理动态内容，防止不可信数据重新定义任务或生成新操作。
results: 在581个有效的WebArena Verified任务中，Baya达到了77.8%的聚合效用，优于基于浏览器的ReAct（55.1%）和API启用的ReAct（66.7%）；在WASP安全基准测试中，Baya的攻击成功率为0%，而API启用ReAct为16.2%，浏览器ReAct为25.5%。
conclusion: Baya通过将用户请求编译为Python程序来安全地与网站交互，实现了零攻击成功率，同时保持了极高的实用性能，为构建安全的Web智能体提供了新途径。

title: PIMROP: A Feasibility Study of Return-Oriented Programming on Commercial Processing-in-Memory Architectures
authors: William C. Tegge, Shouzhi Fang, Alex K. Jones
abstract: Processing-in-Memory places small programmable cores on the memory device, where they execute beside the DRAM banks and beyond the control-flow defenses that protect host programs. The security of this in-memory code is an attack surface that remains largely unstudied. We present PIMROP, to our knowledge the first demonstrated code-reuse attack on a commercial Processing in-Memory ISA. We show that return-oriented programming is feasible on a real, commercially shipped PIM instruction set, the UPMEM DPU, whose DRAM Processing Units run C compiled by a dedicated LLVM toolchain. We build Galileo-for-DPU, a gadget scanner adapted to the DPU's fixed-width, 8-byte-aligned RISC encoding, and run it entirely on the UPMEM functional simulator in a reproducible Docker and VM environment. We find the runtime library that every kernel links already yields 517 non-trivial gadgets covering all five canonical ROP primitive classes, and all 13 PrIM benchmarks we scanned carry gadgets as well. We then demonstrate two verified end-to-end attacks, each reproducible on 10 of 10 runs. In the first, a stack buffer overflow in a DPU kernel overwrites the saved return address and diverts control into a routine that copies a secret into host-readable memory. In the second, we leak the same secret using a chain of reused gadgets alone, without diverting control into any such routine. We further show that two standard defenses--stack canaries and _FORTIFY_SOURCE-style bounds-check fortification--fail on the DPU in ways specific to the platform (misplaced canary, silently inactive wrapper), and we verify a bounds-checked DMA that stops the attack on 10 of 10 runs with no effect on benign requests. To enable further research on PIM security, we open-source Galileo-for-DPU and our testing harness at https://github.com/wtegge2/ROP-in-PIM.
zh_title: PIMROP：商业内存处理架构上面向返回的编程的可行性研究
translation: 内存处理技术将小型可编程核心放置在内存设备上，它们在DRAM体旁边执行，超出了保护主机程序的控制流防御范围。这种内存中代码的安全性是一个在很大程度上未被研究的攻击面。我们提出了PIMROP，据我们所知，这是首次在商业内存处理指令集上演示的代码重用攻击。我们表明，面向返回的编程在一个真实、商业出货的PIM指令集（UPMEM DPU）上是可行的，其DRAM处理单元运行由专用LLVM工具链编译的C语言。我们构建了Galileo-for-DPU，这是一个适应DPU固定宽度、8字节对齐的RISC编码的小工具扫描器，并在可重现的Docker和虚拟机环境中的UPMEM功能模拟器上完全运行它。我们发现，每个内核链接的运行时库已经产生了517个非平凡的小工具，涵盖了所有五个规范的ROP原语类，我们扫描的所有13个PrIM基准测试也都带有小工具。然后，我们演示了两个经过验证的端到端攻击，每个攻击在10次运行中均可100%重现。在第一种攻击中，DPU内核中的栈缓冲区溢出覆盖了保存的返回地址，并将控制流转移到一个将秘密复制到主机可读内存的例程中。在第二种攻击中，我们仅使用重用的小工具链泄漏了相同的秘密，而没有将控制流转移到任何此类例程中。我们进一步表明，两种标准防御机制（栈金丝雀和_FORTIFY_SOURCE风格的边界检查加固）在DPU上以特定于平台的方式失效（金丝雀错位、包装器静默失效），并且我们验证了经过边界检查的DMA可以在10次运行中100%阻止攻击，且对良性请求没有影响。为了促进PIM安全性的进一步研究，我们将Galileo-for-DPU和我们的测试工具开源在https://github.com/wtegge2/ROP-in-PIM。
tldr: 本文首次证明了在商业UPMEM内存处理（PIM）架构上进行面向返回的编程（ROP）攻击是完全可行的，并揭示了传统防御机制的失效。
ai_comments: 该论文首次针对商业内存处理（PIM）架构进行了面向返回的编程（ROP）可行性研究，揭示了新型硬件架构带来的安全隐患，并提出了针对性的防御建议，对推动PIM安全领域的研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 内存处理（PIM）技术将可编程核心放置在内存设备上执行，超出了保护主机程序的控制流防御范围，但其内部代码的安全性在很大程度上仍未得到研究。
method: 开发了Galileo-for-DPU小工具扫描器，针对UPMEM DPU的固定宽度8字节对齐RISC编码进行分析；并在UPMEM功能模拟器、Docker和虚拟机环境中进行了端到端的攻击验证与防御测试。
results: 发现运行时库包含517个非平凡小工具，所有13个PrIM基准测试均包含小工具；成功演示了两种端到端攻击（栈溢出控制流劫持和纯ROP链泄露秘密），并证明了传统栈金丝雀和边界检查防御在PIM平台上的失效性。
conclusion: 商业PIM架构（如UPMEM DPU）存在严重的代码重用攻击风险，现有的标准防御机制在平台上失效，亟需开发适用于PIM架构的专用安全防御措施。

title: UniRestorer++: Scalable Universal Image Restoration with Multi-Granularity Degradation Modeling
authors: Jingbo Lin, Zhilu Zhang, Fan Li, Renjing Pei, Wenbo Li, Hang Xu, Hongzhi Zhang, Wangmeng Zuo
abstract: Universal image restoration aims to handle diverse degradations within a single model, but a reliable scaling strategy remains underexplored. Increasing backbone depth and width can lead to performance saturation, while degradation-aware specialization depends on accurate degradation estimation and is vulnerable to errors on out-of-distribution and real-world inputs. We propose UniRestorer++, a scalable framework based on multi-granularity degradation modeling. It progressively refines degradation groups and introduces group-specific experts, coupling capacity growth with specialization. Degradation-estimation-based routing selects a root-to-leaf path, while granularity-estimation-based routing chooses a level along that path to balance specialization and robustness. Spatially dense degradation representation maps further enable region-aware routing for spatially non-uniform corruptions. We develop CDD-50, a benchmark covering 50 degradation categories from single to penta-degradation. Experiments show approximately log-linear PSNR trends over the evaluated model-size range and stronger scaling gains on out-of-distribution and real-world data than vanilla MoE scaling. UniRestorer++ achieves state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks and demonstrates zero-shot generalization and few-shot transfer on real-world images. Code: https://github.com/mrluin/UniRestorer_plusplus
zh_title: UniRestorer++：具有多粒度退化建模的可扩展通用图像恢复
translation: 通用图像恢复旨在通过单个模型处理各种退化，但可靠的扩展策略仍有待探索。增加骨干网络的深度和宽度可能导致性能饱和，而基于退化感知的专业化依赖于准确的退化估计，并且容易在分布外和真实世界的输入上出错。我们提出了UniRestorer++，一个基于多粒度退化建模的可扩展框架。它逐步细化退化组并引入组特异性专家，将容量增长与专业化相结合。基于退化估计的路由选择根到叶路径，而基于粒度估计的路由沿该路径选择级别，以平衡专业化和鲁棒性。空间密集退化表示图进一步实现了区域感知路由，以处理空间上不均匀的损坏。我们开发了CDD-50，一个涵盖从单一退化到五重退化的50个退化类别的基准。实验表明，在评估的模型尺寸范围内，PSNR趋势近似对数线性，并且在分布外和真实世界数据上的扩展收益比标准的MoE扩展更强。UniRestorer++在各项基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，并在真实世界图像上实现了零样本泛化和少样本迁移。代码：https://github.com/mrluin/UniRestorer_plusplus
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为UniRestorer++的可扩展通用图像恢复框架，通过多粒度退化建模、组特异性专家和新颖的路由机制来解决现有方法的局限性，并在多种退化情况下实现了最先进的性能和良好的泛化能力。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的多粒度退化建模方法，用于可扩展的通用图像恢复，解决了现有方法的局限性。其创新的路由机制和专家设计值得关注。CDD-50基准的开发也为该领域的研究提供了宝贵的资源。然而，对于计算成本和实际部署的效率仍需进一步评估。
motivation: 现有通用图像恢复模型在扩展性和对真实世界退化的鲁棒性方面存在不足，而基于退化估计的方法容易出错。需要一种能够可靠扩展并处理多样化退化的单一模型。
method: 提出了一种名为UniRestorer++的可扩展框架，采用多粒度退化建模，逐步细化退化组并引入组特异性专家。通过退化估计路由选择路径，通过粒度估计路由选择级别，以平衡专业化和鲁棒性。引入空间密集退化表示图以实现区域感知路由。开发了包含50种退化类别的CDD-50基准。
results: UniRestorer++在模型尺寸扩展范围内实现了近似对数线性PSNR趋势，并在分布外和真实世界数据上比标准MoE扩展获得了更强的扩展收益。在各项基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，并在真实世界图像上实现了零样本泛化和少样本迁移。
conclusion: UniRestorer++通过多粒度退化建模和创新的路由机制，成功实现了可扩展的通用图像恢复，克服了现有方法的局限性，并在各种退化场景下展现出优越的性能和泛化能力。

title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
authors: Daniel Huang, Qi He, Shaoxiong Duan, Yingjie Li, Qiao Cheng, Yitao Duan
abstract: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. A token that is later revised costs wasted work or a wrong action. In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency. R2T2 is obtained by post-training Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on 1,500 hours of Chinese and English audio while freezing its pre-trained audio encoder and projector. The adaptation is based on the concept of Longest Stable Prefix (LSP), a new notion that we introduce in this work. We prove that LSP is monotone under the prefix order, consistent with the full-audio output, and maximal among labels that equal a whole earlier output. Learning from LSP labels converts a full-context model into a stable-prefix streaming one without any architectural change. Extensive evaluations show that R2T2 brings streaming recognition close to the base model's full-context quality while delivering stable text with low emission lag. Its gains extend beyond the post-training languages, demonstrating a practical path from full-context ASR to stable streaming. We open-source the model weights and code at https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2 and https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2.
comment: 30 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code and model weights available at https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2 and https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2
zh_title: Confucius4-R2T2：一种用于真实实时转录的稳定前缀流式自动语音识别模型
translation: 流式语音识别越来越多地被机器所消费，例如翻译器和语音代理，它们在每个词元出现时就进行操作。稍后被修改的词元会造成浪费或错误的行动。在这项工作中，我们提出了Confucius4-R2T2（代表真实实时转录），一个稳定的前缀流式自动语音识别模型，它在保持高准确率和低延迟的同时，从不修改其早期输出。R2T2是通过在1500小时的中文和英文音频上对Qwen3-ASR-1.7B进行后训练得到的，同时冻结其预训练的音频编码器和投影仪。该适应基于我们在这项工作中引入的一个新概念——长时稳定前缀（LSP）。我们证明了LSP在词语顺序上是单调的，与全音频输出一致，并且在等于先前完整输出的标签中是最大的。通过从LSP标签学习，可以在没有任何架构更改的情况下将全上下文模型转换为稳定的前缀流式模型。广泛的评估表明，R2T2使流式识别的质量接近基准模型的全上下文质量，同时提供稳定的文本输出和低延迟。其优势不仅限于后训练的语言，展示了从全上下文ASR到稳定流式的实用途径。我们在https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2和https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2上开源了模型权重和代码。
tldr: Confucius4-R2T2是一个稳定的流式自动语音识别模型，它在不修改早期输出的情况下保持高准确率和低延迟，通过在Qwen3-ASR-1.7B模型上进行长时稳定前缀（LSP）的后训练来实现，并在中文和英文音频上进行了评估，显示其性能接近全上下文模型。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的“长时稳定前缀”（LSP）概念，并成功将其应用于构建稳定的流式ASR模型Confucius4-R2T2。该模型在不牺牲准确率和低延迟的前提下，解决了流式语音识别中早期输出修改的问题，具有重要的理论和实践意义。其开源的实现进一步促进了该领域的研究和应用。
motivation: 机器（如翻译器和语音助手）在流式语音识别中需要基于每个出现的词元进行操作，而后续修改词元会造成浪费或错误操作。因此，需要一种能够避免修改早期输出的流式语音识别模型。
method: 通过在Qwen3-ASR-1.7B模型上进行后训练，冻结其预训练的音频编码器和投影仪，并引入“长时稳定前缀”（LSP）的概念。LSP被证明在保持与全音频输出一致性的同时，在等于先前完整输出的标签中是最大的。通过学习LSP标签，将全上下文模型转换为稳定的前缀流式模型，而无需改变架构。
results: Confucius4-R2T2在流式识别的准确率上接近基准全上下文模型的质量，同时提供了稳定的文本输出和低延迟。其优势不仅限于后训练的语言，为从全上下文ASR到稳定流式ASR提供了一条实用的途径。
conclusion: Confucius4-R2T2通过引入长时稳定前缀（LSP）的概念，成功地将全上下文模型转换为稳定的前缀流式ASR模型，实现了在不修改早期输出的情况下保持高准确率和低延迟，为流式语音识别提供了一种有效的解决方案。

title: DeepfakeGenome: Toward Next-Generation Deepfake Attribution
authors: Shunli Wang, Xinyu Zhou, Yandan Zhao, Wenbin Liang, Taiping Yao, Ke-Yue Zhang, Zhiyuan Yan, Shouhong Ding, Lizhuang Ma
abstract: In recent years, AIGC technologies are capable of generating hyper-realistic forged facial images, posing severe threats to facial security safety. To tackle these challenges, early Deepfake research primarily centered on real-fake classification. Recently, growing efforts have been devoted to the Deepfake Attribution (DFA) of generated content. Nevertheless, existing research on Deepfake detection and attribution faces saturated performance in binary classification, limited diversity in datasets and algorithms, and imperfect evaluation protocols, which severely impede practical application. To address these limitations, we propose a comprehensive deepfake detection and attribution benchmark named DeepfakeGenome (DFG). It contains 100 facial forgery algorithms and 2M images in total, achieving 4x to 100x larger than prior DFA benchmarks. We further design 4 protocols for practical evaluation, including a novel retrieval-based attribution paradigm. Unlike previous open-set evaluation metrics, the proposed retrieval metrics are more aligned with the real-world active defense situation of blacklist registration mechanisms. Based on these elaborate designs, we investigate the performance ceiling of deepfake attribution task. Over 2k experimental evaluations are conducted, and 10 insightful findings are derived. We believe this work can provide new insights into the DFA research field. The Code and Benchmark of DFG are avaliable on https://huggingface.co/spaces/DeepfakeGenome/DFG_Page.
zh_title: DeepfakeGenome：迈向下一代深度伪造归属
translation: 近年来，AIGC技术能够生成超级逼真的伪造面部图像，对面部安全构成了严重威胁。为了应对这些挑战，早期的Deepfake研究主要集中在真假分类上。最近，越来越多的努力投入到生成内容的Deepfake归属（DFA）中。然而，现有的深度伪造检测和归属研究面临着二分类性能饱和、数据集和算法多样性有限以及评估协议不完善的问题，严重阻碍了实际应用。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一个名为DeepfakeGenome（DFG）的综合深度伪造检测和归属基准。它总共包含100种面部伪造算法和200万张图像，比以往的DFA基准大4到100倍。我们进一步为实际评估设计了4个协议，包括一种新颖的基于检索的归属范式。与以往的开放集评估指标不同，所提出的检索指标更符合黑名单注册机制的现实主动防御情况。基于这些精心设计，我们探究了深度伪造归属任务的性能上限。进行了超过2000次实验评估，并得出了10个有见地的发现。我们相信这项工作可以为DFA研究领域提供新的见解。DFG的代码和基准可在https://huggingface.co/spaces/DeepfakeGenome/DFG_Page获取。
tldr: 该论文提出了目前最大、最多样化的深度伪造检测与归属基准DeepfakeGenome，并引入了基于检索的归属新范式和实用评估协议。
ai_comments: 该论文构建了一个目前规模最大、算法多样性最丰富的深度伪造检测与归属基准（DeepfakeGenome），并创新性地提出了基于检索的归属范式，更契合实际的主动防御需求，对推动深度伪造归属（DFA）领域的发展具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的Deepfake检测和归属研究面临二分类性能饱和、数据集和算法多样性有限以及评估协议不完善等问题，严重阻碍了实际应用，因此需要一个更全面、更符合实际防御需求的基准。
method: 提出了包含100种人脸伪造算法和200万图像的综合基准（DeepfakeGenome），设计了4个实际评估协议（包含一种新颖的基于检索的归属范式），并进行了2000多次实验评估。
results: 构建了比以往DFA基准大4到100倍的DeepfakeGenome基准，进行了2000多次实验评估，并得出了10项有见地的发现。
conclusion: 通过提出DeepfakeGenome基准、4个实际评估协议和基于检索的归属范式，该研究为深度伪造归属任务提供了新的性能上限洞察和实用评估框架。

title: Do Search-Augmented Recommenders Use the Latest Search Episode?
authors: Jiandong Ding
abstract:
Search-augmented recommenders can use the latest search episode and earlier searches. We introduce FocalSwap to test how these inputs contribute to the next recommendation. For each recommendation, it changes the latest search slot or all search inputs while holding the target, candidates, pre-search history, and scorer fixed. It compares neutral masks with matched observed-search replacements, recording rank changes, RR gains relative to each control, and preference for the true focal search. A planted signal and GenSAR's current-query task confirm that the audit detects known input dependence. We evaluate behavioral and lexical evidence on KuaiSAR and Qilin, and recommendation checkpoints trained using the released SESRec and UniSAR implementations.
  Across three independently trained UniSAR checkpoints, the estimated all-source benefit depends on the control. On the same 66,139 rows, replacing all search inputs with a neutral ID yields a positive signed contribution, whereas replacing them with category/profile-matched observed search sequences gives smaller estimates, with an interval below zero for one checkpoint. The paired RR gaps range from $+2.770 \times 10^{-3}$ to $+6.604 \times 10^{-3}$, and every adjusted interval is above zero. Neutral masks change 59.7-61.7% of target ranks, while matched replacements change 44.1-44.8%. The control contrast persists across five alternative donor assignments per checkpoint. Under the primary neutral-mask and category-matched controls, positive latest-slot contribution is not established in SESRec or UniSAR. These results show why masking evidence should be compared with observed-search replacements when attributing a benefit to broader search state or the latest episode.
zh_title: 搜索增强推荐系统会使用最新的搜索片段吗？
translation: 搜索增强推荐系统可以使用最新的搜索片段和更早的搜索。我们引入了FocalSwap来测试这些输入如何对下一次推荐做出贡献。对于每个推荐，它会改变最新的搜索槽或所有的搜索输入，同时保持目标、候选集、预搜索历史和评分器固定。它将中性掩码与匹配的观测搜索替换进行comparison，记录排名变化、相对于每个对照的RR增益，以及对真实焦点搜索的偏好。一个植入的信号和GenSAR的当前查询任务证实了该审计能够检测已知的输入依赖性。我们在KuaiSAR和Qilin上评估了行为和词汇证据，以及使用发布的SESRec和UniSAR实现训练的推荐检查点。在三个独立训练的UniSAR检查点中，估计的全源收益取决于对照。在相同的66,139行数据中，用中性ID替换所有搜索输入会产生正的有符号贡献，而用类别/配置文件匹配的观测搜索序列替换它们给出的估计值较小，其中一个检查点的区间低于零。配对的RR间隙从 $+2.770 \times 10^{-3}$ 到 $+6.604 \times 10^{-3}$ 不等，且每个调整后的区间都高于零。中性掩码改变了59.7-61.7%的目标排名，而匹配的替换改变了44.1-44.8%。对照对比在每个检查点的五个替代捐赠者分配中持续存在。在主要的中性掩码和类别匹配对照下，SESRec或UniSAR中并未确立最新搜索槽的正向贡献。这些结果表明了为什么在将收益归因于更广泛的搜索状态或最新片段时，应将掩码证据与观测搜索替换进行比较。
tldr: 提出FocalSwap方法评估搜索增强推荐系统中的搜索输入贡献，发现控制基准的选择对归因结果有重大影响。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种名为FocalSwap的新方法，用于审计和评估搜索增强推荐系统中最新搜索片段和早期搜索对推荐结果的具体贡献，揭示了不同控制基准（中性掩码与匹配的观测搜索替换）对归因分析的重要影响，对未来推荐系统可解释性研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 为了测试和了解搜索增强推荐系统中，最新搜索片段与早期搜索输入是如何具体贡献于下一步推荐结果的，并探究不同控制基准对归因分析的影响。
method: 引入了FocalSwap方法，通过在固定目标、候选集、预搜索历史和评分器的条件下，改变最新搜索槽或所有搜索输入，对比中性掩码与匹配的观测搜索替换，记录排名的变化、RR增益以及对真实焦点搜索的偏好。
results: 通过对UniSAR、SESRec在KuaiSAR和Qilin数据集上的评估发现，所有来源的获益估计高度依赖于控制基准；在中性和分类匹配控制下，SESRec或UniSAR中并未确立最新搜索槽的正向贡献。
conclusion: 研究表明，在评估搜索增强推荐系统时，掩码证据必须与观测搜索替换进行比较，才能准确归因更广泛的搜索状态或最新片段的好处。当前模型下，最新搜索槽的正向贡献并未在SESRec或UniSAR中得到证实。

title: RI-Prune: Relation and Information Aware Visual Token Pruning for Multi-Image Vision-Language Models
authors: Dongjin Lee, Eunju Lee, Jinhee Jang, Yoonji Lee, Youngbin Kim
abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have recently been extended to handle multiple input images, but this extension dramatically increases the visual token budget, making visual-token pruning not merely an efficiency option but a practical necessity. Existing visual-token pruning methods, primarily designed for the single-image setting, rely on attention-derived saliency signals to estimate per-token importance. However, this attention-centric design transfers poorly to the multi-image regime: it causes substantial performance degradation on multi-image benchmarks, suffers from strong positional bias, and loses discriminative attention signals as the number of input images increases. To test whether attention-selected tokens are truly important for multi-image reasoning, we conduct two complementary causal probes Leave-One-In and Leave-One-Deletion, which measure token importance by restoring individual tokens to a zeroed visual sequence or removing them from the full sequence. Attention-based pruners provide only marginal gains over random selection, showing that attention is a weak proxy for visual-token importance in multi-image reasoning. Motivated by this gap, we propose Relation and Information Aware Pruning (RI-Prune), a training-free, attention-free pre-decoder selector for multi-image visual token pruning. RI-Prune scores each visual token using a z-normalized combination of three signals computed from projector outputs: query relevance, cross-image correspondence with compact per-image prototypes, and intra image representativeness. By integrating these signals, RI-Prune performs balanced per-image Top-K selection to preserve information across input images. Across multiple multi-image benchmarks and three LVLM backbones, RI-Prune achieves a stronger trade-off between token reduction and task performance than prior pruning methods, particularly under aggressive token budgets.
zh_title: 面向多图像视觉语言模型的、感知关系与信息的视觉标记剪枝方法
translation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）最近已扩展到处理多个输入图像，但这种扩展极大地增加了视觉标记的预算，使得视觉标记剪枝不仅仅是一个效率选项，而是一个实际必需。现有的视觉标记剪枝方法主要为单图像场景设计，依靠注意力衍生的显着性信号来估计每个标记的重要性。然而，这种以注意力为中心的设计在多图像模型上的迁移效果不佳：它会导致多图像基准的性能大幅下降，存在严重的位置偏差，并且随着输入图像数量的增加，会丢失区分性的注意力信号。为了检验注意力选择的标记是否对多图像推理真正重要，我们进行了两种互补的因果探测——“仅保留”和“删除一个”，它们通过将单个标记恢复到零值视觉序列或从完整序列中删除它们来衡量标记的重要性。基于注意力的剪枝器仅提供比随机选择略微的增益，表明注意力是多图像推理中视觉标记重要性的薄弱代理。基于这种差距，我们提出了关系与信息感知剪枝（RI-Prune），一种无需训练、不依赖注意力的预解码器选择器，用于多图像视觉标记剪枝。RI-Prune使用从投影仪输出计算的三个信号的z标准化组合来为每个视觉标记评分：查询相关性、具有紧凑的每图像原型的跨图像对应性以及图像内代表性。通过整合这些信号，RI-Prune执行平衡的每图像Top-K选择，以在输入图像之间保留信息。在多个多图像基准和三种LVLM骨干网络上，RI-Prune在标记缩减和任务性能之间实现了比现有剪枝方法更强的权衡，尤其是在高标记缩减率下。
tldr: 现有视觉标记剪枝方法在多图像场景下效果不佳。本文提出RI-Prune方法，通过查询相关性、跨图像原型对应和图像内代表性三个信号来选择视觉标记，在多图像基准上表现优于现有方法。
ai_comments: RI-Prune方法通过引入关系和信息感知信号，有效解决了现有视觉标记剪枝方法在多图像场景下的局限性。该方法无需训练且不依赖注意力机制，具有较高的实用价值。然而，对于不同类型的多图像任务和不同数量的图像输入，其性能表现仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 现有基于注意力的视觉标记剪枝方法在多图像场景下性能下降，并且存在位置偏差，因此需要新的剪枝方法来适应多图像场景。
method: RI-Prune是一种无需训练、不依赖注意力的预解码器选择器，它结合了查询相关性、跨图像原型对应和图像内代表性这三个信号来评估视觉标记的重要性，并进行跨图像的Top-K选择。
results: RI-Prune在多图像基准和三种LVLM骨干网络上，在标记缩减和任务性能之间实现了比现有方法更优的权衡，尤其是在高标记缩减率下。
conclusion: RI-Prune是一种有效的多图像视觉标记剪枝方法，能够克服现有方法在多图像场景下的局限性，并在保持模型性能的同时显著减少视觉标记数量。

title: SVGFaith: A Two-Layer Meta-Evaluation of Faithfulness Metrics for Text-to-SVG Generation
authors: Guotao Liang, Haitao Zhou, Biao Liu, Huanxuan Liao, Lingfeng Qiao, Qian-Wen Zhang, Qian Yu, Di Yin, Xing Sun
abstract: Text-to-SVG systems are commonly evaluated by applying raster-image metrics to rasterised outputs, yet whether these scores capture fine-grained prompt faithfulness remains unclear. We introduce SVGFaith, a two-layer meta-evaluation framework in which the more faithful candidate of each pair is determined by construction or by human judgment. SVGFaith-Diagnostic contains 1,842 controlled contrastive pairs across eight capability axes, split evenly between two directions: two renderings compared against one prompt, and two descriptions compared against one rendering. SVGFaith-Arena contains 1,327 human-annotated comparisons of real generator outputs. On SVGFaith-Diagnostic, CLIP and three other image--text embedding metrics reach at least 0.789 pairwise accuracy on object identity but at most 0.672 on spatial relations and attribute binding, where chance is 0.5. We further introduce SVGFaith-Score, an interpretable pointwise metric. A domain-tuned decomposer turns each prompt into a dependency graph of atomic visual requirements, a visual question answering model scores whether each requirement is satisfied, and a requirement's score is discounted when its prerequisites score low. In addition to the overall score, the per-requirement scores show which requirements are judged unsatisfied and which inherit discounts from their prerequisites. SVGFaith-Score significantly outperforms all nine baselines, including a Qwen3.5-122B-A10B judge, on Arena and in both Diagnostic directions. Code and data: https://github.com/Yukinonooo/SVGFaith.
zh_title: SVGFaith：文本到SVG生成忠实度指标的双层元评估
translation: 文本到SVG系统通常通过将光栅图像指标应用于光栅化输出来进行评估，然而这些得分是否能捕捉到细粒度的提示忠实度仍不清楚。我们介绍了SVGFaith，这是一个双层元评估框架，其中每一对中更忠实的候选者是通过构造或人类判断来确定的。SVGFaith-Diagnostic包含1,842个跨越八个能力轴的受控对比对，均等地分为两个方向：两个渲染与一个提示的对比，以及两个描述与一个渲染的对比。SVGFaith-Arena包含1,327个人工注释的真实生成器输出比较。在SVGFaith-Diagnostic上，CLIP和其他三个图文嵌入指标在对象身份上的成对准确率至少达到0.789，但在空间关系和属性绑定上最高为0.672（随机概率为0.5）。我们进一步介绍了SVGFaith-Score，这是一种可解释的逐点指标。一个经过领域微调的分解器将每个提示转化为原子视觉需求的依赖图，视觉问答模型对每个需求是否满足进行打分，当其前置条件得分较低时，该需求的得分会受到折扣。除了整体得分外，逐项需求得分还显示了哪些需求被判定为未满足，以及哪些需求继承了来自其前置条件的折扣。SVGFaith-Score在Arena和两个Diagnostic方向上均显著优于所有九个基线，包括Qwen3.5-122B-A10B裁判模型。代码和数据：https://github.com/Yukinonooo/SVGFaith。
tldr: 本文提出了SVGFaith元评估框架和SVGFaith-Score指标，解决了文本生成SVG中细粒度忠实度评估准确性不足的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对文本生成SVG（Text-to-SVG）领域评估指标缺乏细粒度忠实度捕捉能力的问题，提出了SVGFaith框架和SVGFaith-Score指标。其创新之处在于通过双层元评估和依赖图引导的VQA方法，显著提升了模型生成结果与提示词一致性的评估准确性和可解释性，对未来图形生成评估方法的研究具有重要推动作用。
motivation: 现有的文本-到-SVG系统通常通过对栅格化输出应用栅格图像指标进行评估，然而这些分数是否能捕捉到细粒度的提示忠实度仍不明确，因此需要一个专门的元评估框架和更精准的忠实度评估指标。
method: 引入SVGFaith双层元评估框架（包括SVGFaith-Diagnostic和SVGFaith-Arena）；提出SVGFaith-Score可解释逐点指标，利用领域微调的分解器将提示转换为原子视觉需求的依赖图，通过视觉问答模型打分并根据前置条件进行折扣计算。
results: 在SVGFaith-Diagnostic上，CLIP等图像-文本嵌入指标在对象身份上达到至少0.789的成对准确率，但在空间关系和属性绑定上最高仅为0.672；而SVGFaith-Score在Arena以及两个Diagnostic方向上显著优于包括Qwen3.5-122B-A10B裁判在内的所有九个基线。
conclusion: SVGFaith框架和SVGFaith-Score指标成功弥补了现有光栅图像指标在评估文本生成SVG忠实度方面的不足，在诊断和竞技场基准测试中均展现出卓越的性能与可解释性。

title: Reglos: A Self-Evolving Personal Memory Agent with Recursive Self-Improvement
authors: Sen Yang, Jiaduo Lin, Zehong Huang, Wen Liu
abstract: Personal agents draw on past conversations to tailor their responses to each user. Their memory systems store and update what each user says, and coding agents now also rewrite the harness that turns this memory into the model's context. Such patches risk overfitting, because one tested only on the failures it targets can fix those cases and help nowhere else. We present Reglos, a training-free personal memory agent that tests whether harness changes help beyond the failures they were written to fix. Its self-evolving memory adds to each user's append-only record with every conversation, as new preferences supersede old ones and facts can be forgotten. Its harness improves through recursive self-improvement, in which a coding agent proposes patches from failure traces and a critic from a second model family screens each one for benchmark gaming. After the harness is frozen, a fixed evaluator decides which further patches to accept. With the same backbone behind every system, Reglos outperforms state-of-the-art memory systems such as Mem0, MemOS and EverOS, reaching 61.3% and 84.0% on PersonaMem-v2 and LongMemEval-S with Qwen3.8-27B, and 57.5% and 87.2% with GPT-5.6 Luna.
zh_title: Reglos：一个具有递归自我改进的自进化个人记忆代理
translation: 个人代理利用过去的对话来为每个用户定制他们的响应。它们的记忆系统存储和更新每个用户所说的内容，而编码代理现在也重写了将此记忆转化为模型上下文的“马具”。此类修补存在过拟合的风险，因为只针对其要修复的故障进行测试的代理可能会修复这些情况，但无助于其他方面。我们提出了 Reglos，一个无需训练的个人记忆代理，它测试“马具”的更改是否能在其旨在修复的故障之外提供帮助。其自进化的记忆系统在每次对话中都会向每个用户的追加式记录添加信息，因为新的偏好会取代旧的偏好，事实也可能被遗忘。其“马具”通过递归自我改进得到提升，其中编码代理从故障跟踪中提出补丁，而来自第二个模型家族的评估器则筛选每个补丁以防止基准测试作弊。在“马具”冻结后，一个固定的评估器决定接受哪些进一步的补丁。由于每个系统都拥有相同的骨干，Reglos 的性能优于 Mem0、MemOS 和 EverOS 等最先进的记忆系统，在使用 Qwen3.8-27B 时在 PersonaMem-v2 和 LongMemEval-S 上分别达到 61.3% 和 84.0%，在使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 时分别达到 57.5% 和 87.2%。
tldr: Reglos 是一种无需训练的个人记忆代理，通过递归自我改进来增强其记忆系统的适应性，解决了现有方法过度拟合的问题，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: Reglos 的递归自我改进方法在解决个人代理的过拟合问题方面具有重要意义。其训练免费的特性和在多个基准测试中的卓越表现，使其成为一个极具潜力的研究方向。然而，对于其评估器在防止基准测试作弊方面的具体机制，以及在不同模型家族中的泛化能力，仍需进一步的深入研究。
motivation: 现有的个人代理在利用过去的对话来定制响应时，其记忆系统的修补方式容易导致过拟合，因为它们只针对特定的故障进行优化，而无法泛化到其他情况。
method: Reglos 采用一种无需训练的方法，通过递归自我改进来优化其记忆系统的“马具”。该过程包括一个编码代理提出基于故障跟踪的补丁，一个来自不同模型家族的评估器筛选这些补丁以防止基准测试作弊，最后由一个固定的评估器决定接受哪些进一步的补丁。其记忆系统是追加式的，能够根据新偏好更新信息，并允许遗忘事实。
results: Reglos 在 PersonaMem-v2 和 LongMemEval-S 基准测试中，使用 Qwen3.8-27B 时分别达到了 61.3% 和 84.0% 的准确率，使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 时分别达到了 57.5% 和 87.2% 的准确率，性能优于 Mem0、MemOS 和 EverOS 等最先进的记忆系统。
conclusion: Reglos 通过其创新的训练免费、递归自我改进方法，成功地超越了现有的最先进的个人记忆代理，在多个基准测试中展现出卓越的性能和适应性。

title: Softmax Attention with Any Temperature in Fixed Dimension: Matching the Best Known Maximum-Inner-Product Bounds
authors: Zixuan Huang, Guozhang Chen
abstract:
Attention is central to modern AI models for language, vision, and scientific modeling. However, direct evaluation compares every query with every key, requiring quadratic time in the context length, which limits its scalability to long contexts. Consequently, characterizing the complexity bounds of attention is of fundamental importance.
  For every fixed dimension $d$, we give an algorithm for $m$ queries, $n$ key-value pairs, and additive error $\varepsilon$, with expected time $ \widetilde{\mathrm{O}}\bigl((mn)^{k/(k+1)}+m+n\bigr),\qquad k=\lfloor d/2\rfloor. $
  For fixed dimension and a fixed number of value channels, soft-O hides factors of the form $\operatorname{poly}_d\bigl(b,\log(m+n),\log B,\log(1/\varepsilon)\bigr),$ where $b$ bounds input encoding lengths and $B$ bounds coordinate and value magnitudes. In particular, the dependence on $B$ and $1/\varepsilon$ is polylogarithmic, which allows arbitrary positive temperature. When $m=n$ and $d\ge2$, the bound is $\widetilde{\mathrm{O}}(n^{2-2/(\lfloor d/2\rfloor+1)})$: near-linear in dimensions two and three, with exponent $4/3$ in dimensions four and five and $3/2$ in dimensions six and seven. It improves the previous $\widetilde{\mathrm{O}}(n^{2-1/d})$ upper bound and matches the best known batch maximum-inner-product bound in each fixed dimension. Additionally, we reduce integer batch maximum inner product computation to one attention call with the same dimension and input sizes $m,n$.
zh_title: Softmax注意力在固定维度下的任意温度：匹配已知最优的最大内积界限
translation:
注意力机制是现代语言、视觉和科学建模AI的核心。然而，直接评估需要将每个查询与每个键进行比较，这需要与上下文长度成二次方的时间，限制了其在长上下文中的可扩展性。因此，表征注意力的复杂度界限具有根本重要性。 
对于每个固定维度 $d$，我们给出了一个算法，用于 $m$ 个查询，$n$ 个键值对和加性误差 $\varepsilon$，其期望时间为 $ \widetilde{\mathrm{O}} igl((mn)^{k/(k+1)}+m+n igr),
其中 $k=\lfloor d/2\rfloor$。
对于固定维度和固定数量的值通道，soft-O隐藏了 $\operatorname{poly}_d igl(b,\log(m+n),\log B,\log(1/\varepsilon)\bigr)$ 形式的因子，其中 $b$ 限制了输入编码长度，$B$ 限制了坐标和值的大小。特别是，对 $B$ 和 $1/\varepsilon$ 的依赖是多对数级的，这允许任意正温度。当 $m=n$ 且 $d\ge2$ 时，界限为 $\widetilde{\mathrm{O}}(n^{2-2/(\lfloor d/2\rfloor+1)})$：在维度二和三中接近线性，在维度四和五中指数为 $4/3$，在维度六和七中为 $3/2$。它改进了之前的 $\widetilde{\mathrm{O}}(n^{2-1/d})$ 上界，并在每个固定维度上匹配了已知最优的批次最大内积界限。此外，我们将整数批次最大内积计算约简为一次具有相同维度和输入规模 $m,n$ 的注意力调用。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的软最大注意力算法，在固定维度下，能够以任意温度进行计算，并达到了当前已知的最优最大内积界限。
ai_comments: 该研究在理论上取得了显著进展，将注意力机制的计算复杂度与最优界限相匹配，并允许更灵活的温度参数设置。然而，实际应用中的性能提升仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 注意力机制在现代AI模型中至关重要，但其二次方的时间复杂度限制了其在长上下文中的应用。因此，对注意力机制的复杂度界限进行表征具有根本重要性。
method: 论文提出了一种新的算法，对于给定的维度d、m个查询、n个键值对和误差ε，其期望时间复杂度为 $\widetilde{\mathrm{O}} igl((mn)^{k/(k+1)}+m+n igr)$, 其中 $k=\lfloor d/2\rfloor$。该算法能够处理任意正温度，并且在特定条件下（m=n且d≥2）可以达到 $\widetilde{\mathrm{O}}(n^{2-2/(\lfloor d/2\rfloor+1)})$ 的复杂度。
results: 该算法在固定维度下，达到了当前已知的最优最大内积界限，并且优于之前的上界。此外，该研究还将整数批次最大内积计算约简为一次具有相同维度和输入规模的注意力调用。
conclusion: 该研究成功地为软最大注意力机制在固定维度下的任意温度计算提供了新的算法，显著提高了效率，并达到了理论最优界限，为处理长上下文和复杂模型提供了新的可能性。

title: vExpert: Virtualizing Expert Storage for Adaptive Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference
authors: Wenxun Wang, Xiuhong Li, Yida Wang, Chen Tang, Zongle Huang, Ke Hong, Yu Wang, Yongpan Liu
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become prevailing, yet their distributed deployment suffers from severe dynamic load imbalance due to the conflict between static expert placement and inherent routing dynamism. While host DRAM offers capacity to avoid static device storage for load balancing, we identify existing offloading works fundamentally fail in distributed inference due to two overlooked challenges: (1) coupled performance impacts of runtime Host-to-Device transfers due to load dynamism and shared PCIe topology; (2) system-level memory overhead incurred by DRAM usage at scale. In this paper, we propose vExpert that shifts DRAM offloading paradigm from partial residency to full redundancy through virtualized expert storage. We pioneer the first systematic performance model that jointly captures H2D latency, PCIe contention, and load imbalance, building a lightweight allocator to dynamically map physical experts to virtual slots runtime. A novel disaggregated manager is designed to reduce memory overhead in multi-process environments. Evaluated on DeepSeek-V3.1 within an 8-node H100 cluster, vExpert improves load balance ratio by up to 55% and achieves 1.2$\times$ end-to-end speedup.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 21 pages, including references and appendices
zh_title: vExpert: 面向分布式MoE推理自适应负载均衡的虚拟化专家存储
translation: 混合专家（MoE）模型已变得普遍，但其分布式部署由于静态专家放置与固有路由动态性之间的冲突，在动态负载不平衡方面存在严重问题。虽然主机DRAM提供了避免负载均衡静态设备存储的容量，但我们发现现有的卸载工作由于两个被忽视的挑战而在分布式推理中根本失败：（1）由于负载动态性和共享PCIe拓扑导致的运行时主机到设备传输的性能影响耦合；（2）大规模使用DRAM所产生的系统级内存开销。在本文中，我们提出了vExpert，通过虚拟化专家存储将DRAM卸载范式从部分驻留转变为完全冗余。我们开创了第一个系统性能模型，联合捕获H2D延迟、PCIe争用和负载不平衡，构建了一个轻量级分配器，在运行时动态地将物理专家映射到虚拟槽位。设计了一个新颖的分解管理器，以减少多进程环境中的内存开销。在H100集群上对DeepSeek-V3.1进行评估，vExpert将负载均衡比提高了55%，实现了1.2倍的端到端加速。
tldr: 通过虚拟化专家存储，vExpert解决了分布式MoE推理中的负载不平衡问题，通过新的性能模型和轻量级分配器，实现了显著的负载均衡和速度提升。
ai_comments: 该研究有效地解决了分布式MoE推理中的关键挑战——动态负载不平衡问题。通过引入虚拟化专家存储和创新的性能建模及资源管理技术，vExpert不仅提升了负载均衡效果，还实现了显著的性能加速。其提出的系统级方法具有重要的理论和实践意义，但大规模部署下的长期稳定性和与其他系统组件的兼容性有待进一步验证。
motivation: 分布式MoE部署面临静态专家放置与动态路由冲突导致的严重动态负载不平衡问题。现有卸载方法因运行时主机到设备传输的性能影响和系统级内存开销而失败。
method: 提出vExpert，将DRAM卸载范式从部分驻留转变为通过虚拟化专家存储实现完全冗余。构建了联合捕获H2D延迟、PCIe争用和负载不平衡的系统性能模型，并设计了轻量级分配器动态映射物理专家到虚拟槽位，以及一个新颖的分解管理器以减少内存开销。
results: 在H100集群上对DeepSeek-V3.1进行评估，vExpert将负载均衡比提高了55%，实现了1.2倍的端到端加速。
conclusion: vExpert通过虚拟化专家存储，有效解决了分布式MoE推理中的负载不平衡问题，并在实际环境中取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Alleviating Limited Effectiveness and Multi-Class Collapse in Deep Graph-level Clustering
authors: Xiaoyang Lin, Renchi Yang, Yuqi Chen, Xin Huang
abstract: Given a collection of $N$ graphs, graph-level clustering (GLC) seeks to partition the $N$ graphs into semantically meaningful groups, which serves as a fundamental task in analyzing graph-structured data. While Graph Isomorphism Networks (GINs) have become the de facto encoders for GLC, they still fail to distinguish graphs due to their neglect of global topology. On top of that, existing deep clustering frameworks suffer from severe "clustering collapse" issues, particularly in imbalanced multi-class scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose S$^3$GLC, a novel framework that integrates global topological characteristics with local neighborhood features for balanced GLC. Theoretically, we leverage the Hoffman-Wielandt inequality to construct Spectral Signature as a rigorous lower bound for graph edit distance (GED), providing a computationally efficient proxy for global topological features. We additionally propose a joint manifold-preserving sparse regression module to fuse Spectral Signature with Spatial Representation, eliminating noise while preserving the complementary information. Furthermore, to mitigate clustering collapse, we introduce a balanced clustering objective based on optimal transport, harnessing the Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization to enforce equipartition constraints on cluster assignments. Extensive experiments on 10 real-world datasets demonstrate that S$^3$GLC significantly outperforms 15 state-of-the-art baselines, achieving remarkable improvements on benchmark datasets such as REDDIT-12K and OGBG-PPA.
zh_title: 缓解深度图级别聚类中有限的有效性和多类别坍塌
translation: 鉴于$N$个图的集合，图级别聚类（GLC）旨在将$N$个图划分为有意义的组，这是分析图结构数据的基本任务。虽然图同构网络（GINs）已成为GLC的事实编码器，但由于它们忽略了全局拓扑，仍然无法区分图。此外，现有的深度聚类框架在多类别场景不平衡时，会遭受严重的“聚类坍塌”问题。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了S$^3$GLC，一种整合全局拓扑特征和局部邻域特征以实现平衡GLC的新颖框架。理论上，我们利用霍夫曼-威尔兰特不等式来构建谱签名，作为图编辑距离（GED）的严格下界，为全局拓扑特征提供了一个计算上有效的代理。我们还提出了一种联合流形保持稀疏回归模块，将谱签名与空间表示融合，消除噪声，同时保留互补信息。此外，为了减轻聚类坍塌，我们引入了一种基于最优传输的平衡聚类目标，利用Sinkhorn-Knopp归一化来强制执行簇分配的均分约束。在10个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，S$^3$GLC显著优于15种最先进的基线方法，在REDDIT-12K和OGBG-PPA等基准数据集上取得了显著的改进。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为S$^3$GLC的新框架，用于解决深度图级别聚类（GLC）中的两个主要问题：GINs忽略全局拓扑信息导致的区分能力有限，以及现有框架在多类别不平衡场景下出现的聚类坍塌问题。S$^3$GLC通过结合全局拓扑特征（利用霍夫曼-威尔兰特不等式构造的谱签名）和局部邻域特征（空间表示），并引入基于最优传输和Sinkhorn-Knopp归一化的平衡聚类目标，有效缓解了这些问题。实验证明，S$^3$GLC在10个真实世界数据集上显著优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的S$^3$GLC框架，有效地解决了图级别聚类中的两个关键挑战：利用谱签名来捕捉全局拓扑信息以增强图区分能力，以及通过基于最优传输的平衡聚类目标来缓解多类别不平衡场景下的聚类坍塌问题。将理论上的图编辑距离下界（谱签名）与实际的图表示（空间表示）相结合，并通过稀疏回归进行融合，是一种有前景的方法。此外，引入基于最优传输的平衡聚类目标，利用Sinkhorn-Knopp归一化来强制执行均分约束，为处理不平衡数据提供了有效的解决方案。该方法在多个真实世界数据集上取得了显著的性能提升，证明了其有效性和实用性。然而，计算谱签名和最优传输的计算复杂度可能是一个潜在的限制，在非常大规模的图数据集上可能需要进一步优化。
motivation: 现有的图级别聚类（GLC）方法，特别是基于图同构网络（GINs）的方法，在区分图方面存在局限性，因为它们忽略了全局拓扑信息。此外，现有的深度聚类框架在处理不平衡的多类别场景时，会遇到严重的“聚类坍塌”问题。
method: 提出了一种名为S$^3$GLC的新框架。该框架整合了全局拓扑特征（通过霍夫曼-威尔兰特不等式构造的谱签名，作为图编辑距离的计算高效代理）和局部邻域特征（空间表示）。通过一个联合的保持流形的稀疏回归模块来融合这两种特征。为了解决聚类坍塌问题，引入了一个基于最优传输的平衡聚类目标，并利用Sinkhorn-Knopp归一化来强制执行簇分配的均分约束。
results: 在10个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，S$^3$GLC显著优于15种最先进的基线方法，并在REDDIT-12K和OGBG-PPA等基准数据集上取得了显著的改进。
conclusion: S$^3$GLC框架通过有效整合全局拓扑信息和局部邻域特征，并采用创新的平衡聚类策略，成功解决了深度图级别聚类中存在的区分能力不足和聚类坍塌等关键挑战，并在多项真实世界数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。

title: TouchéWorld tech report : Towards Online Unified Camera--Hand Exploration in Generative Worlds
authors: Jiaao Yu, Yanjian Zhang, Haoyang Jiang, Guillaume Wisniewski, Nadi Tomeh, Shijie Jia
abstract: Recent video world models allow users to explore generated environments through camera navigation. Continuous hand motion provides a fine-grained action channel for interacting with the people and objects encountered during exploration. We present TouchéWorld, a framework that integrates gesture-driven interaction into a camera-controlled video world model. Given an initial image and a scene-description prompt, the model generates video conditioned on temporally aligned camera and hand controls. We construct joint camera--hand training data from heterogeneous egocentric videos through annotation completion, consistency-based filtering, and temporal alignment. Building on a pretrained camera-controlled world model, we combine spatial hand-skeleton conditioning with numerical hand-motion features through parameter-efficient adaptation. Causal adaptation and few-step distillation support chunk-level online generation, allowing users to update their controls based on generated visual feedback. We further introduce TouchéBench to evaluate hand-motion following, camera--hand coordination, online interaction, and object response. Together, these components establish a framework for studying continuous exploration and hand-driven interaction within generative worlds.
zh_title: 通感世界技术报告：迈向生成世界中的在线统一相机-手部探索
translation: 最近的视频世界模型允许用户通过相机导航探索生成的环境。连续的手部运动为与探索过程中遇到的人和物体进行交互提供了一个细粒度的动作通道。我们提出了TouchéWorld，一个将手势驱动的交互集成到相机控制的视频世界模型中的框架。给定初始图像和场景描述提示，模型会生成以时间对齐的相机和手部控制为条件的视频。我们通过注释完成、基于一致性的过滤和时间对齐，从异构的自我中心视频中构建联合相机-手部训练数据。在预训练的相机控制世界模型的基础上，我们将空间手部骨骼条件与数值手部运动特征通过参数高效的适应相结合。因果适应和几步蒸馏支持块级别的在线生成，允许用户根据生成的视觉反馈更新他们的控制。我们进一步引入了TouchéBench来评估手部运动跟随、相机-手部协调、在线交互和物体响应。这些组件共同建立了一个用于在生成世界中研究连续探索和手部驱动交互的框架。
tldr: 该研究提出了TouchéWorld，一个将手势交互集成到相机控制的视频世界模型中的框架，实现了在生成世界中进行连续的探索和手部驱动的交互。
ai_comments: 该研究在生成世界模型领域取得了重要进展，通过集成手部交互解决了现有方法的局限性。其创新性在于实现了相机-手部联合控制的在线生成和交互，并提供了相应的评估基准。未来可以进一步探索更复杂的手部动作识别和交互方式。
motivation: 为了在生成世界中实现更精细的交互，需要将连续的手部运动与相机导航相结合。
method: 通过结合空间手部骨骼和数值手部运动特征，并使用参数高效的适应和因果适应以及几步蒸馏来实现分块级别的在线生成。同时，构建了包含相机和手部控制的训练数据。
results: TouchéWorld框架能够根据图像和场景描述生成视频，并对用户的手部和相机控制做出响应。TouchéBench基准测试了手部运动跟随、相机-手部协调、在线交互和物体响应。
conclusion: TouchéWorld框架为在生成世界中研究连续探索和手部驱动的交互提供了一个平台。

title: Exact Transport-Information Correspondence for Distribution-Adaptive Discretization
authors: Koretaka Yuge
abstract: Discretization of continuous probability distributions is an operation on the sample space, and the structure induced by this operation cannot generally be determined solely from information geometry. In our recent work on unavoidable canonical nonlinearity (UCN), we established a non-arbitrary connection between the transport cost associated with discretization and the information-geometric indistinguishability of continuous probability distributions. Through the transport-information correspondence, the UCN quantify the information-theoretic cost due to discretization as the expected Kullback-Leibler divergence between nearby continuous distributions associated with the discretization geometry. In the original UCN construction, discretization is implemented by transporting the probability mass within each cell to its geometric centroid. The resulting transport-information correspondence, however, is derived under specific conditions involving the cell geometry, spatial coverage, and the vanishing-cell-scale limit. In this work, we introduce an alternative local-map discretization scheme in which the probability mass within each cell is transported to its own probability-weighted centroid. This change in the representative-point selection enables an exact expression for the transport cost of each cell in terms of the covariance matrix of its conditional probability distribution and the Fisher metric of the underlying continuous family. We establish an exact correspondence between the resulting transport cost and the expectation of the associated Fisher-induced quadratic form, without requiring uniform cell geometry, complete coverage of the sample space, or an infinitesimal cell-scale limit. The proposed construction thus generalizes the transport-information correspondence to finite-scale discretization using arbitrary collections of non-overlapping bounded convex sets.
zh_title: 精确的传输-信息对应关系用于分布自适应离散化
translation: 连续概率分布的离散化是样本空间上的一个运算，而该运算所诱导的结构通常不能仅从信息几何中确定。在我们近期关于不可避免的规范非线性（UCN）的工作中，我们建立了与离散化相关的传输成本与连续概率分布的信息几何不可区分性之间的一种非任意联系。通过传输-信息对应关系，UCN 将由于离散化引起的信息论成本量化为与离散化几何相关的邻近连续分布之间的期望 Kullback-Leibler 散度。在最初的 UCN 构建中，离散化是通过将每个单元内的概率质量传输到其几何质心来实现的。然而，由此产生的传输-信息对应关系是在涉及单元几何、空间覆盖和消失单元尺度极限的特定条件下推导出来的。在本工作中，我们引入了一种替代的局部映射离散化方案，其中每个单元内的概率质量被传输到其自身的概率加权质心。这种代表点选择的改变使得每个单元的传输成本能够以其条件概率分布的协方差矩阵以及基础连续族的 Fisher 度量来精确表示。我们建立了一个精确的对应关系，将由此产生的传输成本与相关的 Fisher 诱导二次型的期望联系起来，而无需要求均匀的单元几何、完整的空间覆盖或无穷小的单元尺度极限。因此，所提出的构造将传输-信息对应关系推广到了使用任意非重叠有界凸集集合的有限尺度离散化。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种新的局部映射离散化方案，通过将概率质量传输到概率加权的质心，实现了离散化传输成本与信息几何之间的精确对应关系，克服了先前方法的局限性，并推广到有限尺度和任意集合。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过引入概率加权质心和局部映射离散化方案，成功地将传输-信息对应关系推广到了更广泛的场景，包括有限尺度和任意形状的集合。这在信息几何和概率分布处理领域具有重要意义，尤其是在需要处理实际应用中的离散化问题时。然而，该方法在计算复杂性方面可能需要进一步评估。
motivation: 先前关于不可避免的规范非线性（UCN）的研究建立了离散化传输成本与信息几何之间的一种非任意联系，但该联系的推导受到特定条件（如单元几何、空间覆盖和消失单元尺度极限）的限制。因此，需要一种更通用的方法。
method: 提出了一种替代的局部映射离散化方案，其中每个单元内的概率质量被传输到其概率加权的质心。通过这种方法，推导出了每个单元的传输成本的精确表达式，该表达式与条件概率分布的协方差矩阵以及基础连续族的 Fisher 度量相关。
results: 实现了离散化传输成本与 Fisher 诱导二次型的期望之间的精确对应关系，无需均匀的单元几何、完整的空间覆盖或无穷小的单元尺度极限。该方法将传输-信息对应关系推广到了使用任意非重叠有界凸集集合的有限尺度离散化。
conclusion: 本研究成功地将传输-信息对应关系推广到了有限尺度离散化，并使用了任意非重叠有界凸集集合，克服了先前方法的局限性，为离散化研究提供了更精确和通用的框架。

title: Adapting Qwen3 to Tajik from 0.6B to 8B: Lower Text Loss Did Not Mean Better Understanding
authors: Tohir Saidzoda, Madina Abdusalomzoda, Nasimjon Rajabov, Akhrorkhon Ikromov, Komron Giyosiev, Abubakr Abdullozoda, Amin Jalilov, Jonibek Kishvarov, Rahmonali Sharipov, Mariyamkhon Shodyeva
abstract: Small LoRA adapters trained on Tajik news and books lowered Qwen3's Tajik text loss at every size we tried, from 0.6B to 8B, by 0.60 to 1.45 nats per token, but none of them improved Tajik reading comprehension where it can be measured. On Belebele the 1.7B and 8B adapters left accuracy unchanged and the 4B adapter lowered it by 3.7 points; at 0.6B the score rose by 4.2 points but sits near chance and coincides with a change in which answer letter the model prefers, so we do not read it as understanding. At 8B, continued pretraining on about 375 million tokens of raw Tajik text was followed by a Belebele gain of 9.9 points. After a further supervised fine-tuning stage, our main model, e3, is 11.4 points above Qwen3-8B on Belebele; its English MMLU changed by -1.2 points, and a loss larger than 3.3 points is excluded. The same heavy recipe applied to Qwen3-0.6B-Base brought its text loss close to that of the 8B model after books-only pretraining, while its multiple-choice answers stayed near chance and its English MMLU fell by 7.6 points. We report 15 trained models and their 5 starting models from June to October 2025, scored in 2026 on one harness with paired intervals, and we report what went wrong: lost training records, a thinking-mode dataset with almost no reasoning in it, later branches whose training data was never documented, and a 4-bit release that contains no transformer layers.

title: ProcessPrefBench: Evaluating Cross-Task Transfer of Individual Process Preferences from Naturalistic Human-AI Interaction
authors: Yiwen Yang, Guanming Liu
abstract: In natural human-AI dialogue, users' corrections, requests, and self-descriptions carry reusable signals about how they want work to be done. These signals reveal individual process preferences, user-specific standards for evidence, depth, analytical focus, procedure, and delivery. We ask whether a preference revealed in one dialogue can shape an assistant's later answer when the task does not restate it. ProcessPrefBench uses three months of natural dialogues from two knowledge workers to build 66 source-target cases separately judged for source evidence and target applicability. Sources are preselected, so the benchmark tests application rather than retrieval. We test three models with target-only, full-history, and distilled-preference prompts. Target-specific 0-2 rubrics score preference realization, and a task gate flags severe failures. Compared with target-only prompting, full-history and imperative distilled-preference prompting raise preference realization by 0.204 and 0.244 points on the 0-2 scale, respectively, with no reliable advantage from distillation. Fabricated-evidence failures rise from 5.8% under target-only prompting to 10.1% under full-history and 10.4% under imperative prompting. ProcessPrefBench highlights a tension in learning from dialogue, where drawing on prior interactions can improve preference realization yet also invite fabricated evidence. We hope it helps build assistants that honor a user's process preferences without sacrificing factual reliability.
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Published at LM Playschool 2026 (EMNLP 2026 workshop)

title: PRISM-AMC: Replay-Free Continual Learning for Automatic Modulation Classification
authors: Usman Akram, Matthew Graham, Haris Vikalo
abstract: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) is a key component of cognitive wireless systems, enabling spectrum awareness and adaptive communication. Most deep learning approaches to AMC assume a fixed set of modulation classes and access to previously observed training data. In practice, modulation classes and channel conditions may evolve over time, while storage or data-retention constraints may preclude replay of raw baseband I/Q samples. We propose PRISM-AMC, a replay-free continual learning framework that mitigates catastrophic forgetting by preserving task-relevant subspaces of intermediate representations via gradient projection memory. We further analyze projected stochastic-gradient updates under an SNR-dependent gradient-noise model. PRISM-AMC is evaluated in both class-incremental and domain-incremental settings. Experiments on the MIGOU and DeepSig 2018.01A datasets show substantially reduced forgetting relative to sequential fine-tuning and elastic weight consolidation, while remaining competitive with or outperforming replay-based RSD-AMC in class-incremental settings, without storing raw I/Q samples.

title: Learning From Static Context in Federated Time Series Forecasting
authors: Viktor Walter, Andreas Wagner, Fabian Stricker
abstract: Time series forecasting is shifting from locally trained, per-series models to global models trained across many heterogeneous series, which requires learning what sets the series apart. When the raw data cannot be centralized, such a global model is trained with federated learning (FL), one client per data owner. State-of-the-art forecasters such as the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) tell series apart through a static input that describes each series and does not change over time. In the special case of a federated setting where each client holds a single series, this static input is constant within each client and varies only across clients. We ask whether a federated TFT can learn from it. Per-batch FedAdam, which aggregates gradients after every batch, uses the static input almost as well as central training, whereas communication-efficient schemes with local epochs (FedAvg, FedAdam+Prox) extract far less from it and gain nothing significant on either application dataset. At the same local computation, an Adam-compatible SCAFFOLD keeps the static pathway responsive on wind power and gains significantly there. On building energy its error still drops, but the static pathway falls silent, so drift and communication frequency cannot be fully separated as the cause. Only per-batch FedAdam matches or beats the per-client local models across all datasets. We confirm the effect on building-energy meter data, a wind-power dataset, and a controlled synthetic dataset. The loss is not specific to the TFT: on the synthetic and the wind data two further architectures with different static-conditioning mechanisms show it as well.
comment: 4th IEEE International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2026)

title: Fluidic Body: Swarm Robots as a Fluid Extension of the Hand
authors: Michikuni Eguchi, Shigeo Yoshida, Mai Nishimura, Takefumi Hiraki
abstract: Swarm robots have attracted growing interest as a physical interface for human--computer interaction, since a swarm can reshape its formation to fit the objects and surroundings it works with. For a human operator, however, adapting the swarm's behavior remains difficult. Most existing methods require the user to specify where the swarm should go, and they offer no intuitive way to change the collective's behavior as each task demands. We present Fluidic Body, a system that lets a person operate a swarm of fluid-imitating robots as an extension of the hand. The system places a virtual fluid between the hand and the swarm, and the user adapts the swarm's behavior to each task by changing the fluid's properties through simple hand movements. When the user opens the hand, the swarm becomes soft enough to deform and flow around obstacles. Closing the hand turns it into a hard, cohesive body that can push objects. We evaluated the controller's performance and its operability in two simulation experiments and one demonstration with physical robots. First, our controller handled both obstacle avoidance and object transportation better than an existing method that behaves the same way in every task. Second, in a VR user study, 17 participants completed the combined avoidance-and-transportation task faster and more reliably than with that method. They also reported a lower workload and a stronger sense of agency. Finally, this experience carried over to physical robots in a real-world demonstration (88 participants). These results suggest that treating a swarm as a fluid, a material people already understand, allows a robot swarm to work as a deformable extension of the human body.
comment: accepted to ACM ISS 2026 (ISS track of PACMHCI)

title: SynMOE: A Syntax-Aware MOE-Guided Approach for PEFT-Based Code Intelligence Learning
authors: Shuo Liu, Hao Ning, Jacky Keung, Zhen Yang, Xiao Yu, Xing Hu, Yicheng Sun
abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has emerged as an important approach for adapting Language Models (LMs) in downstream tasks. However, in the domain of code intelligence, the performance of most PEFT methods relatively drops compared to Full fine-Tuning (FT), hindering their broader applicability. One of the main reasons is that current PEFT methods are generally based on assumptions about the low-rank nature or sparsity of parameter updates, lacking explicit modeling of code-related information. To tackle this limitation, we propose SynMOE, a syntax-aware MOE-guided approach for PEFT on code intelligence learning. Specifically, SynMOE contains two stages: syntactic information extraction and syntax-aware MOE-guided adaptation. It first obtains the syntactic labels of source code from Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs), and then aligns the labels with the input tokens of code LMs. In the second stage, syntactic labels are integrated into the MOE module, participating in the routing decision of MOE for a more powerful syntactic-aware token representation. We evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approach by applying it to two typical PEFT methods, LoRA and $(IA)^3$, across three diverse code intelligence tasks. Experimental results show that SynMOE achieves consistent and significant improvements. Even compared to FT, SynMOE achieves comparable or superior performance while being more computationally efficient. In addition, we also conduct ablation studies, hyperparameter analysis, and evaluation in the low-resource scenario to provide a comprehensive investigation of the proposed approach.

title: Offline Learning of Reserve Prices from Censored Bids
authors: Lavanya Marla, Yunzong Xu, Boxuan Zhou
abstract: We study how a seller can learn a reserve price for a second-price auction from censored historical bid data. Because values below past reserves are unobserved, even unlimited data may not reveal which reserve earns the most revenue. Under a monotone hazard rate (MHR) assumption, we characterize exactly when an optimal reserve is identified, even though the value distribution may not be: either revenue has not yet begun to fall at the lowest historical reserve, so the best reserve lies among the observed bids, or the censored fraction is as large as MHR allows, which pins down the entire distribution. When identification fails, we derive the reserve that minimizes worst-case revenue regret over distributions consistent with the data, and prove that this unique minimax reserve and its regret depend on just two observable quantities: the censored fraction and the hazard just above the lowest historical reserve. With $N$ historical bidders, the optimal reserve is learned with expected worst-case regret $O(N^{-1/2})$ when it lies among the observed bids, and $O(N^{-1})$ from the censored count alone when the censored fraction is as large as MHR allows and the optimum lies at or below the lowest reserve. In the nonidentifiable regime, plugging estimates of the two quantities into the minimax reserve gives expected worst-case regret within $O(N^{-2/5})$ of the population minimum under local density smoothness, with a matching minimax lower bound on a smooth class. Beyond MHR, we solve the minimax problem for regular and unrestricted distributions and prove an $O(N^{-2/5})$ learning bound in the regular nonidentifiable regime, given known bounds on the boundary parameters. Experiments on synthetic and eBay data show gains from exploiting MHR and the benefits of the robust rule when parametric models are misspecified.
comment: 87 pages, 12 figures, 25 tables. Authors listed alphabetically

title: RouTex: Multi-reference 3D Texture Generation by Reprogramming Rotary Position Encoding
authors: Chengyang Li, Yang Liu, Jiale Zhang, Qiang Rao, Wei Zhang, Taicheng Huang
abstract: While single-image 3D texture generation has advanced significantly, conditioning texture synthesis on multi-view reference images remains largely under-explored, despite its necessity for resolving surface ambiguity in unobserved regions. In this paper, we propose RouTex, a novel multi-reference 3D texture generation framework based on in-context Diffusion Transformers (DiT). Our key insight is that native 3D Rotary Position Encoding (RoPE) inherently possesses spatial addressing capabilities. We introduce Positional Routing (PR) to reprogram 3D RoPE along spatial and semantic dimensions, establishing explicit reference-to-view correspondence without introducing additional parameters. To execute this routing efficiently, Dual-Granularity Attention (DGA) combines per-view local attention for fine texture fidelity with global joint attention over deduplicated references for cross-view consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RouTex achieves new state-of-the-art performance in multi-reference 3D texture generation.

title: File-Semantic SSD for I/O-centric Architectures with NFS-over-NVMe Protocol
authors: Kyu-Jin Cho, Injae Kang, Keunsan Park, Jaehoon Shim, Munsung Bae, Jiho Jeon, Eyee Hyun Nam, Jin-Soo Kim
abstract: Emerging I/O-centric architectures empower peripheral devices to access storage directly while bypassing the host CPU and kernel. However, SSDs expose only a block interface and rely on the host filesystem for file metadata and access control, making file-level access for applications and peripheral devices inherently difficult in I/O-centric architectures. This tight coupling between the host filesystem and storage device introduces unavoidable software overhead and limits the potential of fully hostless I/O paths. In this paper, we present File-Semantic SSD (FS-SSD), a new SSD architecture that provides a native file abstraction within SSDs, enabling direct file access by peripheral and remote devices without host intervention. FS-SSD adopts the lightweight, stateless NFS interface and introduces NFS-over-NVMe, a protocol extension that embeds NFS operations into the standard NVMe command structure. This allows FS-SSD to support local and remote file I/O through existing PCIe and NVMe-oF transports. Our evaluation shows that FS-SSD provides on-device file abstraction while fully utilizing raw-device bandwidth in I/O-centric architectures.

title: UniCompress: From Multi-LoRA Experts to One Compact Model for Edge Intelligence
authors: Mingkang Liu, Peipei Jiao, Weiming Meng, Tianyuan Liu, Lichen Pang, Junyan Li
abstract: Embodied and edge systems increasingly rely on vision-language models (VLMs) to support heterogeneous skills, yet deploying a separate task adapter for each skill while retaining a high-precision backbone creates substantial memory and management costs. We present UniCompress, a deployment-oriented framework that converts multi-task expertise into one compact, adapter-free model. Starting from a consolidated BF16 Qwen3-VL-4B teacher, UniCompress constructs an asymmetric INT2 student using GPTQ initialization and teacher-guided quantization recovery. The approach jointly quantizes and recovers the projection weights in the vision encoder and language backbone, enabling aggressive compression of the complete vision-language model while preserving its multi-task behavior. We evaluate UniCompress on four heterogeneous embodied tasks: posture recognition, household-safety understanding, multimodal dialogue routing, and mobile-GUI action prediction. UniCompress reduces the approximate weight storage from 8.9 GB in BF16 to 2.1 GB in INT2, corresponding to a reduction of approximately 76%. It improves the INT2 macro task score by 34.3 percentage points over GPTQ-INT2 while remaining within 0.9 points of the consolidated BF16 teacher. These results demonstrate the potential of teacher-guided joint vision-language INT2 recovery for deploying a single multi-skill VLM on resource-constrained embodied platforms.

title: Which One Is Sounding? Binaural Sounding Instance Disambiguation for Audio-Visual Segmentation
authors: Haoze Ma, Yidi Li, Yu Ma, Pengyuan Zhao, Yi Shi, Bin Ren, Yanwen Guo, Dimitrios Kanoulas
abstract: Existing audio-visual segmentation methods mainly predict sound-related regions or category masks and often fail to identify the sounding instance when multiple same-class candidates coexist. Recent audio-visual instance segmentation methods address instance-level prediction but rely largely on motion and cross-frame association, which may become unreliable under sparse observations or inconspicuous motion. To this end, we introduce binaural audio, whose interaural differences encode source-direction information, to provide spatial constraints for distinguishing the sounding instance among same-class visual candidates. We propose Binaural Sounding Instance Disambiguation for Audio-Visual Segmentation (BiSID-AVS), which progressively refines category-level candidate responses into a mask of the true sounding instance. BiSID-AVS first grounds category-consistent candidate regions through audio prompting, then projects binaural cues into an image-plane spatial response map, and finally refines the true sounding instance through dual-level spatial conditioning at the feature and decoder levels. Experiments on the binaurally extended AVS-Synthetic benchmark and Habitat-AVS dataset for robotic indoor perception show that BiSID-AVS achieves the best performance on the multi-candidate subsets, improving instance-level mIoU by 35.19 and 41.21 percentage points, respectively, while substantially reducing false activation on non-sounding same-class regions.

title: Breaking the One-Player Extension Barrier: History-Aware Repair for Multiplayer Approximate Nash Equilibria
authors: Jinqi Tang, Shihong Ding, Cong Fang
abstract: Computation of Nash equilibria is a central problem in algorithmic game theory, yet exact equilibrium computation is $\mathsf{PPAD}$-complete even for two-player games. This hardness motivates the study of polynomial-time algorithms for approximate Nash equilibria. While substantial progress has been made for two-player and three-player games, existing algorithms for general $m$-player games have largely relied on repeatedly applying one-player extension starting from improved fixed-player algorithms. Such improvements can at best strengthen the classical $1-1/m$ guarantee to $1-1/(m-c)$, for some constant $c$ independent of $m$. We break this long-standing barrier by developing an iterative algorithm that directly tackles general $m$-player games and achieves a $(1-(σ_{\star}-ε)/m)$-approximation for fixed $ε> 0$ and sufficiently large $m$, where $σ_\star\approx1.5867$ is the unique root in $(1,2)$ of $σ_\star^3-19σ_\star^2+27σ_\star+1=0$.
