title: Do Agentic Policies Need to Look at Every Step? Geometric Abstraction for Reasoning and Action
authors: Yihang Liu, Yiming Chen, Mingzhe Zheng
abstract: Recent multimodal language models can reason directly about robot scenes, but it is unclear whether they need to repeatedly reinterpret raw visual observations at every step of an interaction. We propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through a 3D geometric abstraction that is refreshed locally from observations and read directly by the language models. Specifically, our interface represents scene geometry via typed, evidence-aware symbolic references to object parts, grounds them from calibrated RGB-D, and returns compact textual checkpoints with metric residuals after each action. Symbolic task structure can thus be reused across decisions while metric values are rebound to the current scene, with direct visual reasoning invoked only on demand. Across offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, reasoning over grounded text and symbols improves multi-step manipulation completion while substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries, positioning explicit geometric state as an effective substrate for agentic robot policies.
comment: Accepted to the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Agentic Robotics. 13 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://geometric-abstraction.github.io

title: Semi-Streaming Reachability and Shortest Paths in $n^{1/3+o(1)}$ Passes
authors: Gary Hoppenworth, George Z. Li, Sepideh Mahabadi, Jakub Tarnawski
abstract:
In the semi-streaming model, the edges of an $n$-vertex graph arrive in a stream, and an algorithm makes multiple passes over that stream while using only $\widetilde{O}(n)$ space. The number of passes needed to compute single-source reachability in directed graphs is a long-standing open question in streaming algorithms, going back to Henzinger, Raghavan, and Rajagopalan (1998). The best known semi-streaming algorithm uses $n^{1/2+o(1)}$ passes due to Jambulapati, Liu, and Sidford (2019), while the best lower bound is $Ω(\log n/\log\log n)$ passes due to Guruswami and Onak (2016).
  We give streaming algorithms for computing single-source reachability and shortest paths on $n$-vertex directed graphs using $\widetilde{O}(n)$ space and $n^{1/3+o(1)}$ passes. Our algorithms are based on implicit hopsets, which are large hopsets that can be represented implicitly in $\widetilde{O}(n)$ space. We introduce this notion and give new constructions for implicit hopsets with small hopbound. Along the way, we obtain new work-depth tradeoffs for parallel shortest paths in directed graphs, improving the recent result of Ashvinkumar, Bernstein, Probst Gutenberg, and Saranurak (2026).

title: Rank-metric intersecting codes
authors: Martino Borello, Martin Scotti, Lune Vila
abstract:
Intersecting codes are codes in which any two nonzero codewords share a common nonzero coordinate, and they have been extensively studied due to their applications in communication theory, cryptography, and combinatorics. Recently, geometric interpretations have provided new insights into intersecting codes, both in the Hamming metric and, more recently, in the rank metric for linear codes.
  In this paper, we introduce and study matrix rank-metric intersecting codes. By defining the support of a matrix as its row space, we extend the notion of intersecting codes to the matrix rank-metric setting. Using the slice space associated with the generator tensor of a rank-metric code, we derive a geometric characterization that is equivalent to the intersecting property. This characterization generalizes the known results for linear rank-metric intersecting codes and highlights both analogies and differences with the linear case. In particular, it yields bounds on the parameters of intersecting codes, one of which is sharp and differs from the one in the linear case, together with first constructions. We then consider codes that are closed under multiplication, i.e. matrix algebras. In this setting, the intersecting property can be read off from the algebraic structure, namely the Jacobson radical and the socle. This provides a simple and flexible way to construct many intersecting codes, including codes that do not satisfy the classical sufficient condition on the minimum distance.

title: Equal Access, Unequal Gains? GitHub Copilot and Productivity Among Developers with Disabilities
authors: Emeralda Sesari, Daria Ana-Maria Mogoş, Federica Sarro, Ayushi Rastogi
abstract: Generative AI tools are increasingly used in software development and have been associated with benefits such as faster task completion and improved perceived productivity. However, whether these benefits extend across different developer populations remains unclear. This is especially relevant for developers with disabilities, whose work can already be impacted by accessibility barriers. Yet, evidence remains limited across a broader range of disability groups. This study investigates whether the wider availability of GitHub Copilot is associated with changes in productivity among GitHub users who self-identify as having a disability. Using publicly available profile and repository data, we curated a dataset of 199 developers across multiple disability groups and compared their activity before and after GitHub Copilot became freely available. We found that most disability groups showed a descriptive pattern of fewer commits but more code modified. In several disability groups, the distribution of developers across commit activity levels shifted toward both lower and higher level, leaving fewer developers at moderate level. However, we found no evidence that changes in commits or net lines modified differed across disability groups. These findings suggest that the wider availability of GitHub Copilot cannot be associated with a broad increase or decrease in observable development activity, while patterns of change varied across developers and disability groups.

title: VIGOR: Visual Gain Ordering for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
authors: Junzhe Chen, Tian Qin, Eugenie Shi, Tianshu Zhang, Qiang Ju, Lijie Wen
abstract: Multimodal discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate responses through iterative mask prediction and offer a promising alternative to autoregressive large vision-language models. However, they still suffer from hallucination, producing outputs that are plausible under language priors but insufficiently grounded in the image. We argue that hallucination in multimodal dLLMs is not only a token prediction problem, but also a premature commitment problem: during iterative denoising, some masked positions are unmasked too early because their confidence is driven more by language priors than by visual evidence, and these early commitments can bias later generation. To address this issue, we propose Visual Gain Ordering (VIGOR), a training-free and plug-and-play inference strategy that reorders masked positions according to counterfactual visual evidence. At each denoising step, VIGOR compares the confidence of each candidate token under the original image-conditioned pass and an additional visual-ablation pass, and prioritizes positions whose predictions are more strongly supported by the image. Experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO show that VIGOR consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning performance across benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/THU-BPM/Vigor.

title: FloMo: 3D Scene Flow as a World Action Model Intermediate for Learning from Human Video
authors: Jeremy Collins, Namra Patel, Ayush Agarwal, Shitij Govil, Animesh Garg
abstract: Pretrained video generation models distill internet-scale motion priors into robot policies, but full video is a redundant signal for action prediction. We argue that dense 3D motion is the medium through which video pretraining best transfers to robot actions, and that predicting motion rather than video affords better sample-efficiency for action prediction. FloMo is a 5B video-generation model fine-tuned to predict 3D scene-flow and action tokens. Rendering scene flow as RGB and encoding it into the same latent space as video enables a pretrained video generation backbone to efficiently adapt to predict 3D scene flow. Co-trained on action-free human video and action-labeled robot teleoperation data, our model benefits from human-video pretraining and generalizes to unseen objects, motion primitives, and tasks. Replacing motion prediction with a video prediction objective degrades out-of-distribution generalization, while adding a video prediction target alongside motion lowers policy success rather than improving it. When motion, video, and action are predicted jointly, action tokens attend far more to motion than to video, suggesting that predicting video wastes model capacity. Together, these results indicate that motion effectively mediates the transfer from video pretraining to action. More information can be found at flomo-wam.github.io.

title: Process-zone condensation: a discretization-exact reduced cell model for FE$^2$ analysis of composites with fibre-matrix debonding and matrix plasticity
authors: Leonilson Toffoli Pedrini, Maycoln Conci, Rafael Marin Ferro
abstract: Periodic composites with cohesive interfaces and matrix plasticity require nonlinear cell solutions in multiscale analysis. Process-zone condensation eliminates the linear elastic remainder of the cell by a Schur complement, retaining all interfacial and process-zone internal variables. Influence matrices recover macroscopic stress and consistent tangent. One back-substitution per increment checks that the matrix outside the retained zone remains elastic. While this holds, the reduction is exact relative to the full discretisation, also with a plastic matrix, and requires no training. In an E-glass/epoxy cell, eight of nine two-dimensional paths agree with the full cell to 1e-11 in stress and tangent; the check flags the ninth. Three paths on each of two three-dimensional meshes need zone expansion. Excluding setup and checks, two-dimensional path timings show an aggregate speed-up of 3.3; certified three-dimensional zones show none. In adaptive finite element squared (FE$^2$) simulations of a perforated plate, the reduced solver reproduces the full-cell response within solver tolerances, 1.51 times faster for glass/polypropylene and slower for glass/epoxy. Independent Ansys models agree to below 1e-3 in cell stress and about 0.6% in plate reactions, although local damage and plasticity onsets differ. The advantage depends on zone size, active set and adaptation costs.
comment: 27 pages, 19 figures, 17 tables; 9-page supplementary material appended. Submitted to Composite Structures. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23512947

title: Dataset Recommendation for Heterogeneous and Dynamic Scholarly Graphs via Multimodal Representation Learning
authors: Ornella Irrera, Matteo Lissandrini, Daniele Dell'Aglio, Gianmaria Silvello
abstract: Researchers struggle to find relevant datasets amid the growing volume of data across repositories and scholarly publications. Manual dataset retrieval is time-consuming and often fails to identify valuable resources that are not easily discoverable through direct links or popularity metrics. Dataset recommendation, which aims to identify datasets relevant to a paper, author, or query, has become essential for improving dataset discoverability and reuse. However, this task remains challenging because Scholarly Knowledge Graphs (SKGs) are large-scale, heterogeneous, dynamic, and incomplete. Although openly available SKGs organize scientific knowledge by linking scholarly outcomes, they often lack meaningful connections between datasets, leaving them isolated and underutilized. These graphs contain millions of evolving relations but still suffer from missing or inaccurate metadata, duplicate records, and weak dataset integration. This work presents the Multimodal Scholarly Attention Network (MM-SAN), a heterogeneous multimodal graph representation learning method for recommending datasets relevant to research publications within real-world SKGs. MM-SAN combines topology-aware and text-based embeddings, enabling effective recommendations even when textual metadata is limited or absent. It operates in transductive, semi-inductive, and fully inductive settings, adapting to evolving SKGs without requiring retraining. Experiments show that MM-SAN outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing a robust and scalable solution for dataset recommendation.

title: Trajectory Evaluation via Rollout-Free World Model for End-to-end Autonomous Driving
authors: Junzhe Wang, Jinqing Zhang, Qingjie Liu
abstract: Although existing candidate trajectory evaluators have substantially improved end-to-end planning accuracy, their underlying mechanism remains suboptimal. Model-based evaluators typically make scoring future-aware by explicitly predicting candidate-conditioned future states over the planning horizon, which we term rollout. However, rollout incurs high inference cost and accumulates prediction errors. We argue that planning does not require reconstructing a full future scene for each candidate, but only future-relevant information for reliable comparison. We therefore propose RFWorld, a Rollout-Free World model for end-to-end trajectory evaluation. RFWorld constructs a shared scene memory and shapes it into a future-readable representation via lightweight training-time temporal readout with semantic supervision, keeping training overhead low. At inference time, candidate trajectories directly query the shared memory via sparse spatial readout for scoring, reducing computation by roughly the planning horizon times the number of candidate trajectories, while avoiding recursive rollout errors. Experiments on NAVSIM and Bench2Drive show that RFWorld learns a more planning-aligned world representation and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

title: Graph-Based Dynamic Activity Prediction for Real-Time Power System Applications
authors: Stefanos Eleftheriadis, Mohammad Hashemnezhad, Savvas Panagi, Thibaut Vermeulen, Petros Aristidou
abstract: Online dynamic security assessment and day-ahead planning require rapid identification of where disturbances will produce significant dynamic activity. Full time-domain simulations are computationally demanding, while existing machine-learning approaches predict system-level outcomes or require post-disturbance trajectories. This paper proposes a pair-aware Graph Isomorphism Network with Edge features (GINE) framework comprising two task-specific models for predicting bus-voltage and generator apparent-power activity from the operating point and contingency description. Physically aware KPI cuts convert simulated responses into ordinal activity targets for model training. Evaluations on Nordic 32 and the French transmission system with more than 6 000 buses show that pair-aware fusion and graph embeddings improve on a local baseline on Nordic 32, with GINE the lower-cost graph encoder, and that the framework remains effective at large scale. As a downstream application, the predicted activity maps guide Adaptive Model Simplification, reducing continuous and discrete model variables by 72% and 66%, achieving speedups of up to 3.16x, and preserving voltage trajectories when critical substations are retained. These results demonstrate scalable, pre-disturbance prediction of component-level dynamic activity.

title: Nested Field-of-View Barriers for Teleoperated Multi-Robot Relay Chains
authors: Arthur Vangasse, Theo Cruz, Thales Soares, André Cid, Vinícius Gonçalves, Gustavo Freitas, Luciano Pimenta
abstract: Teleoperation of mobile robots in communication-denied environments requires maintaining a communication link while allowing the operator to maneuver freely. We propose a shared-autonomy framework in which a teleoperated leader is followed by a chain of autonomous robots that relays a line of sight to a fixed base station, a geometric proxy for the link. Connectivity is enforced geometrically through visibility-based Control Barrier Functions (CBFs), with each agent computing its control input locally through a quadratic program. A strict visibility constraint guarantees connectivity, but a follower with no independent motion objective remains stationary, stalling the leader at the boundary of the safe set. Relaxing it preserves mobility at the cost of the guarantee. Our framework resolves this conflict through nested hard-soft visibility constraints: a full field-of-view (FoV) constraint enforced strictly to guarantee connectivity and a contracted FoV constraint imposed on each follower as a relaxed behavioral objective that drives it inward before the connectivity boundary is reached. We prove feasibility of the local quadratic programs and forward invariance of the connected, collision-free set under the resulting distributed controller. The contraction parameter shapes follower behavior without affecting the guarantee, which follows from the strict constraint alone. The framework is evaluated in confined and cluttered environments on two simulated systems: a kinematic integrator and software-in-the-loop Crazyflie quadrotors. Compared with a baseline tuned to reach the goal in comparable time, the framework keeps the links far closer to the connected set and moves the followers less.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Submitted to the American Control Conference (ACC)

title: Toward Constant-Factor Maximin Share Guarantees for Subadditive Valuations
authors: Bo Li, Ankang Sun
abstract:
For $n$ agents and $m$ indivisible goods, an agent's maximin share (MMS) is the largest minimum bundle value she can obtain by partitioning the goods into $n$ bundles. Constant MMS approximations are known for additive, submodular, or XOS valuations, but whether such a guarantee exists for general subadditive valuations remains open. We advance this question in two directions. For general subadditive valuations, we exponentially improve the guarantee from $Ω(1/\log\log n)$ to $Ω(1/\log^* n)$, where $\log^* n$ is the iterated logarithm. We then seek constant MMS guarantees under additional structure on subadditive valuations by studying $q$-partitioning valuations: every partition of a bundle into at most $q$ groups admits nonnegative group prices that sum to the bundle's value and whose sum on any collection of groups is at most the value of their union. This hierarchy ranges from subadditivity at $q=2$ to XOS for $q\ge m$. We give the first study of MMS in the intermediate classes and prove constant guarantees whenever $q/n$ has a fixed positive lower bound, including $1/6$ for $q\ge n$ and $1/4$ for $q\ge2n$. For XOS valuations, we further improve the universal guarantee from $4/17\approx 0.2353$ to $5/16=0.3125$.
  For subadditive valuations, we prove a bidding amplification theorem that gives an exponential bound on each agent's probability of receiving less than half her MMS, while satisfying her budget in every outcome. For $q$-partitioning valuations, we give a scalar criterion that converts bounds on the value lost from disjoint deletions within a bundle into bounds on potential losses, even when an agent contributes zero below the target bundle value. For XOS valuations, we prove a reservation theorem that selects goods for integral assignment together with auxiliary additive valuations and accounts for the loss in rounding.

title: Finding Hypercliques Faster Than Brute Force
authors: Josh Alman, Baitian Li, Neha Pant, Kevin Pratt, Ryan Williams
abstract:
We show that for any fixed $k$, there exists $\varepsilon_k > 0$ such that, given a $(k-1)$-uniform hypergraph $H$ on $n$ vertices, one can count the number of $k$-hypercliques in $H$ in $O(n^{k-\varepsilon_k})$ time. This refutes the hyperclique conjecture of Lincoln, Vassilevska Williams, and Williams (SODA 2018). Our result follows from the uniform construction of a family of arithmetic circuits of size $O(n^{k-\varepsilon_k})$ for the $k$-hyperclique tensor, a natural higher-order generalization of the matrix multiplication tensor.
  We obtain two corollaries. First, for every $k$, there exists $\varepsilon > 0$ such that Max-$k$SAT can be solved in $2^{(1-\varepsilon)n} \cdot \mathrm{poly}(m,n)$ time. Second, for every $k$, there exists $\varepsilon > 0$ such that arithmetic progressions of length $k$ in subsets of $\{0,1,\ldots,n\}$ can be detected in $n^{2-\varepsilon}$ time. Both corollaries refute other prominent conjectures in the literature.

title: CRONOS: Benchmarking Non-Episodic Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
authors: Po-Yi Wu, Djengo Cyun-Jyun Fang, Dian Cheng, Tsung-Wei Ke
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is promising for adapting robot policies to unstructured real-world environments. However, standard RL pipelines rely on episodic training with frequent scene resets, which is impractical for real-world deployment due to the need for substantial human intervention. While prior work has studied non-episodic RL in relatively small policies trained from scratch, its behavior when fine-tuning modern large-scale pre-trained vision-language-action (VLA) models remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce CRONOS, a simulation benchmark for RL fine-tuning of VLAs under non-episodic scene resets. CRONOS leverages high-fidelity physics simulators and adopts shared-scene multi-task settings. Using CRONOS, we show that naively fine-tuning pre-trained policies fails in non-episodic settings due to shifts in object configurations and end-effector poses; however, these challenges can be mitigated through targeted reset allocation and by addressing biases in pre-trained models. Moreover, we find that non-episodic training enhances long-horizon manipulation and improves generalization to previously unseen object configurations and task sequences. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/cronos/

title: Characterizing Serverless Workloads: A Large-Scale Analysis of Function-as-a-Service Platforms
authors: Saman Akbari, Yassine Lazreg, Mohammadreza Malekabbasi, Manfred Hauswirth
abstract: Serverless computing is a popular approach to application deployment without having to manage the underlying infrastructure. Its most common implementation is Function-as-a-Service (FaaS), in which applications are structured as fine-grained functions. FaaS providers face non-trivial tasks in the management of their platforms, including cold starts, auto-scaling, and scheduling. The design of optimized platforms requires an accurate understanding of realistic serverless workloads. However, existing research and platforms rely on insights from single, often outdated datasets. In this work, we conduct a large-scale, cross-platform comparative analysis of eight publicly available FaaS workload traces from major cloud providers (Alibaba, Azure, Huawei, IBM) and a scientific computing platform (Globus). We provide a comprehensive and up-to-date view of the serverless ecosystem by characterizing key dimensions such as invocation patterns, latency, cold start behavior, and resource utilization. Our analysis shows that although invocation patterns remain universal, execution times have shortened, shifting the performance bottleneck toward platform scheduling and dependency management. We also observe an architectural shift toward "Serverless 2.0" models, where concurrent, long-lived containers are increasingly utilized to bypass cold start penalties. Furthermore, we found resource over-provisioning and extreme skew in user request volumes. These findings provide actionable insights for designing more efficient FaaS platforms, informing improved approaches to targeted cold start mitigation, predictive resource management, and dependency-aware scheduling.

title: Enabling risk and reliability analysis in next-generation computational tools via multifidelity methods
authors: Anirban Chaudhuri, Karen Willcox
abstract: Risk and reliability analysis are fundamental to the design, assessment, and operation of safety-critical complex systems; however, their integration into next-generation computational tools is constrained by the cost of uncertainty quantification with expensive computational models. The computational challenge is particularly prohibitive for tail-sensitive quantities, such as probabilities of failure, conditional values-at-risk, and buffered probabilities of failure, where accurate estimation can require a large number of model evaluations. Multifidelity methods provide a framework for addressing this computational bottleneck by combining information from models of varying accuracy and cost while retaining the predictive accuracy of the high-fidelity model. This review summarizes the state of the art in methods that enable scalable risk and reliability analysis using multifidelity control variates, multifidelity importance sampling, and multifidelity active learning.
zh_title: 通过多保真度方法在下一代计算工具中实现风险与可靠性分析
translation: 风险与可靠性分析是安全攸关复杂系统的设计、评估和运行的基础；然而，使用昂贵计算模型进行不确定性量化的成本限制了它们在下一代计算工具中的集成。对于诸如失效概率、条件风险价值和缓冲失效概率等尾部敏感量，精确估计可能需要大量的模型评估，这一计算挑战尤为严峻。多保真度方法通过结合不同精度和成本的模型信息，同时保持高保真模型的预测精度，为解决这一计算瓶颈提供了一个框架。本综述总结了利用多保真度控制变量、多保真度重要性采样和多保真度主动学习来实现可扩展风险与可靠性分析的最新进展。
tldr: 本文总结了基于多保真度控制变量、重要性采样和主动学习等方法，以低计算成本实现复杂系统可扩展风险与可靠性分析的最新研究进展。
ai_comments: 本篇综述紧扣安全攸关系统设计中的核心计算瓶颈，针对尾部敏感风险指标计算开销大的痛点，系统梳理了结合控制变量、重要性采样和主动学习的多保真度解决方案，对发展下一代高效工程仿真计算工具具有重要理论与应用指导价值；但摘要未提供具体工程案例或不同多保真度策略性能对比的量化细节。
motivation: 风险与可靠性分析对安全攸关系统至关重要，但由于昂贵计算模型的不确定性量化成本极高，尤其是失效概率、条件风险价值等尾部敏感量的精确估计需要海量模型评估，严重制约了其在下一代计算工具中的集成与应用。
method: 综述了利用多保真度控制变量法（multifidelity control variates）、多保真度重要性采样（multifidelity importance sampling）和多保真度主动学习（multifidelity active learning），通过融合不同精度与成本的模型信息，在保持高保真模型精度的同时降低评估开销。
results: 摘要未提及（本文为综述文章，总结了实现可扩展风险与可靠性分析的最新多保真度方法前沿进展，未提供具体实验结果）。
conclusion: 多保真度方法为解决昂贵计算模型带来的瓶颈问题提供了有效框架，能够赋能下一代计算工具实现高效、可扩展的风险与可靠性分析。

title: Manifold Embedding of Deep Image Features for Image Matching via Neural Adjoint Maps
authors: Nafie El Amrani, Moritz Heep, Florian Bernard
abstract: Estimating semantic correspondences between different object instances of similar categories in real-world images is a fundamental challenge in computer vision. While the recent progress in foundation models has significantly advanced solutions for such difficult image correspondence problems, respective methods are often insufficiently regularised. For example, common nearest-neighbour matching with foundation model features often results in noisy correspondences, which is particularly prominent when solving for dense correspondences. In this work, we tackle image matching via functional maps, which have been popularised for 3D shape matching due to their powerful spectral formalism utilising an efficient low-dimensional linear representation. However, functional maps require that domains (in our cases the rectangular image grids) are equipped with an informative and non-trivial geometry. To define a meaningful manifold structure for images, we use Galerkin's method from finite elements to derive a discrete Laplace-Beltrami operator (LBO) based on a manifold embedding of deep image features. Further, we leverage a neural adjoint map that allows to represent non-linear mappings. We demonstrate that our method sets the new state of the art among zero-shot image correspondence methods on multiple dense correspondence benchmarks of real-world images. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/NafieAmrani/NAMI
zh_title: 通过神经伴随映射实现深度图像特征流形嵌入的图像匹配
translation: 估计真实世界图像中相似类别不同对象实例之间的语义对应关系是计算机视觉领域的一项基本挑战。虽然基础模型的最新进展显著推进了这类复杂图像对应问题的解决，但现有方法通常缺乏足够的正则化。例如，使用基础模型特征进行常见的最近邻匹配往往会导致带有噪声的对应关系，这在求解密集对应时尤为突出。在这项工作中，我们通过泛函映射（functional maps）来解决图像匹配问题；泛函映射因其利用高效低维线性表示的强大谱形式在3D形状匹配中得到广泛应用。然而，泛函映射要求匹配域（在我们的场景中即矩形图像网格）具有信息丰富且非平凡的几何结构。为了给图像定义有意义的流形结构，我们采用有限元中的伽辽金法（Galerkin's method），基于深度图像特征的流形嵌入推导出了离散拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子（LBO）。此外，我们利用神经伴随映射来表示非线性映射。实验表明，我们的方法在真实图像的多个密集对应基准上，刷新了零样本（zero-shot）图像对应方法的当前最佳水平。代码已开源：https://github.com/NafieAmrani/NAMI
keywords: 拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子 (Laplace-Beltrami Operator)
神经伴随映射 (Neural Adjoint Maps)
tldr: 本研究利用伽辽金法在深度图像特征流形上构建离散拉普拉斯算子，并结合神经伴随映射将泛函映射引入图像领域，刷新了零样本密集图像匹配的SOTA。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙地将3D形状分析中的泛函映射（Functional Maps）和谱几何方法迁移至2D图像密集匹配任务，通过有限元Galerkin方法在深度特征上构建离散拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子，解决了图像网格缺乏非平凡几何结构的难题，并结合神经伴随映射建模非线性关系，为基础模型特征匹配提供了强大的结构化正则化，具有很高的跨领域理论融合创新性。
motivation: 在真实图像中估计相似类别不同物体实例间的语义对应极具挑战性。尽管基础模型显著推进了图像对应问题的解决，但现有方法缺乏足够的正则化（如常见的最近邻匹配常产生多噪点的对应关系，在密集对应中尤为严重）。泛函映射虽具高效低维线性表示优势，但图像网格本身缺乏非平凡的几何结构。
method: 该方法采用泛函映射框架进行图像匹配，利用有限元中的伽辽金法（Galerkin's method）基于深度图像特征的流形嵌入推导出离散拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子（LBO），为矩形图像网格赋予有意义的流形几何结构；同时引入神经伴随映射（Neural Adjoint Map）以表示非线性映射。
results: 在多个真实世界图像的密集对应基准测试中，该方法在零样本（zero-shot）图像对应方法中取得了目前最优的性能（State-of-the-Art）。
conclusion: 结合深度特征流形嵌入构建的离散拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子与神经伴随映射，为零样本密集图像匹配提供了一种有效的正则化泛函映射框架，显著提升了匹配精度与鲁棒性。

title: Sparse Anchors for Visual Multi-Session Registration in Changing Environments
authors: Yunus Talha Erzurumlu, Niklas Trekel, Saurabh Gupta, Nico Koltermann, Olga Vysotska, Jens Behley, Louis Wiesmann, Cyrill Stachniss
abstract: Repeated robotic monitoring requires localization across visits to the same environment, even if the environment changes. Such changes can substantially reduce persistent visual content, and repetitive structures can lead to incorrect cross-session correspondences. In this paper, we address visual multi-session registration of a new data recording (the query session) to a previously reconstructed reference map. Under substantial visual and structural changes, cross-session localization may be possible only for parts of the trajectory. In our approach, we therefore rely on a sparse set of reliable absolute pose constraints and combine them with within-session relative-pose information to register the complete trajectory to the reference map. We first estimate absolute alignment hypotheses through visual place recognition, local feature matching, and geometric verification. We then use sequence consensus to reject hypotheses that are inconsistent with a common query-to-reference alignment and retain the remaining poses as absolute anchors. These anchors are refined through featuremetric alignment against a Gaussian feature field and combined with within-session relative-pose constraints in a robust pose-graph optimization. We evaluate our approach on 15 cross-session experiments from the challenging HILTI26 construction-site dataset, covering substantial scene changes and difficult-to-match environments. Our method achieves 94.4% recall within 1m and 100.0% within 5m, outperforming independent image localization, which peaks at 65.3% and 70.7%, respectively, as well as direct registration of independently reconstructed Structure-from-Motion geometry. Our results show that sparse, reliable absolute anchors can provide accurate and complete trajectory registration even when reliable cross-session correspondences are available only for part of the query session.
zh_title: 变化环境下视觉多会话配准的稀疏锚点方法
translation: 重复的机器人监测需要在多次访问同一环境时实现跨会话定位，即使环境在此期间发生改变。此类环境变化会大幅减少持久存在的视觉内容，且重复性结构极易导致跨会话的错误对应。在本文中，我们针对将新采集数据（查询会话）配准到预先重建的参考地图的视觉多会话配准问题展开研究。在显著的视觉和结构变化下，跨会话定位可能仅在轨迹的局部区域可行。因此，我们的方法依赖一组稀疏但可靠的绝对位姿约束，并将其与会话内的相对位姿信息相结合，从而将整条轨迹完整配准至参考地图中。我们首先通过视觉地点识别、局部特征匹配和几何验证来估计绝对对齐假设；接着利用序列一致性剔除与全局“查询-参考”对齐不一致的假设，将剩余位姿作为绝对锚点保留；随后基于高斯特征场对这些锚点进行特征度量对齐细化，并在鲁棒位姿图优化中将它们与会话内相对位姿约束相融合。我们在充满挑战的HILTI26建筑工地数据集上的15个跨会话实验中评估了该方法，该数据集涵盖了巨大的场景变化和极难匹配的环境。实验中，我们的方法在1米范围内实现了94.4%的召回率，在5米范围内达到了100.0%，显著优于独立图像定位（峰值分别为65.3%和70.7%）以及基于独立重建运动恢复结构（SfM）几何的直接配准方法。结果表明，即使仅在查询会话的部分区域存在可靠的跨会话对应，稀疏且可靠的绝对锚点依然能够提供精确且完整的轨迹配准。
tldr: 提出了一种利用序列一致性提取稀疏可靠绝对锚点、并结合会话内位姿图优化的方法，解决了环境发生显著变化时的视觉多会话整轨配准难题。
ai_comments: 该研究的核心创新在于针对动态/变化场景中全局特征大面积失效的问题，转变了追求全局稠密跨会话匹配的思路，提出利用序列一致性挖掘稀疏但高度置信的绝对位姿锚点，并结合连续的高斯特征场进行亚像素级精细对齐。这种“稀疏绝对锚点+局部相对连续位姿约束”的架构在极端挑战（如HILTI建筑工地）下展现出了极高鲁棒性，对长周期机器人自主巡检和SLAM建图具有重要的实际应用价值。
motivation: 在长期机器人监测巡检任务中，环境外观和几何结构的显著变化会导致持久视觉线索大幅减少，加之重复结构干扰，跨会话匹配往往极易出错且只能在轨迹局部成功，导致现有的独立单帧定位或全局SfM几何配准方法失效。
method: 1. 假设生成：结合视觉地点识别、局部特征匹配和几何验证提取绝对对齐假设；2. 锚点筛选：利用序列一致性（sequence consensus）滤除异常假设，保留高置信位姿作为绝对锚点；3. 锚点细化：借助高斯特征场（Gaussian feature field）进行特征度量对齐细化位姿；4. 轨迹优化：在鲁棒位姿图优化中联合绝对锚点与会话内相对位姿约束，完成整条轨迹的统一配准。
results: 在极具挑战性的HILTI26建筑工地数据集（包含15个跨会话测试）上，该方法在1米和5米误差阈值内分别达到了94.4%和100.0%的召回率，大幅超越独立图像定位基线（峰值分别为65.3%和70.7%）以及基于独立SfM模型直接配准的方法。
conclusion: 实验结果证明，即使可靠的跨会话视觉对应仅存在于查询轨迹的部分片段中，利用稀疏、高可靠的绝对位姿锚点并结合会话内约束，也能实现高精度且完整的全轨迹配准。

title: LatentTriad: Pre-Action Risk Representations for Malicious Agent Skill Detection
authors: Zhe Yu, Yi Liu, Ying Zhang, Simin Chen
abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly extended with reusable skills, but untrusted skill content can induce operations outside the user's task. Detecting this contextual risk requires more than suspicious-pattern matching, while dynamic analysis incurs the cost of skill execution. We find that hidden states formed during prefill contain readable information about task-operation consistency, including across held-out expression forms in controlled evaluations. Matched Operation-state interventions also affect later Boundary states and shift fixed risk readouts toward the donor label. Based on these findings, we introduce LatentTriad, which combines contextual Boundary features, group-adjusted Operation directions, and departures from benign state relationships. All branches share one prefill: detection generates no output tokens, invokes no tools, and executes no skill code. Across 5,830 skill packages from five sources and seven backbones, LatentTriad achieves 99.0-99.2% pooled F1 and 93.0-94.6% source-macro F1. A separately measured compact implementation completes prefill and detection in a median of 259-284 ms. These results connect pre-action risk readability and functional influence to execution-free skill screening.
comment: Preprint. Under review. 44 pages, 16 figures, 37 tables. 9 pages of main text
zh_title: LatentTriad：用于恶意智能体技能检测的动作前风险表征
translation: 大语言模型智能体正日益通过可重用技能进行能力扩展，但不可信的技能内容可能诱发超出用户任务的操作。检测这种上下文风险不仅需要超越简单的可疑模式匹配，而动态分析又会带来执行技能的开销。我们发现，在预填充阶段形成的隐藏状态包含有关任务与操作一致性的可读信息，在受控评估中跨未见表达形式时依然如此。匹配的操作状态干预还会影响后续的边界状态，并将固定的风险读出偏向供体标签。基于这些发现，我们提出了 LatentTriad，它结合了上下文边界特征、群体调整的操作方向以及对良性状态关系的偏离。所有分支共享单次预填充：检测过程不生成输出标记、不调用工具，也不执行技能代码。在来自5个来源和7个骨干模型的5,830个技能包中，LatentTriad 实现了 99.0–99.2% 的汇总 F1 值和 93.0–94.6% 的源宏观 F1 值。一个单独测试的紧凑型实现在中位数 259–284 毫秒内即可完成预填充和检测。这些结果将动作前风险的可读性及功能性影响与免执行的技能筛选有效联系起来。
tldr: LatentTriad 利用大模型预填充阶段的隐藏状态特征，在不执行技能代码、不生成任何 Token 的前提下，实现毫秒级且高精度的恶意智能体技能检测。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将模型内部表征分析（预填充阶段隐藏状态的语义与因果干预）应用到智能体安全防御中，提出了无需代码运行、无需工具调用且无需生成额外 Token 的“免执行”筛选方案，兼顾了高安全性与极低的毫秒级延迟。其局限性可能在于依赖对模型底层隐藏状态的白盒访问权限，难以直接应用于纯商业闭源黑盒 API 智能体。
motivation: 不可信的智能体技能可能引发超出用户预期的越权或危险操作。现有的静态模式匹配难以捕捉深层上下文风险，而动态分析则必须承担实际执行不可信代码的开销与安全代价。
method: 基于预填充阶段隐藏状态包含任务-操作一致性信息的发现，提出了 LatentTriad。该方法融合了上下文边界特征（Boundary features）、群体调整的操作方向（Operation directions）以及良性状态关系的偏离度；所有计算分支共享单次预填充，完全不生成输出标记、不调用外部工具、不执行技能代码。
results: 在覆盖5个来源、7种骨干模型的5,830个技能包测试中，LatentTriad 取得了 99.0–99.2% 的汇总 F1 值和 93.0–94.6% 的源宏观 F1 值；紧凑版实现在 259–284 毫秒的中位时间内即可完成预填充与检测。
conclusion: 研究证实了语言模型在动作执行前的内部隐藏状态具备风险可读性与功能影响，为实现高效、免执行、前置式的恶意智能体技能筛选提供了全新且可行的途径。

title: Search and Verification for Strategyproof Facility Location on Metric Graphs
authors: Krzysztof Rogowski, Marcin Dziubiński
abstract:
We study automated design of strategyproof (SP) mechanisms for randomized facility location on continuous metric graphs, with the objective of minimizing total distance. We develop methods for computing upper and lower bounds on the optimal approximation ratio achievable by SP mechanisms for a given graph and number of agents.
  For the lower bound, we propose a cost-preserving reduction to a finite domain that yields lower bounds for unrestricted SP mechanisms through linear programming dual certificates.
  For the upper bound, we introduce finite representations of mechanisms, called piecewise-linear attributions (PL attributions), that mix piecewise-linear deterministic mechanisms using affine weights on a triangulation of the report space. We show that for mechanisms represented by PL attributions, checking SP and an approximation guarantee reduces to finitely many quadratic nonnegativity tests over compact polytopes. With exact arithmetic and comparisons, each verification certifies the proposed property or returns locations where it fails. In addition, we introduce a strengthening of the incentive notion called strong strategyproofness. We show that for fixed component mechanisms and regions of a PL attribution, the strong strategyproofness requirement can be expressed by a finite number of linear constraints on the attribution coefficients. Using these theoretical results, we propose a heuristic procedure for computing an upper bound on the approximation ratio.
  We compute certified upper and lower bounds on several metric graphs and numerically evaluate the proposed search procedure.
  Lastly, we show that deterministic SP onto mechanisms on graphs are strongly strategyproof and admit PL attributions. Thus restricting attention to strongly strategyproof mechanisms admitting PL attributions loses no deterministic SP onto mechanisms.
zh_title: 度量图上策略证明设施选址的搜索与验证
translation:
我们研究了在连续度量图上随机设施选址的策略证明（SP）机制的自动化设计，目标是最小化总距离。我们开发了计算给定图和代理数量下，SP机制可实现的最优近似比率的上下界的方法。
对于下界，我们提出了一种成本保留的还原方法，将其简化为有限域，通过线性规划对偶证书为无限制SP机制提供下界。
对于上界，我们引入了机制的有限表示，称为分段线性归因（PL归因），它通过在报告空间的三角剖分上使用仿射权重来混合分段线性确定性机制。我们表明，对于由PL归因表示的机制，检查SP和近似保证可归结为在紧致多面体上进行有限数量的二次非负性测试。通过精确算术和比较，每次验证都能证明所提出的属性或返回失败的位置。此外，我们引入了一种激励概念的强化，称为强策略证明性。我们表明，对于固定的组件机制和PL归因的区域，强策略证明性要求可以通过归因系数上的有限数量的线性约束来表达。利用这些理论结果，我们提出了一种启发式程序来计算近似比率的上界。
我们在几个度量图上计算了认证的上下界，并数值评估了所提出的搜索程序。
最后，我们表明图上的确定性SP onto机制是强策略证明的，并且支持PL归因。因此，将注意力限制在支持PL归因的强策略证明机制上不会损失任何确定性SP onto机制。
tldr: 本文研究了度量图上随机设施选址的策略证明机制设计，开发了计算SP机制最佳近似比率上下界的方法，并提出了新的机制表示和验证技术。
ai_comments: 本文通过引入分段线性归因（PL归因）和强策略证明性等概念，为度量图上策略证明设施选址机制的设计和验证提供了一种新颖且严谨的数学框架。其创新点在于将复杂的机制设计问题转化为可计算的优化问题，并通过理论分析和数值实验验证了方法的有效性。
motivation: 研究旨在自动化设计度量图上随机设施选址的策略证明（SP）机制，以最小化总距离。
method: 对于下界，提出了一种成本保留的还原方法，将其简化为有限域，并通过线性规划对偶证书获得无限制SP机制的下界。对于上界，引入了分段线性归因（PL归因）作为机制的有限表示，混合分段线性确定性机制，并通过有限数量的二次非负性测试检查SP和近似保证。引入了强策略证明性概念，并表明其要求可用线性约束表示。基于此提出启发式程序计算上界。
results: 计算了在多个度量图上的认证上下界。数值评估了所提出的搜索程序。证明了图上的确定性SP onto机制是强策略证明的，并支持PL归因。
conclusion: 图上的确定性SP onto机制是强策略证明的，且支持PL归因，因此将注意力限制在支持PL归因的强策略证明机制上不会损失任何确定性SP onto机制。

title: The Platonic Brain: Representational Convergence in EEG Foundation Models
authors: Nicolas Waehner, Enzo Tagliazucchi, Jacobo Sitt, Demian Wassermann, Giovanni Franco Gabriel Marraffini, Trinidad Borrell
abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) predicts that artificial neural networks converge on shared representations as scale and performance increase. We test whether these predictions hold for representations of the human brain with EEG foundation models. Using EEG recordings from six participants watching a television series, together with aligned visual and language content, we tested whether EEG foundation-model representations converge within and across modalities as their embeddings become better at decoding an informative set of EEG markers. We found that EEG models with greater decodability showed stronger cross-family alignment in both local neighbourhood similarity and global structure, not consistently increasing with model parameter count. Cross-modal convergence was modality and metric dependent: greater EEG decodability was associated with stronger global alignment to language, but not consistently to vision models, while local alignment showed no consistent association. This dissociation may reflect local sensitivity to low-level sensory features, whereas global geometry may capture weaker shared semantic structure.
zh_title: 柏拉图式大脑：EEG基础模型中的表征收敛
translation: 柏拉图式表征假设（PRH）预测，随着规模和性能的增加，人工神经网络会收敛于共享的表征。我们测试了这些预测是否适用于使用EEG基础模型的人类大脑表征。我们使用了六名参与者观看电视剧时的EEG记录，以及对齐的视觉和语言内容，测试了EEG基础模型表征在解码一组信息性EEG标记方面表现更好时，其在模态内和模态间是否收敛。我们发现，解码能力更强的EEG模型在局部邻域相似性和全局结构上显示出更强的跨家族对齐，但这不一定随着模型参数数量的增加而增加。跨模态收敛依赖于模态和度量：EEG解码能力越强，与语言模型的全局对齐越强，但与视觉模型不一致；局部对齐没有一致关联。这种分离可能反映了局部对低级感觉特征的敏感性，而全局几何可能捕捉到较弱的共享语义结构。
tldr: 研究测试了EEG基础模型中人类大脑表征的收敛性，发现解码能力越强的模型，其表征在跨家族和跨模态（对语言而非视觉）上表现出更强的对齐。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过将柏拉图式表征假设扩展到人类大脑的EEG基础模型，提供了一个新颖的视角来理解大脑表征的收敛性。研究发现解码能力与表征对齐之间的关系，以及跨模态收敛的模态依赖性，对于理解EEG表征的语义内容和其与不同感官模态的交互具有重要意义。特别是，区分局部和全局对齐的发现，为未来研究大脑表征的层次结构提供了启示。
motivation: 论文旨在检验柏拉图式表征假设（PRH）是否适用于人类大脑的表征，特别是使用EEG基础模型来观察随着模型规模和性能增加，表征是否会收敛。
method: 研究使用了六名参与者观看电视剧时的EEG记录，并结合了对齐的视觉和语言内容。通过测试EEG基础模型表征在解码信息性EEG标记方面的表现，来评估表征在模态内和模态间的收敛性。
results: 研究发现，解码能力更强的EEG模型在局部邻域相似性和全局结构上显示出更强的跨家族对齐，但这不一定随模型参数数量增加。跨模态收敛依赖于模态和度量：EEG解码能力越强，与语言模型的全局对齐越强，但与视觉模型不一致；局部对齐没有一致关联。
conclusion: 这种分离可能反映了局部对低级感觉特征的敏感性，而全局几何可能捕捉到较弱的共享语义结构。

title: A Gated Spec-Driven Workflow: An Audit-Trail Study of Coding-Agent Work
authors: Rodrigo Figueiredo Abdo, Pedro Carvalho Brom
abstract: Spec-driven development (SDD) asks a coding agent to work from specifications, plans, and task lists rather than from the chat transcript. We study one such workflow for Claude Code, in which almost every control is an instruction carried out by the same model that it constrains. The user must approve each stage before the next begins. A reviewer subagent checks each artefact against a fixed, stage-specific defect list, and an executor subagent may only touch the files listed in its task. After each block of tasks, the orchestrator runs a file-inventory check to detect undeclared changes. We analyse the logs and transcripts of nine features in seven projects, all run by the authors, ranging from a Fortran solver and Python programs to books and this paper. Of these, five finished with every planned task done, including the Fortran solver feature, and 288 of the 581 planned tasks were completed block by block. The executor kept to its declared files: it left only one undeclared change in the deliverable folder, and the check caught it, although its reports record other departures from the protocol. The weak point was the orchestrator, which runs and judges its own checks. It recorded undeclared changes in 11 of 247 block checks, mostly from the authors' in-round requests and the environment, and stopped work in only four.
zh_title: 门控规范驱动工作流：编码代理工作的审计追踪研究
translation: 规范驱动开发（SDD）要求编码代理根据规范、计划和任务列表工作，而不是根据聊天记录。我们研究了Claude Code的一种此类工作流，其中几乎每个控制都是由约束它自身的模型执行的指令。用户必须在每个阶段开始前批准。一个评审子代理根据固定的、阶段特定的缺陷列表检查每个工件，一个执行器子代理只能修改其任务中列出的文件。在每个任务块之后，协调器运行文件库存检查以检测未声明的更改。我们分析了九个功能在七个项目中的日志和记录，所有这些项目都由作者运行，范围从Fortran求解器和Python程序到书籍和本文。其中，有五个完成了所有计划任务，包括Fortran求解器功能，581个计划任务中有288个按块完成。执行器坚持其声明的文件：它在可交付文件夹中只留下了一个未声明的更改，并且检查发现了它，尽管其报告记录了其他违反协议的情况。弱点是协调器，它运行并判断自己的检查。它在247次块检查中有11次记录到未声明的更改，主要来自作者的轮内请求和环境，并且仅在四次中停止了工作。
tldr: 本研究分析了一种门控的规范驱动开发（SDD）工作流，该工作流由Claude Code执行，并具有严格的审查和执行机制。结果显示，该工作流在遵循文件修改和完成任务方面表现良好，但协调器作为自我检查的弱点被发现。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的门控规范驱动工作流，旨在提高AI编码代理工作的可控性和可审计性，这对于确保AI生成代码的质量和安全性具有重要意义。其创新之处在于引入了多级代理和严格的检查机制，特别是审计追踪的研究方法。然而，研究也揭示了自我检查机制（协调器）的局限性，这对于未来开发更鲁棒的AI编码系统提供了宝贵的见解。
motivation: 研究一种规范驱动开发（SDD）工作流，其中编码代理（如Claude Code）根据规范、计划和任务列表工作，而不是基于聊天记录，并评估其执行效果和潜在问题。
method: 研究了一种针对Claude Code的特定规范驱动工作流。该工作流中，几乎所有控制都是由约束自身的模型执行的指令。用户必须批准每个阶段才能进行下一步。一个评审子代理根据固定的、阶段特定的缺陷列表检查每个工件，一个执行器子代理只能修改其任务中列出的文件。在每个任务块之后，协调器运行文件库存检查以检测未声明的更改。作者分析了九个功能在七个项目中的日志和记录，这些项目由作者运行，涵盖了Fortran求解器、Python程序、书籍和本文。
results: 在研究的九个功能中，有五个完成了所有计划任务，包括Fortran求解器功能。在581个计划任务中，有288个按块完成。执行器子代理仅在可交付文件夹中留下了一个未声明的更改，并被检查发现。然而，其报告记录了其他违反协议的情况。协调器被发现是弱点，在247次块检查中有11次记录到未声明的更改（主要来自作者的轮内请求和环境），但仅在四次中停止了工作。
conclusion: 门控规范驱动工作流在确保编码代理遵循文件修改和完成计划任务方面具有一定效果，但协调器作为自我检查机制存在明显弱点，未能有效阻止所有未声明的更改。

title: LoopQ: Fair, Closed-Loop Evaluation of Quantized Vision-Language-Action Models
authors: Syed Umer Bukhari, Magnus Almgren, Ahmed Ali-Eldin
abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) for vision-language-action (VLA) models promises smaller and faster VLA deployments. However, when analyzing existing VLA quantization works, we realised that it is hard to reason about the performance of the suggested quantization method compared to existing, similar, or in many cases, simpler PTQ methods. We present LoopQ, a closed-loop benchmark that compares multiple quantization policies on the same checkpoint, layers and engine, varying only the method and the kernels. We evaluate RTN, AWQ, GPTQ, ActQuant and QuantVLA on four VLAs with more than 180,000 episodes of LIBERO and LIBERO-plus, compare against QVLA's reported results on the same layers, and benchmark whether the four public VLA-quantization releases can be reproduced. We benchmark the methods on an NVIDIA H100, an L4, and a Jetson AGX Thor. Our results show that while quantization reliably saves memory, 2-3x for real low-bit models, VLA-specific PTQ methods underperform compared to simpler generic baselines. At 4 bits, RTN, AWQ and GPTQ match or exceed ActQuant and QuantVLA, plain RTN matches the calibrated methods, and plain AWQ matches the success QVLA reports for itself. Standard LIBERO hides the losses that do exist: configurations with no significant LIBERO loss lose 1.5-4.3 points under paired LIBERO-plus perturbations. Speed is a weaker story. At batch 1 on the H100, no quantized pi0.5 or OpenVLA-OFT configuration is faster than its 16-bit model (1.06-1.58x slower on library kernels); only the L4 with int8 kernels gains (4-14%), the Thor is slower on every 4-bit configuration, and the engine alone changes latency by 2.1x. Profiling explains why: pi0.5's quantized backbone is compute-bound, while its memory-bound action expert, 63% of GPU time and 13% of the parameters, stays in 16 bits.
zh_title: LoopQ：量化视觉-语言-动作模型的公平闭环评估
translation: 后训练量化（PTQ）对于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型而言，有望实现更小、更快的VLA部署。然而，在分析现有VLA量化工作时，我们发现很难推断所提出的量化方法与现有、相似或在许多情况下更简单的PTQ方法相比的性能。我们提出了LoopQ，一个闭环基准，它在相同的检查点、层和引擎上比较多种量化策略，仅改变方法和内核。我们评估了RTN、AWQ、GPTQ、ActQuant和QuantVLA在四种VLA模型上的表现，使用了超过180,000个LIBERO和LIBERO-plus回合，并与QVLA在相同层上报告的结果进行比较，同时基准测试了四个公开的VLA量化版本是否可以复现。我们在NVIDIA H100、L4和Jetson AGX Thor上对这些方法进行了基准测试。我们的结果表明，虽然量化确实能可靠地节省内存，对于真正的低位模型可节省2-3倍，但VLA专用的PTQ方法表现不如更简单的通用基线。在4位精度下，RTN、AWQ和GPTQ与ActQuant和QuantVLA持平或超越，纯RTN与校准方法相当，纯AWQ与QVLA报告的成功率相当。标准LIBERO掩盖了实际存在的损失：在配对的LIBERO-plus扰动下，没有显著LIBERO损失的配置会损失1.5-4.3点。速度提升则不尽如人意。在H100上批处理1时，没有量化的pi0.5或OpenVLA-OFT配置比其16位模型更快（在使用库内核时慢1.06-1.58倍）；只有L4在使用int8内核时有所增益（4-14%）；Thor在所有4位配置下都变慢；仅引擎的变化就能导致延迟改变2.1倍。分析解释了原因：pi0.5的量化骨干受限于计算，而其内存受限的动作专家（占GPU时间的63%和参数的13%）仍保持16位。
tldr: LoopQ是一个闭环基准，用于公平评估量化视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。研究发现，通用量化方法在内存节省和性能方面往往优于VLA专用方法，而速度提升则不尽如人意。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新在于提出了一个公平、闭环的基准测试框架LoopQ，解决了现有VLA量化方法评估不一致的痛点。其重要性体现在揭示了VLA专用量化方法可能不如通用方法有效，并强调了在实际部署中速度提升的复杂性，纠正了对量化效果的一些普遍误解。研究还通过详细分析揭示了速度瓶颈的深层原因，为未来的VLA模型量化研究提供了宝贵的见解和方向。
motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型量化工作的性能难以与现有、相似或更简单的PTQ方法进行比较，这使得推理其有效性变得困难。
method: 论文提出了LoopQ，一个闭环基准测试平台，用于在相同的检查点、层和引擎上比较多种量化策略，仅改变方法和内核。研究评估了RTN、AWQ、GPTQ、ActQuant和QuantVLA等方法，并在NVIDIA H100、L4和Jetson AGX Thor等硬件上对四种VLA模型进行了超过180,000个LIBERO和LIBERO-plus回合的评估。
results: 量化确实节省内存，对于真正的低位模型可节省2-3倍。VLA专用PTQ方法表现不如更简单的通用基线。在4位精度下，RTN、AWQ和GPTQ的性能与ActQuant和QuantVLA持平或超越，纯RTN与校准方法相当，纯AWQ与QVLA报告的成功率相当。标准LIBERO测试会掩盖实际存在的性能损失；在LIBERO-plus扰动下，没有明显LIBERO损失的配置会损失1.5-4.3点。速度提升不明显：H100在批处理1时，量化的pi0.5或OpenVLA-OFT配置均不比16位模型快（慢1.06-1.58倍）；只有L4在使用int8内核时有所增益（4-14%）；Thor在所有4位配置下都变慢；仅引擎变化就能导致延迟改变2.1倍。分析表明，pi0.5的量化骨干受限于计算，而其内存受限的动作专家（占GPU时间的63%和参数的13%）仍保持16位。
conclusion: VLA模型的后训练量化虽然能显著节省内存，但VLA专用的量化方法往往不如更简单的通用基线方法，且在不同硬件和配置下，速度提升并不总是可靠或显著。

title: Workload-Static Optical Circuit Switching For Scalable LLM Inference Decode
authors: Maximilian Thürmer, Nicolas Scotto di Perto, Eloise Stein, Natanijel Vasic, Mikaeil Bagherli, Zhenguo Wu, Benjamin Klenk, Holger Fröning, Johannes Feldmann
abstract: LLM inference decode executes fine-grained collectives whose latency directly limits per-user interactivity, yet scale-up fabrics are still built from electronic packet switches designed for training. We observe that, for a given model deployment and parallelization, the communication structure of decode is fixed, and propose workload-static optical circuit switching (OCS): circuits are configured once per deployment, co-designed with model parallelism and with topology-aware collective schedules that turn spare accelerator ports into fewer communication phases or higher bandwidth. We evaluate this design with GXNET, a graph-based workload emulator coupled to analytical and flit-level network models grounded in hardware measurements. In a 576-accelerator scale-up domain serving 5T-parameter MoE models with up to 5M tokens of context, all-OCS fabrics improve interactivity by up to 65% and energy efficiency by up to 119% over 4:1 oversubscribed packet-switched fabrics.
zh_title: 工作负载静态光电路交换用于可扩展LLM推理解码
translation: LLM推理解码执行细粒度集合操作，其延迟直接限制了每用户交互性，然而，扩展性网络仍然由为训练设计的电子分组交换机构建。我们观察到，对于给定的模型部署和并行化，解码的通信结构是固定的，并提出了工作负载静态光电路交换（OCS）：电路在每次部署时配置一次，与模型并行化和拓扑感知集合调度共同设计，将备用加速器端口转化为更少的通信阶段或更高的带宽。我们通过GXNET（一个基于图的工作负载模拟器，结合了基于硬件测量的分析和flit级网络模型）评估了这种设计。在一个服务具有高达5M上下文的5T参数MoE模型的576加速器扩展域中，全OCS网络比4:1过载的分组交换网络将交互性提高高达65%，能效提高高达119%。
tldr: 针对LLM推理解码的固定通信结构，提出工作负载静态光电路交换（OCS），显著提升交互性和能效。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于认识到LLM推理解码通信结构的静态性，并据此提出了光电路交换（OCS）这一差异化解决方案。与为训练设计的动态分组交换不同，OCS利用固定性进行优化，提高了交互性和能效，对于大规模LLM部署具有重要意义。
motivation: LLM推理解码的延迟直接限制用户交互性，而现有网络结构（电子分组交换）是为训练设计的，不适用于解码固定的通信结构。
method: 本文提出工作负载静态光电路交换（OCS），其电路在部署时配置一次，与模型并行化和拓扑感知集合调度共同设计，将备用加速器端口转化为更少的通信阶段或更高的带宽。该设计通过GXNET（一个基于图的工作负载模拟器，结合了基于硬件测量的分析和flit级网络模型）进行评估。
results: 在576个加速器、服务5T参数MoE模型且上下文高达5M令牌的场景下，全OCS网络比4:1过载的分组交换网络将交互性提高高达65%，能效提高高达119%。
conclusion: 工作负载静态光电路交换（OCS）能够显著提升LLM推理解码的交互性和能效，是解决现有网络瓶颈的有效方案。

title: Molecular Prior Networks
authors: Pawel Gomoluch, Anthony Bradley
abstract: Predicting affinity between small molecules and their protein targets remains one of the central problems in drug discovery. Due to the substantial cost of wet-lab experiments, machine learning models of drug-target affinity are usually trained on relatively small datasets, ranging from tens to hundreds of molecules. Given the inherent difficulty of generalization between different targets and chemical series, existing datasets of protein-ligand affinities are typically not used for new projects. At the same time, tabular foundation models, including Prior-data Fitted Networks, have recently shown how transformers can be used to solve machine learning problems in a single forward pass of the network, after being trained over a large corpus of, typically, synthetic datasets. Inspired by that line of work, we propose a novel affinity modelling approach, in which the labels of the query molecules are predicted from the labelled support molecules in a single forward pass of a transformer model. The model is trained on thousands of existing affinity datasets, enabling it to capture the general patterns of molecular activity across different targets, chemical series and dataset sizes. For the smallest support sets, our model matches the state of the art on the regression variant of the FS-Mol benchmark, while being faster than existing methods, thanks to the lack of task-specific training. A comparison against a reduced variant of our architecture, which amounts to kernel regression in a meta-learned feature space, shows that the predictive performance of the transformer model is only partially explained by simple molecular similarity.
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery: Bridging the Translation Gap
translation:
预测小分子与其蛋白质靶点之间的亲和力仍然是药物发现中的核心问题之一。由于湿实验室实验的巨大成本，药物-靶点亲和力的机器学习模型通常在相对较小的数据集上进行训练，范围从几十到几百个分子。考虑到不同靶点和化学系列之间泛化的固有难度，现有的蛋白质-配体亲和力数据集通常不用于新项目。
与此同时，表格基础模型，包括先验数据拟合网络，最近展示了如何使用Transformer在网络的一次前向传播中解决机器学习问题，这些模型通常在大量合成数据集语料库上进行训练。受此启发，我们提出了一种新颖的亲和力建模方法，其中查询分子的标签通过Transformer模型的一次前向传播从有标签的支持分子中预测。该模型在数千个现有亲和力数据集上进行训练，使其能够捕获不同靶点、化学系列和数据集大小下分子活性的通用模式。对于最小的支持集，我们的模型在FS-Mol基准的回归变体上匹配了最先进水平，并且由于缺乏任务特定训练，比现有方法更快。与我们架构的简化变体（相当于元学习特征空间中的核回归）进行比较表明，Transformer模型的预测性能仅部分由简单的分子相似性解释。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“分子先验网络”的新型药物-靶点亲和力预测方法，它利用Transformer模型通过单次前向传播从支持分子中预测查询分子的亲和力。该模型在数千个现有亲和力数据集上训练，以捕获分子活性的通用模式，并在小支持集上达到了与现有技术相当的性能，同时速度更快。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于将Transformer架构和“先验数据拟合网络”的思想引入到药物-靶点亲和力预测领域，通过在大量现有数据集上进行预训练，实现了模型在小样本条件下的高效泛化。其“单次前向传播”的预测方式显著提高了效率，解决了传统方法需要任务特定训练的痛点。未来可能的研究方向包括探索更复杂的注意力机制或结合其他模态数据以进一步提升预测准确性。
motivation: 药物发现中预测小分子与蛋白质靶点间的亲和力是核心问题，但湿实验室实验成本高昂导致机器学习模型训练数据量小（数十到数百分子），难以泛化到新项目，且现有数据集未能有效复用。
method: 提出一种新颖的亲和力建模方法，其中查询分子的标签通过Transformer模型的一次前向传播从有标签的支持分子中预测。该模型在数千个现有亲和力数据集上进行训练，使其能够捕获不同靶点、化学系列和数据集大小下分子活性的通用模式。
results: 在最小支持集上，该模型在FS-Mol基准的回归变体上匹配了现有最先进水平。由于无需任务特定训练，其速度比现有方法更快。与简化架构（元学习特征空间中的核回归）的比较表明，Transformer模型的预测性能仅部分归因于简单的分子相似性。
conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一种高效且能捕捉分子活性通用模式的Transformer模型，有效解决了药物-靶点亲和力预测中数据稀疏和泛化困难的问题，并在性能和速度上均表现出色。

title: Dual-VaDE: Efficient and Robust Prototype Learning via Variational Dual-Domain Mixture Priors
authors: Wugeng Zheng, Song Wang, Jian Wang
abstract: In this paper, we propose Dual-VaDE, an unsupervised generative framework for learning interpretable anatomical prototypes from unlabeled medical images. In contrast to previous variational methods that rely on a single spatial latent code, which often entangles global geometry with local textures and fails to capture their cross-domain dependencies, Dual-VaDE introduces a dual-domain Gaussian mixture prior that explicitly couples spatial anatomy with phase-preserving Fourier spectral representations. We derive an exact, closed-form variational lower bound that fuses this joint prior into the decoder and optimizes the entire network end-to-end via an alternating EM formulation, avoiding heuristic two-stage clustering while ensuring superior training stability and robustness. Evaluated on OASIS-3 brain MRI, Dual-VaDE delivers substantially sharper and more plausible prototypes, achieves superior cluster separation with improvements of up to 94% over spatial-only baselines, exhibits markedly reduced variance across random seeds, and incurs negligible inference overhead (0.28 ms per image).
zh_title: Dual-VaDE：通过变分双域混合先验实现高效鲁棒的原型学习
translation: 在本文中，我们提出了Dual-VaDE，一个无监督生成框架，用于从无标签医学图像中学习可解释的解剖原型。与以往依赖单一空间潜在代码的变分方法不同，这些方法常常将全局几何与局部纹理纠缠在一起，并且未能捕获它们的跨域依赖性。Dual-VaDE引入了一个双域高斯混合先验，该先验显式地将空间解剖与相位保持的傅里叶谱表示耦合起来。我们推导出一个精确的、闭合形式的变分下界，将这个联合先验融合到解码器中，并通过交替EM公式端到端地优化整个网络，避免了启发式两阶段聚类，同时确保了卓越的训练稳定性和鲁棒性。在OASIS-3脑MRI数据集上进行评估，Dual-VaDE提供了明显更清晰、更合理的原型，实现了卓越的聚类分离，比仅空间基线提高了高达94%，随机种子间的方差显著降低，并且推理开销可忽略不计（每张图像0.28毫秒）。
tldr: Dual-VaDE是一个无监督生成框架，通过引入显式耦合空间解剖与相位保持傅里叶谱表示的双域高斯混合先验，从医学图像中学习可解释的解剖原型，解决了现有方法中全局几何与局部纹理纠缠以及跨域依赖捕捉不足的问题，并在OASIS-3脑MRI数据集上表现出优越的性能。
ai_comments: Dual-VaDE的创新之处在于其引入了双域高斯混合先验，显式地将空间解剖与傅里叶谱表示耦合，解决了现有方法中全局几何与局部纹理纠缠的问题。其端到端的优化策略和在医学图像上的出色表现，使其在可解释原型学习领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的变分方法依赖于单一的空间潜在代码，常常将全局几何与局部纹理纠缠在一起，并且无法捕获它们的跨域依赖性。因此，需要一种新的方法来学习可解释的解剖原型，同时解决这些问题。
method: Dual-VaDE引入了一个双域高斯混合先验，该先验显式地将空间解剖与相位保持的傅里叶谱表示耦合起来。它推导出一个精确的、闭合形式的变分下界，将这个联合先验融合到解码器中，并通过交替EM公式端到端地优化整个网络，避免了启发式两阶段聚类。
results: Dual-VaDE在OASIS-3脑MRI数据集上生成了更清晰、更合理的原型，实现了卓越的聚类分离，比仅空间基线提高了高达94%，随机种子间的方差显著降低，并且推理开销可忽略不计（每张图像0.28毫秒）。
conclusion: Dual-VaDE通过其创新的双域混合先验和优化方法，显著提高了从无标签医学图像中学习可解释解剖原型的效率和鲁棒性，解决了现有方法的局限性。

title: From AutoResearch to Continual AutoResearch: Do Agents Learn Across Tasks?
authors: Jeremy Qin, Ruizhi Deng, Mohamed Osama Ahmed, Frederick Tung, Leo Feng
abstract: Autoresearch has shown that agents can autonomously write code, run experiments, and iteratively improve machine learning solutions. Yet most evaluations start a new agent session from scratch for each new problem, making them costly and leaving unclear whether agents can retain and apply prior insights when adapting to new tasks. We introduce CONTINUAL AUTORESEARCH, an open-ended environment that compares persistent and reset instances of the same agent under matched task streams, data, and time budget. Continual AutoResearch covers nine task families, spanning synthetic tasks, symbolic regression, time-series forecasting, and tabular AutoML. Across five frontier agents, we measure first-solution quality, research efficiency, and final held-out performance. To distinguish insight transfer from session continuity, we run a memory ablation that vary what information agents retain from prior tasks. We show that persistent state improves research efficiency of all five agents, allowing them to find stronger solutions sooner. However, these gains do not consistently translate into better final solutions. Overall, our findings suggest that retaining experience and utilizing it effectively are distinct capabilities.
zh_title: 从自动研究到持续自动研究：智能体是否跨任务学习？
translation: 自动研究表明，智能体可以自主编写代码、运行实验并迭代改进机器学习解决方案。然而，大多数评估都是为每个新问题从头开始一个新的智能体会话，这使得成本高昂，并且不清楚智能体在适应新任务时是否能够保留和应用先前的见解。我们引入了“持续自动研究”（CONTINUAL AUTORESEARCH），这是一个开放式环境，用于在匹配的任务流、数据和时间预算下比较相同智能体的持久实例和重置实例。持续自动研究涵盖了九个任务家族，包括合成任务、符号回归、时间序列预测和表格AutoML。我们对五个前沿智能体测量了首次解决方案质量、研究效率和最终的保留性能。为了区分见解转移和会话连续性，我们运行了一个记忆消融实验，改变智能体从先前任务中保留的信息。我们发现，持久状态提高了所有五个智能体的研究效率，使它们能够更快地找到更强的解决方案。然而，这些收益并未持续转化为更好的最终解决方案。总的来说，我们的发现表明，保留经验和有效利用经验是不同的能力。
tldr: 现有自动研究智能体每次新任务都从头开始，成本高昂且不清楚能否保留经验。本文引入持续自动研究环境，比较持久和重置智能体在匹配任务流下的表现，发现持久状态能提高研究效率，但并不总能带来更好的最终解决方案，表明保留经验和有效利用是不同的能力。
ai_comments: 这项研究创新性地提出了“持续自动研究”环境，填补了自动研究领域在智能体跨任务学习和经验复用方面的空白。它揭示了智能体在保留和利用过往经验方面的复杂性，为未来设计更高效、更智能的自动研究系统提供了重要见解。其局限性可能在于尚未深入探讨如何有效桥接经验保留与最终性能提升之间的鸿沟。
motivation: 现有自动研究智能体在面对新问题时通常从头开始，这导致成本高昂，并且不清楚智能体是否能够保留并应用先前的见解来适应新任务。
method: 引入了一个名为“持续自动研究 (CONTINUAL AUTORESEARCH)”的开放式环境。该环境在匹配的任务流、数据和时间预算下，比较了相同智能体的持久实例和重置实例。它涵盖了九个任务家族，包括合成任务、符号回归、时间序列预测和表格AutoML。通过对五个前沿智能体进行评估，测量了首次解决方案质量、研究效率和最终的保留性能。为了区分见解转移和会话连续性，还进行了记忆消融实验，改变智能体从先前任务中保留的信息。
results: 持久状态提高了所有五个智能体的研究效率，使它们能够更快地找到更强的解决方案。然而，这些效率提升并不总是能转化为更好的最终解决方案。
conclusion: 智能体保留经验和有效利用经验是两种不同的能力。

title: Stray Losses in Power Transformers: A Comparative Study of Modeling Frameworks for Mild Steel
authors: Micha Swaanen, Timo Overboom, Siamak Pourkeivannour, Tom Huiskamp, Guus Pemen
abstract: Accurately predicting eddy-current and hysteresis losses in mild steel components such as the structural parts and tank of power transformers remains a challenge in transformer design. Conventional numerical approaches for eddy-current loss analysis require discretization at a fraction of the skin depth. While accurate, such fine volumetric mesh becomes computationally prohibitive for large power transformers. Moreover, hysteresis loss is not always included in this analysis. To investigate the trade-off between computational cost and accuracy, this work presents a comparative analysis of eight distinct modeling frameworks for predicting both eddy-current and hysteresis losses in mild steel. These include efficient methods avoiding meshing, such as standard impedance boundary conditions, and more accurate approaches retaining full volumetric meshing, namely complex permeability, nonlinear single-valued B-H curve, and Jiles-Atherton hysteresis modeling. To accurately represent the material's electromagnetic behavior, the properties of the mild steel used are measured directly from samples. Finally, loss measurements are conducted to benchmark all eight frameworks, demonstrating mean absolute percentage errors between predictions and measurements generally below 20%.
comment: 13 pages, 18 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Magnetics
zh_title: 电力变压器中的杂散损耗：低碳钢建模框架的比较研究
translation: 电力变压器中低碳钢部件（如结构件和油箱）的涡流损耗和磁滞损耗的准确预测仍然是变压器设计中的一个挑战。用于涡流损耗分析的传统数值方法需要在小于趋肤深度一部分的尺度上进行离散化。虽然这种方法准确，但对于大型电力变压器而言，如此精细的体积网格会带来计算上的巨大开销。此外，磁滞损耗并非总是包含在此类分析中。为了研究计算成本和精度之间的权衡，本文对八种不同的建模框架进行了比较分析，以预测低碳钢中的涡流损耗和磁滞损耗。这些框架包括避免网格划分的高效方法，例如标准阻抗边界条件，以及保留完整体积网格的更精确方法，即复磁导率、非线性单值B-H曲线和Jiles-Atherton磁滞建模。为了准确表示材料的电磁行为，所用低碳钢的特性直接从样品中测量。最后，通过损耗测量对所有八种框架进行了基准测试，结果表明预测值和测量值之间的平均绝对百分比误差通常低于20%。
tldr: 本文对八种用于预测电力变压器中低碳钢涡流损耗和磁滞损耗的建模框架进行了比较分析，旨在权衡计算成本和精度，并发现预测误差通常低于20%。
ai_comments: 本论文通过对多种建模框架的系统性比较，解决了电力变压器设计中低碳钢部件损耗预测的实际难题。其创新之处在于同时考虑了涡流损耗和磁滞损耗，并权衡了计算成本与精度，为工程师选择合适的仿真工具提供了宝贵的数据支持。直接测量材料特性并进行实际损耗测量来基准测试，增加了研究结果的可靠性和实用性。
motivation: 在电力变压器的设计中，准确预测低碳钢部件（如结构件和油箱）中的涡流损耗和磁滞损耗仍然是一个挑战。传统的涡流损耗分析数值方法需要精细的网格划分，这对于大型电力变压器来说计算成本过高，且通常不包括磁滞损耗。因此，本研究旨在调查计算成本和精度之间的权衡。
method: 本研究比较分析了八种不同的建模框架，用于预测低碳钢中的涡流损耗和磁滞损耗。这些框架包括避免网格划分的高效方法（如标准阻抗边界条件）以及保留完整体积网格的更精确方法（如复磁导率、非线性单值B-H曲线和Jiles-Atherton磁滞模型）。为了准确表示材料的电磁行为，直接测量了所用低碳钢的样品特性。最后，通过损耗测量对所有八种框架进行了基准测试。
results: 在预测值和测量值之间的平均绝对百分比误差通常低于20%。
conclusion: 本研究通过对八种建模框架的比较分析，证明了在预测电力变压器低碳钢部件中的涡流和磁滞损耗时，计算成本与精度之间的权衡，并提供了不同方法的性能基准。

title: Characterizing the vertical continuity of fuel strata based on TLS point clouds Gaussian decomposition and overlap metrics
authors: Jesús Torralba, Luis Á. Ruiz, Pablo Crespo-Peremarch, Marina Simó-Martí, Juan Pedro Carbonell-Rivera
abstract: Vertical forest structure influences fire behavior by regulating understory-to-canopy fuel connectivity, yet operational fuel-type models represent this complexity through discrete classes that only indirectly capture vertical continuity. High-density point clouds offer an opportunity to characterize vertical fuel connectivity in a more explicit and continuous manner, but specific methodological approaches are still required. We applied Gaussian decomposition to vertical height profiles derived from terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) point clouds across 25 permanent forest plots to characterize geometric vertical fuel continuity. A multiscale analysis spanning from the plot scale to ~0.5 $m^2$ units was used to evaluate geometric, probabilistic, and overlap metrics for characterizing fuel strata. The method reproduced the vertical transition between shrub and tree strata, with median Pearson correlations ranging from 0.83 to 0.96 across analysis levels. Probability density overlap metrics and separability indicators, such as the Jeffries-Matusita distance, provided complementary descriptors of vertical continuity. Intermediate spatial scales (3-6 m cells) provided a useful compromise between spatial detail and the consistent representation of shrub-canopy interaction patterns. Finer scales increased variability due to point density reduction and profile irregularity, and low mean squared error values were found insufficient as sole performance indicators. Gaussian decomposition applied to TLS point clouds enables explicit quantification of vertical fuel continuity, a limitation of current discrete classification systems. Continuous vertical connectivity metrics derived from this approach offer a pathway for improving ladder fuel characterization and strengthening decision-making support in wildfire risk assessment.
