title: Reliability-Weighted Direct Preference Optimization: Penalized Weights for Robust Preference Learning
authors: Bin Luo, Param Venkat Vivek Kesireddy, Anil Vallepu
abstract:
Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) treats every reported comparison as correct, yet preference data contain
  reversed, tied or otherwise noisy comparisons. RW-DPO gives each comparison an unknown reliability weight
  $w_i\in[0,1]$ that enters the likelihood linearly -- DPO is $w\equiv1$, a reversed comparison $w_i=0$ -- and estimates
  the weights jointly with the policy under a minimax-concave penalty on $-\log w_i$. The penalty keeps every
  comparison the model agrees with at exactly $w_i=1$ and acts only on those it contradicts, through closed-form weight
  updates at negligible cost over DPO. We prove that recovering all flipped comparisons from a single annotation per
  comparison requires margins of order $\log n$. Furthermore, in a linear-index model, starting from an initial fit
  pointing in the correct direction, our estimator jointly consistently recovers the preference direction and weights,
  as well as identifies the flipped comparisons above this margin scale, even when a fixed fraction of comparisons is
  flipped. In simulations RW-DPO has the lowest average estimation error among DPO, noise-rate corrections and recent
  robust methods, with far more precise flags than recent label-correction methods. In DPO fine-tuning of a language
  model with 10-30% flipped labels, its win rate does not fall as the flip rate grows and exceeds that of DPO trained on
  clean labels, matching the strongest recent method with corrections concentrated on the flipped labels.
zh_title: 可靠性加权直接偏好优化：用于鲁棒偏好学习的惩罚权重
translation: 直接偏好优化（DPO）将每个给出的对比样本均视为正确，但偏好数据中往往存在反转、平局或其他噪声对比。RW-DPO为每个对比样本赋予一个未知的可靠性权重 $w_i \in [0,1]$，该权重线性进入似然函数——其中DPO对应于 $w \equiv 1$，完全反转的对比则对应于 $w_i = 0$——并在施加于 $-\log w_i$ 的极大极小凹惩罚（minimax-concave penalty）下与策略联合估计权重。该惩罚项使得模型赞同的每个对比样本权重严格保持在 $w_i=1$，且仅作用于与模型预测矛盾的样本，同时仅需极小额外计算开销即可通过闭式解更新权重。我们从理论上证明，在每个对比仅有单次标注的情况下，恢复所有反转的对比样本需要 $\log n$ 阶的间隔（margin）。此外，在线性指标模型中，从指向正确方向的初始拟合出发，即使存在固定比例的反转对比，我们的估计器也能联合一致地恢复偏好方向与权重，并识别出该间隔尺度以上的反转对比。在模拟实验中，与DPO、噪声率修正法及近期鲁棒方法相比，RW-DPO取得了最低的平均估计误差，且标记精度远高于近期的标签修正方法。在包含10%至30%反转标签的语言模型DPO微调中，其胜率不仅未随反转率增加而下降，甚至超过了在干净标签上训练的DPO，比肩最优秀的近期方法，并将修正精准集中在反转标签上。
tldr: RW-DPO通过对偏好样本引入可靠性权重与非凸惩罚项，以极小计算开销实现对噪声和反转标签的自适应过滤，显著提升偏好微调的鲁棒性。
ai_comments: RW-DPO巧妙地结合了统计学中的极大极小凹惩罚（minimax-concave penalty）与DPO目标函数，不仅在几乎不增加计算开销的前提下实现了权重的闭式更新，还提供了在单次标注设置下恢复反转标签的理论边界。该方法在噪声偏好微调场景下展现出极强的鲁棒性，甚至胜过纯净数据训练的标准DPO。
motivation: 直接偏好优化（DPO）默认所有标注的比较样本都是正确的，但现实偏好数据中常含有反转、平局或其他噪声比较，严重影响策略微调性能。
method: 提出了RW-DPO方法：为每个偏好对比样本赋予未知可靠性权重$w_i \in [0, 1]$并线性代入似然函数，同时在$-\log w_i$上施加极大极小凹惩罚（minimax-concave penalty），从而与策略联合优化；该惩罚对模型认同的样本保持$w_i=1$，仅对冲突样本通过闭式解更新权重，计算开销可忽略不计。
results: 理论上证明了在单次标注下单样本反转恢复所需的间隔阶数为$\log n$，并在线性指标模型中证明了联合一致恢复性；仿真中其估计误差在同类方法中最低；在10-30%标签反转的语言模型微调实验中，RW-DPO的胜率未随反转率上升而下降，甚至超越了在纯净数据上训练的DPO。
conclusion: RW-DPO通过引入可靠性权重惩罚机制，在理论和实证上均证明了其能够有效纠正和过滤噪声/反转偏好对，显著提升了偏好学习的鲁棒性。

title: PDE-Residual-Informed Kriging
authors: Yu Tan, Shichang Du, Yongxiang Li
abstract: Physics-informed Gaussian process (GP) methods provide a probabilistic framework for PDE solving. Existing approaches incorporate PDE information in different ways: pointwise conditioning uses the governing equation only at finitely many selected locations, globally constrained GPs restrict the admissible functions to satisfy the PDE exactly, and residual-penalized methods control the PDE mismatch over the whole domain through an additional penalty weight. What is still missing is a GP formulation that directly incorporates global PDE-residual information of the entire domain into its covariance structure, while retaining model flexibility and standard GP conditioning without a separate residual-weight parameter. To solve this issue, this study proposes PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK) based on a PDE-residual kernel. The PDE-residual kernel is constructed by equipping a kernel-section space with an inner product defined by the $L^{2}$ inner product of PDE residuals. This construction makes PRIK yield the posterior mean with minimum integrated squared PDE residual. It also provides direct statistical interpretations: the variance-scale estimate equals the normalized PDE-residual energy (i.e., the integrated squared PDE residual of the posterior mean divided by the number of labeled observations), and the profile likelihood balances this residual energy against model complexity. Under the stated regularity and stability conditions, we establish $H^{2}$-quasi-optimality and convergence rates for the posterior mean, together with a nonasymptotic bound for its PDE-residual norm. We further show that the normalized posterior kernel converges to a variational Green-type kernel and derive a uniform nonasymptotic contraction bound for the posterior variance. Numerical studies provide empirical evidence consistent with the theory and demonstrate the PDE-solving capability of PRIK.
translation: 物理信息高斯过程（GP）方法为求解偏微分方程（PDE）提供了一个概率框架。现有方法以不同方式整合PDE信息：逐点条件化仅在有限个选定位置使用控制方程，全局约束GP限制容许函数精确满足PDE，而残差惩罚法则通过额外的惩罚权重来控制整个域上的PDE失配。目前所缺少的是一种GP公式，它能够将整个域的全局PDE残差信息直接纳入其协方差结构中，同时保持模型的灵活性和标准GP条件化，而无需单独的残差权重参数。为了解决这个问题，本研究提出了基于PDE残差核的PDE残差信息克里金法（PRIK）。PDE残差核是通过为核截面空间配备由PDE残差的$L^{2}$内积定义的内积来构建的。这种构建使得PRIK能够产生具有最小积分平方PDE残差的后验均值。它还提供了直接的统计学解释：方差尺度估计等于归一化的PDE残差能量（即后验均值的积分平方PDE残差除以带标签观测值的数量），并且profile似然平衡了该残差能量与模型复杂度。在规定的正则性和稳定性条件下，我们建立了后验均值的$H^{2}$准最优性和收敛速度，以及其PDE残差范数的非渐近界。我们进一步证明了归一化后验核收敛于变分Green型核，并推导出了后验方差的均匀非渐近收缩界。数值研究提供了与理论一致的经验证据，并展示了PRIK的PDE求解能力。
tldr: 本文提出了PRIK方法，通过引入新型PDE残差核，将全局偏微分方程残差直接纳入高斯过程协方差，无需调参即可实现理论保证的高精度PDE求解。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK)方法，将全局偏微分方程残差信息直接融入高斯过程的协方差结构中，无需调节残差惩罚权重，并在理论和数值实验上都展现了优越性。
motivation: 现有的物理信息高斯过程（GP）方法在将PDE信息融入时存在局限：逐点条件化仅在有限位置使用，全局约束限制了解的准确性，而残差惩罚法则需要人为调节惩罚权重。缺少一种能直接将全域全局PDE残差信息纳入协方差结构、保持模型灵活性且无需独立残差权重参数的GP公式。
method: 提出基于PDE残差核的PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK)方法，通过在核截面空间配备由PDE残差的$L^2$内积定义的内积来构建PDE残差核。
results: 理论上建立了后验均值的$H^2$准最优性和收敛速度、PDE残差范数的非渐近界、后验核向变分Green型核的收敛性以及后验方差的均匀非渐近收缩界；数值研究验证了理论并展示了出色的PDE求解能力。
conclusion: 本文提出的PRIK方法成功将全局PDE残差信息融入高斯过程协方差结构，兼具理论保证和良好的数值求解性能。

title: Underdamped Stochastic Optimal Transport with Landauer boundary conditions: machine learning and analytical solution
authors: Julia Sanders, Dario Lucente, Marco Baldovin, Paolo Muratore-Ginanneschi
abstract: Finding optimal transport protocols for underdamped stochastic processes is a difficult yet important problem in control theory. In this paper we develop a direct method, based on machine learning, to find the optimal solution of the problem in the presence of non-linear boundary conditions, including those modelling the Landauer bit-erasure problem. The dynamics is steered from a single-peak to a double-peak distribution in position space, by only acting on a controllable external potential. The problem is highly non-linear, and analytical solutions are not available in general. We benchmark our numerical results with a perturbative expansion, which is expected to hold in a suitable overdamped limit.
comment: Main: 12 pages, 6 figures. Supplemental material: 11 pages
zh_title: 具有朗道尔边界条件的欠阻尼随机最优输运：机器学习与解析解
translation: 寻找欠阻尼随机过程的最优输运协议是控制理论中一个困难但重要的问题。在本文中，我们开发了一种基于机器学习的直接方法，用于在存在非线性边界条件（包括模拟朗道尔比特擦除问题的边界条件）时寻找该问题的最优解。仅通过作用于可控的外加势，动力学在位置空间中从单峰分布被引导至双峰分布。该问题具有高度非线性，通常无法获得解析解。我们使用微扰展开对数值结果进行了基准测试，该微扰展开预计在合适的过阻尼极限下成立。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的直接方法，用于解决具有朗道尔非线性边界条件的高非线性欠阻尼随机最优输运问题，并通过微扰展开进行了基准验证。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将机器学习直接方法引入欠阻尼随机最优输运问题中，有效应对了朗道尔比特擦除等复杂的非线性边界条件，并通过过阻尼极限下的微扰展开进行基准验证，在非平衡统计物理与现代控制理论的结合上具有重要价值。
motivation: 欠阻尼随机过程的最优输运协议求解是控制理论中的重要难题，尤其在存在非线性边界条件（如朗道尔比特擦除）时问题高度非线性，通常缺乏解析解。
method: 开发了一种基于机器学习的直接求解方法，仅通过调节可控外势将系统在位置空间中从单峰分布引导至双峰分布，并利用过阻尼极限下的微扰展开法进行基准比对。
results: 成功获得了非线性边界条件下欠阻尼随机最优输运的数值解，并利用合适过阻尼极限下的微扰展开基准对其进行了有效验证。

title: On reduced SPDE models for stochastic Cucker-Smale flocking dynamics
authors: Kamran Arora, Federico Cornalba, Ana Djurdjevac
abstract: Flocking refers to a phenomenon in collective motion where particles align their velocities with each other, commonly modelled using Cucker-Smale dynamics. In this work, we introduce and analyse two general reduced SPDE models for stochastic Cucker-Smale particle dynamics that encompass environmental and i.i.d.-type noises. Our models are computationally cheaper alternatives to the underlying particle system and preserve the flocking behaviour. To derive our reduced models, we consider suitable empirical particle densities which depend on position and time, but feature velocity dependency in a multiplicative fashion: this setup crucially allows for a very intuitive and convenient notion of flocking at the SPDE level. In $d=1$ we prove flocking of the reduced SPDE models, and, for the environmental noise, we also quantify the discrepancy between the reduced SPDE and mollified particle system. We also discuss the technical modifications required to extend the results to higher dimensions. We then provide extensive numerical experiments to verify our theoretical results in $d=1$ and to explore the behaviour of our models in $d=2$.
zh_title: 关于随机Cucker-Smale群集动力学的降维SPDE模型
translation: 群集是指集体运动中的一种现象，其中粒子的速度相互对齐，通常使用Cucker-Smale动力学来建模。在这项工作中，我们引入并分析了两个通用的降维SPDE模型，用于描述包含环境噪声和独立同分布（i.i.d.）噪声的随机Cucker-Smale粒子动力学。我们的模型是底层粒子系统的计算成本更低的替代方案，并且能够保持群集行为。为了推导出我们的降维模型，我们考虑了适当的经验粒子密度，这些密度取决于位置和时间，但以乘法方式表现出速度依赖性：这种设置至关重要地允许在SPDE层面上对群集进行非常直观和方便的概念化。在 $d=1$ 维度下，我们证明了降维SPDE模型的群集性，对于环境噪声，我们还量化了降维SPDE与平滑粒子系统之间的差异。我们还讨论了将结果扩展到更高维度所需的技术修改。随后，我们提供了大量的数值实验，以验证我们在 $d=1$ 下的理论结果，并探讨了我们的模型在 $d=2$ 下的行为。
tldr: 本文提出了随机Cucker-Smale群集动力学的降维SPDE模型，既能降低计算成本又能保持群集行为，并通过理论证明和数值实验进行了验证。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地提出了适用于随机Cucker-Smale群集动力学的降维随机偏微分方程（SPDE）模型，不仅在计算上更具优势，而且在SPDE层面上保持了群集行为，并通过数学证明和数值实验进行了严格验证。
motivation: 传统的随机Cucker-Smale粒子系统在计算上成本高昂，因此需要开发计算成本更低、同时能保持群集行为的降维SPDE模型。
method: 考虑依赖于位置和时间、且速度依赖性呈乘法关系的经验粒子密度，从而推导出两个通用的降维SPDE模型；在一维情况下证明了群集行为并量化了误差，同时讨论了高维扩展的技术修改并进行了数值实验。
results: 在一维情况下证明了降维SPDE模型的群集性，量化了环境噪声下降维SPDE与平滑粒子系统之间的差异，并经一维和二维的广泛数值实验验证了理论结果。
conclusion: 本文成功导出了随机Cucker-Smale动力学的降维SPDE模型，在数学上证明了一维情况下的群集行为及误差界，并通过高维数值实验验证了模型的有效性。

title: Co$^2$ODE: Conditionally Coarse-Grained Model Discovery for Rewiring in Biochemical Networks
authors: Theodore de Pomereu, Fabian Fröhlich
abstract: Biochemical networks propagate the signals that regulate cellular behaviour, and which routes carry them depends on cellular context: a shift in context rewires the network's effective dynamics. Mechanistic simulators are misspecified here because the effective dynamics emerge from an interaction structure that is only partially known. Model discovery instead learns the dynamics from data, but sparse, correlated measurements poorly identify a full network model. What matters is narrower: the portion the context rewires. We introduce conditionally coarse-grained ODEs (Co$^2$ODE), which model that portion as a sparse neural or symbolic ODE: a conditional mask selects the markers carrying the rewiring, and a variational autoencoder compresses the remaining markers into a learnt closure term. On single-cell phosphoproteomic data spanning 30 cancer-relevant overexpressions, Co$^2$ODE compresses a 30-marker panel into a 10-dimensional state while matching the predictive accuracy of a neural ODE fit to the full panel. The closure absorbs what the mask drops, hence the accuracy is insensitive to which markers are kept. Adding a prior score to the loss shifts the selected markers at no cost in fit, indicating the data are not interventional enough to identify the underlying biology.
zh_title: Co$^2$ODE：用于生物化学网络重连的条件粗粒化模型发现
translation: 生物化学网络传播调节细胞行为的信号，其传输路径取决于细胞上下文：上下文的转变会重连网络的有效动态。此处的机械模拟器存在设定误差，因为有效动力学源于仅部分已知的相互作用结构。模型取而代之是从数据中学习动态，但稀疏且相关的测量难以识别完整的网络模型。重要的是更狭窄的部分：上下文重连的部分。我们引入了条件粗粒化常微分方程（Co$^2$ODE），将其建模为稀疏神经或符号ODE：条件掩码选择携带重连的标记，变分自编码器将剩余标记压缩为学习到的闭包项。在跨越30种癌症相关过表达的单细胞磷酸化蛋白质组学数据上，Co$^2$ODE将30个标记的面板压缩为10维状态，同时匹配了拟合完整面板的神经ODE的预测准确度。闭包吸收了掩码丢弃的内容，因此准确度对应保留哪些标记不敏感。在损失函数中加入先验得分可以在不付出拟合代价的情况下改变所选标记，这表明数据不足以进行干预以识别底层生物学机制。
keywords: 条件粗粒化常微分方程
单细胞磷酸化蛋白质组学
tldr: 提出Co$^2$ODE方法，通过条件掩码和变分自编码器对生物化学网络中的上下文重连动态进行建模与降维，在保证预测准确率的同时简化了模型。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地结合了条件掩码（conditional mask）与变分自编码器（VAE），提出了Co$^2$ODE方法，能够有效解决生物化学网络中由于上下文改变导致的动态重连问题，并在单细胞磷酸化蛋白质组学数据上取得了很好的效果。
motivation: 生物化学网络的有效动力学随细胞上下文而改变（重连），而传统的机械模拟器存在模型设定误差，全网络模型又难以从稀疏且相关的测量数据中准确辨识，因此需要一种能够聚焦于上下文重连部分的模型发现方法。
method: 引入条件粗粒化ODEs (Co$^2$ODE)，利用稀疏神经或符号ODE建模重连部分，通过条件掩码选择携带重连的标记，并使用变分自编码器将其余标记压缩为学习到的闭包项（closure term）。
results: 在涵盖30种癌症相关过表达的单细胞磷酸化蛋白质组学数据上，Co$^2$ODE将30个标记的面板压缩为10维状态，同时保持了与拟合全面板的神经ODE相同的预测准确率。
conclusion: Co$^2$ODE提供了一种有效的、针对上下文重连的生物化学网络简化与建模方法，兼具准确性与鲁棒性，同时也揭示了现有数据在识别潜在生物学机制方面的局限性。

title: Enhancing Medical Lesion Segmentation via Several Simple Modules
authors: Ruichen Li, Zhao Yao
abstract: This work introduces three lightweight enhancement modules for medical lesion segmentation to improve clinical applicability, particularly under data-scarce and computationally constrained environments. Current mainstream methods struggle with the lack of high-quality annotations for rare pathologies, which often leads to severe morphological distortions during inference, despite achieving seemingly ideal DSC scores. Furthermore, the isolated development of individual segmentation tasks restricts cross-domain methodological innovation, underscoring the need for leveraging shared knowledge across different lesions within the same anatomical region. However, constrained access to historical data and annotations hinders efficient knowledge extraction and triggers catastrophic forgetting when adapting to new classes. To address these challenges, we first propose DT-Morph Combined Loss with continuous spatial pooling to optimize differentiable topological structures and boundary continuity. Second, we introduce 3D Group Prompt, which extracts domain-universal knowledge via curated volumetric image-mask alignment prompts together with text prompts built on SAT baseline. Finally, we replace conventional output layers with Many-to-One Conditional Segmentation Head equipped with synonym-resolved routing, which brings negligible computational cost and enables fast incremental learning for new categories without sacrificing performance on old tasks. Ablation studies on abdominal and extra-abdominal datasets covering both organ and lesion segmentation verify the efficacy of our modules.
zh_title: 通过几个简单的模块增强医学病灶分割
translation: 本研究引入了三个用于医学病灶分割的轻量级增强模块，以提高临床适用性，特别是在数据稀缺和计算受限的环境下。当前的主流方法在缺乏高质量稀有病理注释的情况下，尽管获得了看似理想的DSC分数，但在推理过程中往往会导致严重的形态畸变。此外，各个分割任务的孤立发展限制了跨域方法的创新，这凸显了利用同一解剖区域内不同病灶之间共享知识的必要性。然而，对历史数据和注释的受限访问阻碍了高效的知识提取，并在适应新类别时引发灾难性遗忘。为了解决这些挑战，我们首先提出了结合连续空间池化的DT-Morph组合损失，以优化可微分拓扑结构和边界连续性。其次，我们引入了3D Group Prompt，通过精心策划的体积图像-掩膜对齐提示以及基于SAT基线构建的文本提示来提取域通用知识。最后，我们用配备同义词解析路由的多对一条件分割头替换了传统的输出层，这带来了微不足道的计算成本，并实现了对新类别的快速增量学习，同时不牺牲对旧任务的性能。在涵盖器官和病灶分割的腹部及腹部外数据集上的消融实验验证了我们模块的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了三个轻量级的增强模块，解决了医学病灶分割中的形态失真、跨域知识迁移困难及灾难性遗忘问题。
ai_comments: 该论文设计了三个轻量级模块来解决医学病灶分割中的数据稀缺、形态失真以及增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，具有很强的临床应用价值和创新性。
motivation: 现有主流方法在处理缺乏高质量注释的稀有病理时容易产生形态失真，且在跨任务迁移时面临数据受限和灾难性遗忘的挑战，需要轻量级且高效的模块来提升临床适用性。
method: 1. 提出结合连续空间池化的DT-Morph组合损失函数；2. 引入利用体图像-掩膜对齐提示和文本提示的3D Group Prompt；3. 使用配备同义词解析路由的多对一条件分割头替代传统输出层。
results: 消融实验在涵盖器官和病灶分割的腹部及腹部外数据集上验证了所提模块的有效性。
conclusion: 实验证明了所提出的三个轻量级模块在腹部及腹部外数据集上的有效性，能够提升医学病灶分割的性能并支持快速增量学习。

title: Exponential quantum-classical query separations for cyclic Forrelation
authors: Yuxin Zhang, Changpeng Shao
abstract:
We study the randomized classical query complexity of cyclic Forrelation, a cyclic analogue of $k$-Forrelation [AA15, STOC'15; BS21, STOC'21]. Given $k$ Boolean functions $f_1,\ldots,f_k:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\{-1,1\}$, the goal is to estimate $T_k=N^{-1}\operatorname{Tr}(D_{f_1}H^{\otimes n}\cdots D_{f_k}H^{\otimes n}),$ where $D_{f_i}=\operatorname{diag}(f_i(x):x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n)$, $H$ is the Hadamard gate, and $N=2^n$. This normalized-trace problem can be solved with $k$ quantum queries in the DQC1 model. Its classical query complexity was left open in [JLS+26, FOCS'26], which conjectured a lower bound of $\widetildeΩ(N^{1-2/k})$.
  We establish a nearly complete characterization of the nonadaptive classical query complexity of cyclic Forrelation. For even $k\ge 4$, we prove a tight bound of $Θ_k(N^{1-2/k})$ for constant additive error. For odd $k\ge 5$, we obtain a lower bound of $Ω_k(N^{1-2/(k-1)})$ and an upper bound of $O_k(N^{1-2/k})$. Surprisingly, $k=3$ admits a polylogarithmic-query nonadaptive classical algorithm, disproving the conjecture in this case. These results suggest an unexpected parity-dependent structure: the nonadaptive complexity may be governed by the independence number of the $k$-cycle, leading to the exponent $1-1/\lfloor k/2\rfloor$, rather than the previously conjectured $1-2/k$, which was motivated by a Fourier-growth heuristic. Finally, allowing adaptivity, we prove a lower bound of $Ω(N^{1/4})$ for every $k\ge4$.
  Although formally close to $k$-Forrelation, the cyclic structure leads to rather different classical behavior and requires different techniques. Our lower bounds are based on hidden-shift collision constructions, and our upper bounds follow from randomized sampling together with cycle-specific conditional-moment estimates. Our results provide a systematic understanding of its query advantages over classical computation.
zh_title: 循环相关性的指数级量子-经典查询分离
translation:
我们研究了循环相关性（cyclic Forrelation）的随机经典查询复杂度，这是 $k$-相关性（$k$-Forrelation）的一个循环模拟。给定 $k$ 个布尔函数，目标是估计一个归一化迹问题的值。该问题在 DQC1 模型中可以用 $k$ 次量子查询解决，而其经典查询复杂度此前未知，并曾被猜想具有 $\widetilde{\Omega}(N^{1-2/k})$ 的下界。
我们对循环相关性的非自适应经典查询复杂度建立了近乎完整的刻画。对于偶数 $k \ge 4$，我们证明了常数加法误差下的紧界 $\Theta_k(N^{1-2/k})$。对于奇数 $k \ge 5$，我们得到了 $\Omega_k(N^{1-2/(k-1)})$ 的下界和 $O_k(N^{1-2/k})$ 的上界。令人惊讶的是，$k=3$ 允许一个多项对数查询的非自适应经典算法，从而在该情况下推翻了猜想。这些结果表明了一种意想不到的奇偶性依赖结构：非自适应复杂度可能由 $k$ 元环的独立数决定，从而导致指数为 $1-1/\lfloor k/2 \rfloor$，而不是先前由傅里叶增长启发式所激发的 $1-2/k$。最后，允许适应性时，我们证明了对于每个 $k \ge 4$，都有 $\Omega(N^{1/4})$ 的下界。
尽管形式上接近 $k$-相关性，但循环结构导致了相当不同的经典行为，并需要不同的技术。我们的下界基于隐藏位移碰撞构造，而我们的上界则来自随机采样以及循环特定的条件矩估计。我们的结果提供了对它相对于经典计算的查询优势的系统理解。
tldr: 论文研究了循环相关性的量子与经典查询复杂度，证明了其复杂的奇偶依赖界限，并在$k=3$时推翻了先前的经典下界猜想。
ai_comments: 该论文对循环相关性（cyclic Forrelation）的非自适应经典查询复杂度进行了深入研究，给出了近乎完整的刻画，并推翻了先前的某些猜想，展现了量子计算与经典计算之间惊人的奇偶性依赖结构。
motivation: 填补关于循环相关性（cyclic Forrelation）经典查询复杂度的空白，并验证先前关于其下界的猜想。
method: 下界基于隐藏位移碰撞构造，上界通过随机采样结合特定循环的条件矩估计得出。
results: 对于偶数$k\ge 4$证明了紧界$\Theta_k(N^{1-2/k})$；对于奇数$k\ge 5$给出了下界与上界；对于$k=3$发现了多项对数查询的非自适应经典算法，推翻了此前的猜想。
conclusion: 我们对循环相关性的量子与经典查询复杂度有了系统的理解，揭示了其与传统$k$-相关性截然不同的经典行为。

title: Distributed Zeroth-Order Composite Finite-Sum Optimization via Incremental Variance Reduction
authors: Silan Zhang, Yujie Tang
abstract: We study decentralized composite finite-sum optimization over a fixed connected undirected network, where agents access local component functions through function evaluations and share a possibly nonsmooth convex regularizer. In this setting, standard two-point gradient estimators can retain nonvanishing variance at a solution, complicating their integration with gradient tracking. We propose Distributed Zeroth-Order Incremental Variance Reduction (Distributed ZIVR), which combines incrementally updated component-gradient estimates with a proximal gradient-tracking scheme. The method admits an implementation using a constant number of function evaluations per agent at every iteration, without intermittent full-component or full-coordinate refreshes. For convex smooth component functions and strongly convex local averages, we establish linear convergence up to a controllable finite-difference error. With the finite-difference radius chosen for the target accuracy, Chebyshev-accelerated mixing yields a per-agent oracle complexity of $\widetilde{O}(d(m+κ)\log(1/ε))$ for expected squared solution error $ε$, where $d$ is the dimension, $m$ is the number of components per agent, and $κ$ is the condition number. This matches the centralized ZIVR oracle bound, while the communication bound has only an inverse square-root dependence on the network spectral gap. Experiments on logistic and robust regression demonstrate rapid reduction of solution and consensus errors.
zh_title: 基于增量方差约简的分布式零阶复合有限和优化
translation: 我们研究了固定连通无向网络上的分散式复合有限和优化问题，其中智能体通过函数评估访问局部组件函数，并共享一个可能非光滑的凸正则化器。在此设置下，标准的两点梯度估计器在解处可能保留非零方差，这使其与梯度追踪的集成变得复杂。我们提出了分布式零阶增量方差指数约简（Distributed ZIVR），它将增量更新的分量梯度估计与近端梯度追踪方案结合起来。该方法在每次迭代中每个智能体只需使用常数个函数评估，无需间断的全组件或全坐标刷新。对于凸平滑分量函数和强凸局部平均，我们建立了一个可控有限差分误差范围内的线性收敛性。当为目标精度选择有限差分半径时，Chebyshev加速混合产生了 $\widetilde{O}(d(m+κ)\log(1/ε))$ 的每个智能体预言机复杂度（对应于期望平方解误差 $\varepsilon$），其中 $d$ 是维度，$m$ 是每个智能体的组件数，$k$ 是条件数。这与集中式ZIVR的预言机界相匹配，而通信界对网络谱隙只有逆平方根依赖。逻辑回归和鲁棒回归的实验证明了解误差和共识误差的快速降低。
tldr: 提出了一种新的分布式零阶优化算法（Distributed ZIVR），通过增量方差约简实现了与集中式算法相匹配的预言机复杂度。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种分布式零阶组合有限和优化算法，通过结合增量方差约简与近端梯度追踪技术，在保证较低函数评估次数的同时实现了线性收敛，并在理论上匹配了集中式算法的预言机复杂度，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用潜力。
motivation: 在分散式复合有限和优化中，标准的两点梯度估计在解处会保留非零方差，从而使其与梯度追踪的集成变得复杂，因此需要一种新的零阶优化方法来解决这一问题。
method: 提出分布式零阶增量方差约简算法（Distributed ZIVR），结合了增量更新的分量梯度估计与近端梯度追踪方案，利用Chebyshev加速混合。
results: 对于凸平滑分量函数和强凸局部平均，建立了达到可控有限差分误差的线性收敛性；在目标精度下，每个智能体的预言机复杂度达到 $\widetilde{O}(d(m+κ)\log(1/ε))$，匹配了集中式ZIVR的预言机界。
conclusion: 本文提出的Distributed ZIVR算法在分布式零阶组合有限和优化问题上取得了突破，实现了与集中式算法相匹配的预言机复杂度，并通过实验验证了其有效性。

title: Maximum edge overlap between independent random regular graphs
authors: Andrea D'Ascenzo, Riccardo Michielan
abstract: Optimising the vertex correspondence can substantially increase the number of edges shared by two independent realisations of the same random graph. We quantify this phenomenon for uniformly random $d$-regular graphs and derive corresponding results for their edge-based graph edit distance. For every fixed $d\geq 3$, we show that the maximum overlap is $n+Θ_{\mathbb P}(n/\log n)$, where the leading term $n$ arises from Hamiltonicity, while the surplus captures the optimal order of the excess beyond it. We establish explicit upper and lower bounds on the surplus. The upper bound is obtained by counting common cores of minimum degree at least two, while the lower bound is established using spanning factors consisting of cycles of the same logarithmic length. For the special case $d=2$, we show that the maximum overlap is $n-(1+o_{\mathbb P}(1))\log n$. The additional overlap achievable is also studied by rotating aligned Hamilton cycles, using a contiguity argument. As a by-product, we determine the asymptotic maximum overlap between unions of independent random perfect matchings under cyclic shifts.
zh_title: 独立随机正则图之间的最大边重叠度
translation: 优化顶点对应可以显著增加同一随机图的两个独立实现所共享的边数。我们量化了均匀随机 $d$ 正则图的这一现象，并推导了其基于边的图编辑距离的相关结果。对于每个固定的 $d \ge 3$，我们证明了最大重叠为 $n+\Theta_{\mathbb{P}}(n/\log n)$，其中主导项 $n$ 来自哈密顿性，而剩余部分捕捉了超出它的最优阶。我们建立了关于该剩余部分的显式上下界。上限是通过计数最小度至少为二的公共核心获得的，而下限是通过使用由相同对数长度的圈组成的生成因子建立的。对于 $d=2$ 的特殊情况，我们证明最大重叠为 $n-(1+o_{\mathbb{P}}(1))\log n$。通过使用邻接论证，还研究了通过旋转对齐的哈密顿圈可实现的额外重叠。作为副产品，我们确定了独立随机完美匹配的并集在循环移位下的渐近最大重叠。
tldr: 本文研究并通过概率论方法量化了独立随机正则图在优化顶点对应下的最大边重叠度及其上下界。
ai_comments: 该论文在随机图论和图匹配领域具有重要的理论意义，通过严密的概率论证揭示了独立随机正则图在顶点对应优化下的边重叠极限，方法精妙且结果完整。
motivation: 优化顶点对应能够大幅增加两个独立同分布随机正则图所共享的边数，该研究旨在量化这一现象，并推导其基于边的图编辑距离的相关结果。
method: 通过计数具有至少为二的最小度数的公共核心来推导上限，并使用由相同对数长度的圈组成的生成因子来建立下限；对于 $d=2$ 的情况使用邻接论证（contiguity argument）和循环移位进行分析。
results: 对于 $d \ge 3$，最大重叠为 $n+\Theta_{\mathbb{P}}(n/\log n)$，其中主导项 $n$ 源于哈密顿性；对于 $d=2$，最大重叠为 $n-(1+o_{\mathbb{P}}(1))\log n$。此外，还确定了独立随机完美匹配并在循环移位下的渐近最大重叠。
conclusion: 对于固定的 $d \ge 3$，最大边重叠度为 $n+\Theta_{\mathbb{P}}(n/\log n)$，而对于 $d=2$ 的特殊情况，最大重叠度表现为 $n-(1+o_{\mathbb{P}}(1))\log n$，从而精确量化了图同构及图编辑距离中的相关界限。

title: Extending Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization to Systems of Linear Equations
authors: Taha Selim
abstract: Solving systems of linear equations, $Ax=b$, is a ubiquitous task in computational science. The Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd algorithm requires phase estimation, controlled rotations, and post-selection, impractical on noisy intermediate-scale quantum hardware. We extend sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), developed for quantum chemistry, to linear systems. Following the sample-based Krylov variant, the Hermitian matrix $A$ is decomposed in the Pauli basis, the Trotterized time evolution of $|b\rangle$ is sampled at several times to select computational-basis configurations, and the system is solved classically by a Galerkin projection onto the selected subspace. We prove that the subspace solution is exact when the sampled configurations contain the Krylov support of $b$ and optimal in the energy norm for symmetric positive-definite matrices, so that noise-induced configurations cannot degrade it as long as they do not displace the ideal ones. On IBM Quantum hardware, the sampled distribution of a $4\times4$ example deviates from the exact one by eleven times the shot-noise level, yet the solution is recovered exactly. For a localized problem of dimension $N=1024$, SQD selects 33 configurations, reaches a relative error of $10^{-5}$, and its truncated subspaces coincide with the optimal choice; readout errors enlarge the subspace without degrading the accuracy. The tests also show the limitations: the selected subspace coincides with that of inexpensive classical selection, banded matrices require exponentially many Pauli terms in the binary encoding, and Trotter errors populate spurious configurations unless the circuits are deep. An MIT-licensed Python package and notebooks that reproduce the numerical results are provided.
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Code: Python package sqd_linsolve (MIT License) with two notebooks in the ancillary files: reproduce_paper.ipynb reproduces the numerical results of the paper; sqd_linear_systems_selfcontained.ipynb gives a self-contained, step-by-step implementation with explanations and a worked example
zh_title: 将基于样本的量子对角化扩展到线性方程组
translation: 求解线性方程组 $Ax=b$ 是计算科学中的一个普遍任务。Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd 算法需要相位估计、受控旋转和后选择，这在含噪声的中等规模量子硬件上是不切实际的。我们将为量子化学开发的基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）扩展到线性系统。遵循基于样本的 Krylov 变体，将厄米矩阵 $A$ 分解在泡利基中，对 $|bangle$ 的 Trotter 化时间演化在多个时间点进行采样，以选择计算基配置，并通过 Galerkin 投影到选定的子空间在经典计算机上求解。我们证明，当采样配置包含 $b$ 的 Krylov 支撑时，子空间解是精确的，并且对于对称正定矩阵来说，在能量范数上是最优的，因此只要噪声引起的配置不取代理想配置，就不会降低其性能。在 IBM Quantum 硬件上，一个 4x4 示例的采样分布与精确分布的偏差为散粒噪声水平的 11 倍，但仍能精确恢复解。对于维度为 N=1024 的局部问题，SQD 选择 33 个配置，达到 10^-5 的相对误差，并且其截断子空间与最优选择一致；读出误差会扩大子空间而不会降低精度。测试也显示了其局限性：所选子空间与廉价的经典选择的子空间一致，带状矩阵在二进制编码中需要指数级的泡利项，并且除非电路很深，否则 Trotter 误差会产生虚假的配置。我们提供了一个 MIT 许可的 Python 包和笔记本，可重现数值结果。
tldr: 该研究将样本型量子对角化（SQD）方法从量子化学领域扩展到求解线性方程组。通过在泡利基下分解矩阵 A，对 |b⟩ 的 Trotter 化时间演化进行采样以选择计算基配置，然后通过 Galerkin 投影在经典计算机上求解。研究证明，当采样配置包含 Krylov 支撑时，子空间解是精确的，并且对于对称正定矩阵是能量范数最优的。实验结果表明，即使在存在噪声的情况下，该方法也能精确恢复解。该方法在处理大规模问题时表现出良好的精度，并且对噪声具有鲁棒性。然而，该方法也存在一些局限性，例如对于带状矩阵需要指数级的泡利项，以及 Trotter 误差可能导致虚假配置的出现。
ai_comments: 该研究将样本型量子对角化（SQD）方法成功应用于求解线性方程组，并证明了其在含噪声中等规模量子硬件上的潜力。其优点在于能够精确恢复解，并且在处理大规模问题时表现出良好的精度和对噪声的鲁棒性。然而，对于带状矩阵和 Trotter 误差的处理仍需进一步研究。提供的 MIT 许可的 Python 包和笔记本方便了结果的复现和进一步研究。
motivation: 传统的 Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd 算法在现实的量子硬件上难以实现。因此，需要一种适用于含噪声中规模量子硬件的求解线性方程组的新方法。
method: 将样本型量子对角化（SQD）方法扩展到线性方程组。具体步骤包括：1. 将厄米矩阵 A 分解为泡利基。2. 对 |b⟩ 的 Trotter 化时间演化进行采样，以选择计算基配置。3. 在经典计算机上通过 Galerkin 投影到选定的子空间来求解方程组。
results: 在 IBM Quantum 硬件上，一个 4x4 示例的采样分布与精确分布的偏差为 11 倍的散粒噪声水平，但仍能精确恢复解。对于 N=1024 的局部问题，SQD 选择 33 个配置，达到 10^-5 的相对误差，并且其截断子空间与最优选择一致；读出误差会扩大子空间但不会降低精度。
conclusion: 样本型量子对角化（SQD）是一种有前景的求解线性方程组的方法，尤其适用于含噪声的中等规模量子硬件。该方法在精度和噪声鲁棒性方面表现出色，但仍存在一些局限性，例如对带状矩阵和 Trotter 误差的处理。

title: Overcoming the Representational Limitations of Amplitude Encoding for Quantum Neural Networks
authors: Vincent Gurgul, David Prinz
abstract: Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) offer a framework for learning functions from classical data, but their expressive power depends critically on how inputs are encoded into quantum states. Angle encoding can require resources that scale with the number of features, whereas amplitude encoding represents $d$ features using only $\mathcal{O}(\log_2 d)$ qubits. This compactness comes at a representational cost: normalization makes conventional amplitude encoding invariant to nonzero real rescaling of the input, up to an unobservable global phase. We show that this invariance induces an exact, architecture-independent restriction on the resulting hypothesis class. No downstream quantum circuit can distinguish inputs differing by nonzero real scaling. We develop a general condition under which deterministic preprocessing can remove this ambiguity and show that nonlinearity alone is insufficient. Based on this analysis, we introduce a fixed nonlinear feature map that provably distinguishes all real inputs under subsequent amplitude encoding, without adding trainable parameters and while retaining logarithmic qubit scaling. We evaluate the resulting QNN on three canonical classification benchmarks and a nonlinear synthetic dataset against conventional amplitude and angle encoding, as well as a classical neural network. Across these tasks, the proposed encoding consistently improves classification accuracy over both quantum encoding baselines by 21$-$44 %. Our results establish normalization-induced scale invariance as a concrete representational bottleneck of amplitude encoding and demonstrate that it can be removed while preserving a compact quantum representation, marking a step toward quantum models capable of capturing arbitrary relationships in classical data.
zh_title: 克服量子神经网络中幅度编码的表示限制
translation: 量子神经网络（QNN）提供了一个从经典数据学习函数的框架，但它们的表达能力关键取决于如何将输入编码到量子态。角度编码可能需要与特征数量成比例的资源，而幅度编码仅使用 $\mathcal{O}(\log_2 d)$ 量子比特来表示 $d$ 个特征。这种紧凑性是以表示成本为代价的：归一化使得传统幅度编码在不可观测的全局相位之外，对于输入的非零实数重缩放是不变的。我们证明了这种不变性会诱导一个精确的、与架构无关的假设类别限制。没有下游量子电路可以区分相差非零实数缩放的输入。我们开发了一个通用条件，在该条件下，确定性预处理可以消除这种歧义，并表明仅靠非线性是不够的。基于此分析，我们引入了一个固定的非线性特征映射，该映射可以在后续幅度编码下可证明地区分所有实数输入，而无需添加可训练参数，同时保持对数量子比特缩放。我们将由此产生的 QNN 在三个典型分类基准和一个非线性合成数据集上与常规幅度编码和角度编码以及经典神经网络进行了评估。在这些任务中，所提出的编码在量子编码基线上的分类准确性始终提高了 21%–44%。我们的结果将归一化引起的不变性确定为幅度编码的一个具体表示瓶颈，并证明它可以被消除，同时保留紧凑的量子表示，这标志着朝着能够捕获经典数据中任意关系的量子模型迈出了重要一步。
tldr: 幅度编码在表示能力和资源效率之间存在权衡。虽然它使用对数数量的量子比特来表示大量特征，但其归一化会引入对输入进行非零实数缩放的不变性，从而限制了其表示能力。该研究提出了一种固定的非线性特征映射，可以在不增加可训练参数或量子比特数量的情况下消除这种不变性，从而提高了量子神经网络在各种基准测试中的分类准确性。
ai_comments: 这项研究解决了量子神经网络（QNN）中一种重要的编码方案（幅度编码）的一个关键表示限制。通过识别并消除由归一化引起的不变性，研究人员能够提高 QNN 的表达能力和分类性能。该方法具有新颖性，因为它引入了一个固定的、无需训练的特征映射，同时保持了幅度编码的对数量子比特缩放优势。然而，该研究的局限性可能在于其评估仅限于特定的分类任务，未来需要探索其在更广泛的 QNN 应用和更复杂的数据集上的有效性。总的来说，这项工作为实现更强大、更通用的量子机器学习模型做出了重要贡献。
motivation: 传统的幅度编码方法在表示能力和资源效率之间存在权衡。虽然它使用对数数量的量子比特来表示大量特征，但其归一化会引入对输入进行非零实数缩放的不变性，从而限制了其表示能力。本研究的动机是克服这一表示限制，以提高量子神经网络处理任意数据的能力。
method: 研究人员提出了一种固定的非线性特征映射，该映射在后续的幅度编码之前应用，以消除由归一化引起的不变性。该特征映射旨在区分所有实数输入，同时保持对数量子比特缩放，并且不引入可训练参数。然后，将此新颖的编码方案与传统的幅度编码、角度编码以及经典神经网络在各种分类基准测试和非线性合成数据集上进行比较。
results: 与传统的幅度编码和角度编码相比，所提出的固定非线性特征映射在三个分类基准和非线性合成数据集上，将量子神经网络的分类准确性提高了 21%–44%。
conclusion: 该研究成功地识别并解决了幅度编码在表示能力方面的一个具体瓶颈（由归一化引起的不变性），并通过引入一种新的固定非线性特征映射来消除它。这种方法在保持紧凑的量子表示的同时，提高了量子神经网络处理任意数据关系的能力，是朝着更强大的量子模型迈出的重要一步。

title: Leveraging Quantum Measurement Randomness for Shot-Efficient Diffusion Models
authors: Tianhao Guo, Dianxin Zheng, Yuhua Qian, Yaohui Zheng, Yuzhi Yang, Merouane Debbah, Chau Yuen
abstract: In quantum computing, the readout always carries finite-shot sampling noise. Suppressing this noise through repeated measurements raises the cost of a quantum neural network (QNN). Meanwhile, a stochastic diffusion sampler deliberately adds randomness at each reverse (generation) step. This paper turns the measurement noise from a liability into a resource. Specifically, we use the noise quantum measurement produces anyway to replace part of the noise the sampler would otherwise inject. We characterize the measurement error as multinomial sampling noise propagated through a trainable linear readout. To connect the circuit's Born probabilities to the denoising task, we further formulate the diffusion process on a bounded zero-sum hyperplane mapped to the probability simplex. Therefore, we can employ a compensation noise to match the mean and covariance of the shot-noise-free linear update under some minimum shot conditions. Solving this condition for the shot count gives a state-dependent adaptive budget. For the denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM), this budget increases as the sampler becomes more deterministic. On an eight-dimensional Gaussian mixture, the schedule achieves comparable generation quality with $303$ shots per sample against a high-shot reference of $1.6\times10^{6}$, about $5300\times$ fewer. Latent diffusion experiments on MNIST further validate the proposed mechanism for generation in a learned latent space.
zh_title: 利用量子测量随机性实现射击高效扩散模型
translation: 在量子计算中，读出总是带有有限次的采样噪声。通过重复测量来抑制这种噪声会增加量子神经网络（QNN）的成本。同时，随机扩散采样器在每个逆向（生成）步骤中刻意添加随机性。本文将测量噪声从一种负担转化为一种资源。具体来说，我们利用量子测量无论如何都会产生的噪声来替代采样器原本会注入的部分噪声。我们将测量误差表征为通过可训练线性读出传播的多项式采样噪声。为了将电路的玻恩概率与去噪任务联系起来，我们进一步将扩散过程公式化为映射到概率单纯形的有界零和超平面上。因此，我们可以在一些最小测量条件下，采用补偿噪声来匹配无散粒噪声线性更新的均值和协方差。求解此条件以获得测量次数的状态依赖自适应预算。对于去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM），当采样器变得更加确定时，这个预算会增加。在八维高斯混合模型上，该调度实现了与1.6x10^6次高测量参考相当的生成质量，但每个样本仅需303次测量，减少了约5300倍。在MNIST上的潜在扩散实验进一步验证了所提出的机制在学习到的潜在空间中进行生成的可行性。
tldr: 该研究利用量子测量噪声替代扩散模型中的部分随机性，显著减少了生成高质量样本所需的测量次数。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于其将通常被视为负面因素的量子测量噪声巧妙地转化为扩散模型中的有用资源，从而解决了量子神经网络高成本的问题。这种“变废为宝”的思路极具启发性。其提出的自适应测量预算机制，能够根据采样器的确定性动态调整测量次数，展现了高效性。实验结果中高达5300倍的测量次数减少，证明了该方法的巨大潜力，对于推动量子机器学习的实际应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 量子计算中的读出操作存在有限次采样的噪声，通过重复测量来抑制噪声会增加量子神经网络的成本。同时，随机扩散采样器在每个反向生成步骤中刻意添加随机性。
method: 将测量误差表征为通过可训练线性读出传播的多项式采样噪声。将扩散过程公式化为映射到概率单纯形的有界零和超平面上，以连接电路的Born概率与去噪任务。采用补偿噪声来匹配最小测量条件下的无散粒噪声线性更新的均值和协方差，并求解此条件以获得状态依赖的自适应预算。
results: 在八维高斯混合模型上，该调度实现了与1.6x10^6次高测量参考相当的生成质量，但每个样本仅需303次测量，减少了约5300倍。在MNIST上的潜在扩散实验进一步验证了该机制在学习到的潜在空间中进行生成的可行性。
conclusion: 本文成功地将量子测量噪声从负债转化为资源，显著提高了扩散模型的测量效率，为量子神经网络的实际应用提供了新的途径。

title: Numerical evaluation of one-loop integrals using quadrature rules
authors: Jürgen Dölz, Claude Duhr, Bartul Kovačić, Cathrin Semper
abstract: We introduce a numerical quadrature algorithm with stretched exponential convergence to evaluate one-loop integrals in dimensional regularisation in the causal Loop Tree Dual (cLTD) representation. The key feature that makes this possible is the fact that for Euclidean kinematics all singularities of the cLTD integrand lie on a compact set in loop momentum space. We prove that our algorithm admits a stretched exponential convergence with the number of integrand evaluations, and we illustrate it by evaluating triangle, box and pentagon integrals at selected Euclidean kinematics points. We benchmark our implementation against analytic results as well as results obtained via Monte Carlo integration. We also provide a proof of concept that our algorithm can be extended to physical kinematics after subtraction of threshold singularities.

title: On approximate support versions of Donoho--Stark uncertainty principles for $k$-Hadamard operators
authors: Rami Ayoush
abstract: In this paper we present results related to Donoho--Stark type uncertainty principles that were proved in the article "The uncertainty principle: variations on a theme" by Wigderson and Wigderson for $k$-Hadamard operators in the finite-dimensional setting. Namely, the authors showed that Donoho-Stark principles can be generalized to versions for approximate supports with respect to norms $\ell^{p}$ for $p=1$ and $p=2$. In the second case they assumed the so-called speciality condition, namely that a suitable matrix satisfies $A^{*}A = kI$. First we show that such theorems cannot be generalized to $p>1$ if matrices are not special $k$-Hadamard. Next we prove Donoho-Stark type principle for special $k$-Hadamard operators for $\ell^{p}$ norms within the range $1\leq p\leq 2$. Finally, we show that such theorems are false for $p>2$ even in the presence of the speciality condition.

title: General-purpose foundation models surpass specialized ones on chemical property prediction tasks
authors: Stepan N. Ostarkov, Gregorii A. Semakin, Ivan A. Bespalov, Michael G. Medvedev
abstract: Foundation models (FMs) learn reusable representations from large collections of unlabeled data. In chemistry the corresponding data mainly consists of molecular structures, which are abundant, whereas experimental measurements are scarce. Chemical FMs such as ChemBERTa and MoLFormer were therefore trained on diverse molecular structures to enable fine-tuning on small experimental datasets (less than 100 datapoints in most realistic scenarios) and subsequent property prediction. At the same time, general-purpose FMs such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 were trained on virtually all publicly available data, including knowledge of the humankind on molecular properties and laws governing them. Here we compare accuracies of chemical and general-purpose FMs on tasks from various areas of chemistry. Strikingly, general-purpose GPT-6 Astra outperforms the currently eligible chemical FMs on five physicochemical and quantum-chemical regression tasks when only 60 experimental datapoints are available. Only when provided 10x datapoints do the best chemical FMs reach performance of GPT-6 Astra: on 1,000 and 10,000 points they show performance on par with Astra on 60 and 1,000 points, respectively. Thus, counterintuitively, frontier general-purpose FMs are better suited for guiding chemical research in data-scarce areas than specialized chemical FMs, suggesting that learning relevant primitives (e.g. chemical structures) does not substitute training on relevant humankind knowledge.

title: Statistical Foundations of Reinforcement Learning: A Non-Asymptotic Perspective
authors: Yuxin Chen, Yuejie Chi, Jianqing Fan, Gen Li, Yuting Wei, Yuling Yan
abstract:
Reinforcement learning (RL) embodies a foundational paradigm for sequential decision-making in the face of uncertainty. The rapid growth of model complexity in emerging applications has significantly amplified the challenges of achieving data-efficient RL, particularly in sample-starved scenarios where data collection may be costly, time-consuming, or even high-stakes. Consequently, understanding and improving the data efficiency of RL algorithms has become a central problem of both fundamental theoretical interest and practical importance.
  Despite decades of research, the statistical underpinnings of RL remained remarkably underdeveloped until relatively recently, particularly in the finite-sample regimes most relevant to modern practice. Over the past few years, there has been a surge of activity advancing the frontiers of non-asymptotic statistical RL theory, drawing on ideas from high-dimensional statistics and probability, information theory, and statistical learning theory. In this monograph, we present a non-asymptotic treatment for RL based on tabular Markov decision processes, focusing on three canonical sampling mechanisms --- RL with a generative model, online RL, and offline RL --- together with two algorithmic paradigms: model-based and model-free approaches. Centered around non-asymptotic sample complexity analysis, our treatment emphasizes minimax-optimal algorithm design, particularly methods that attain statistical optimality without significant burn-in costs, as well as sharp statistical characterizations of several widely used RL algorithms. Whenever possible, we provide largely self-contained analyses together with intuitive explanations. We also briefly discuss several extensions, such as robust RL, competitive multi-agent RL, federated RL, uncertainty quantification, and RL from human feedback.

title: Revisiting the directed pathwidth of h-semicomplete digraphs
authors: Guilherme C. M. Gomes, Raul Lopes, Matthias Mnich
abstract: A digraph is $h$-semicomplete if every vertex has at most $h$ non-neighbors. In semicomplete digraphs, $k$-triples are obstructions to bounded directed pathwidth with many algorithmic applications: Fradkin and Seymour [JCTB 2013] showed that a large triple contains a subdivision of every small digraph, and triples were used for irrelevant vertex arguments in routing problems by Fomin and Pilipczuk [JCTB 2019] and Gomes, Lopes, and Sau [ICALP 2025]. Fradkin and Seymour also showed that there is a function $f(k)$ such that every semicomplete digraph of directed pathwidth at least $f(k)$ contains a $k$-triple, and their proof gives $f(k)$ triply exponential in $k$. For $h$-semicomplete digraphs, a result of Kitsunai et al. [ESA 2015] also yields a $k$-triple, but only existentially, and finding one in fixed-parameter time remained open. We improve the bound on $f(k)$ to a single exponential and extend the result to $h$-semicomplete digraphs: we show that every $h$-semicomplete digraph of directed pathwidth greater than $(h+1) \cdot k \cdot 2^{27k+9}$ contains a $k$-triple, which we find in polynomial time, and no bound subexponential in $k$ or sublinear in $h$ is possible. We also extend the approximation algorithm for directed pathwidth of Fomin and Pilipczuk to $h$-semicomplete digraphs, so its certificates of large directed pathwidth remain valid. Our proof is much shorter than the analysis of Kitsunai et al., and while their algorithm is exact, ours runs in polynomial time. As an application, we show that Arc-Disjoint Paths on $h$-semicomplete digraphs is fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the number of paths and $h$, generalizing the semicomplete case. Finally, unlike in semicomplete digraphs, directed pathwidth does not bound directed cliquewidth: for every $k$, some acyclic $1$-semicomplete digraph, so of directed pathwidth zero, has directed cliquewidth at least $k$.

title: IGDA-ICMH: an Importance Guided Feature and Network Dual Adaptation Framework towards Image Compression for Machine and Human Vision
authors: Yanbo Gao, Xinyu Zhao, Shuai Li, Xun Cai, Mao Ye, Li Li
abstract: With the surge of machine vision applications, image compression for both machine and human vision (ICMH) has become an important research area. Existing studies mainly focus on task-specific adaptation or multi-task joint optimization, yet they often overlook the unequal contributions of different features and network layers to downstream machine vision tasks. To address this issue, we first quantitatively investigate the impact of different feature and network layers on machine vision performance, providing a principled understanding of their importance. Based on this analysis, an Importance Guided feature and network Dual Adaptation (IGDA) framework is developed for ICMH. It adopts implicit neural representation as the basic architecture and designs an efficient adaptation structure with both feature and network weight adaptation. An Importance-Guided Network Adaptation (IGNA) module is developed with a low-rank adaptation strategy to selectively adjust key network layers according to their importance in different tasks. An Importance-Guided Feature Adaptation (IGFA) module is developed with a low-rank and Kronecker product-based transform to explore the non-local property of the features in order to reduce the number of adaptation parameters. Extensive experiments on representative machine vision tasks, including image classification and object detection, demonstrate that our IGDA-ICMH framework achieves significantly better performance than the existing implicit neural representation-based methods for ICMH.

title: Variance Reduction for Decentralized Stochastic Optimization with Multiple Local Updates
authors: Jie Liu, Nicola Bastianello, Wenying Xu, Daniel W. C. Ho
abstract: Multiple local updates are widely used in decentralized optimization to enhance communication efficiency, often in conjunction with stochastic gradients when exact gradient computation is costly. However, such algorithms generally converge only to a neighborhood of the optimum, whose size depends on the stepsize and the variance of gradient noise. Variance reduction has been incorporated into ADMM-based methods to achieve exact convergence in expectation, but their stepsizes typically scale inversely with both the square root of the network size and the cube of the number of local updates, leading to slow convergence as the network size or the number of local updates increases. In this paper, we propose a novel primal-dual-based decentralized optimization algorithm that integrates variance reduction with multiple local updates, with a stepsize independent of the network size and inversely proportional to the number of local updates (rather than its cube), thereby enabling significantly larger stepsizes and faster convergence. Moreover, to the best of our knowledge, we establish the first linear convergence guarantee in expectation for decentralized optimization with multiple local updates under stochastic gradients in the strongly convex setting. Beyond the theoretical guarantee, the proposed method exchanges only one variable per round, halving the communication cost compared with gradient-tracking-based methods. Numerical experiments further demonstrate its advantages in convergence speed and accuracy.

title: Shock Loading Accesses Reaction Pathways beyond Accelerated Thermolysis
authors: Mingjie Wen, Jiahe Han, Zihan Zhou, Hao Wang, Xueyong Guo, Qingzhao Chu, Dongping Chen
abstract: Thermolysis and shock loading can produce similar major stable products in energetic materials, despite different chemical evolution and reaction pathways. Here, we develop EMFF-MACE, a reactive machine-learning potential for C/H/N/O energetic materials, enabling thermolysis simulations of 20 materials and shock simulations of 10 on a common potential energy surface. Comparisons at matched normalized reaction progress reveal divergent chemical states and local structural environments. Mean reaction-state similarity decreases from 94.0% at 20% progress to 25.9% at trajectory endpoints, while 47.1-92.6% of shock local environments lie outside corresponding material-specific thermolysis reference domains. Structural and reaction-network analyses reveal enhanced intermolecular reorganization and additional association and rearrangement branches under shock loading, despite partially shared early decomposition chemistry. These findings show that loading history influences the structural states and subsequent reaction pathways accessed during decomposition, rather than merely the rate of thermolysis.

title: Stochastic processes on reductive homogeneous and symmetric spaces
authors: Sonja Cox, Erwin Luesink
abstract: In this paper we present a method to effectively and efficiently provide pathwise approximations of the Riemannian Brownian motion on a reductive homogeneous space $M\cong G/H$ endowed with a $G$-invariant metric. This setting includes spheres, hyperbolic spaces, the space of symmetric positive-definite matrices, flag manifolds and Stiefel manifolds. The simulation is based on Wong--Zakai approximations of an appropriately chosen SDE in $G$ that is projected down onto $M\cong G/H$. The effectiveness lies in the fact that well-established results on the convergence rate of the Wong--Zakai equation immediately carry over to the homogeneous space thanks to Nash's embedding. The efficiency lies in the fact that explicit representations of the Wong--Zakai approximations can be obtained in this setting using the Lie exponential map.
comment: 55 pages, 10 figures. First version, all comments are welcome!
zh_title: 约化齐性空间与对称空间上的随机过程
translation: 在本文中，我们提出了一种有效且高效的方法，用于提供赋予$G$不变度量的约化齐性空间$M\cong G/H$上黎曼布朗运动的路径逼近。此框架包括球面、双曲空间、对称正定矩阵空间、旗流形和Stiefel流形。该模拟基于对$G$中适当选择的随机微分方程（SDE）的Wong--Zakai逼近，并将其投影到$M\cong G/H$上。其有效性在于，借助Nash嵌入，关于Wong--Zakai方程收敛率的成熟结果可以直接推广到齐性空间；其高效性则在于，在此设定下利用李指数映射可以获得Wong--Zakai逼近的显式表示。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在约化齐性空间和对称空间上高效模拟黎曼布朗运动的新方法，利用李群上的Wong-Zakai逼近和指数映射实现路径逼近。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种在约化齐性空间和对称空间上进行黎曼布朗运动路径逼近的有效方法，利用李群上的随机微分方程投影以及Wong-Zakai逼近，具有良好的理论收敛性和计算效率。
motivation: 为了有效且高效地在约化齐性空间和对称空间（如球面、双曲空间、正定矩阵空间等）上实现黎曼布朗运动的路径逼近。
method: 基于在基础李群$G$上精心选择的随机微分方程（SDE），利用Wong-Zakai逼近并通过投影将其映射到齐性空间$M\cong G/H$上；结合Nash嵌入证明收敛率，并利用李指数映射获取显式表达。
results: 建立了一种既有效（具备明确的收敛率）又高效（通过李指数映射获得显式表示）的黎曼布朗运动模拟方法，适用于多种重要的几何空间。
conclusion: 通过在李群上构造随机微分方程并利用Nash嵌入和李指数映射，成功实现了约化齐性空间和对称空间上黎曼布朗运动的高效路径逼近。

title: WASABI: Wasserstein Sampling via Bridge Interpolants
authors: Sebastian Salazar, Dilum Fernando, Michal Kucer, Emily Casleton, Luhuan Wu, David M. Blei
abstract: Sampling from Boltzmann distributions is a fundamental problem in physics, chemistry, and biology. We introduce WAsserstein SAmpling via Bridge Interpolants (WASABI), a method that trains a diffusion model to generate samples from a target Boltzmann distribution given access only to the energy function. WASABI minimizes the KL divergence between the distribution generated by its diffusion model and the Boltzmann target using Wasserstein gradient flows. This approach builds on a principle underlying classical sampling methods such as Langevin dynamics. However, applying Wasserstein gradient flows to diffusion models is challenging because the updates require the gradient of the model's own log density, which is generally intractable. We derive a practical training algorithm that avoids computing this gradient. Once trained, WASABI can generate new samples without further evaluations of the energy or its gradient. On alanine dipeptide, WASABI outperforms the best reported baselines using an estimated 3.3 times fewer energy evaluations. It also achieves competitive performance on interacting particle system benchmarks.
translation: 从玻尔兹曼分布中采样是物理、化学和生物学领域的一个基本问题。我们提出了WASABI（基于桥插值的Wasserstein采样），该方法在仅能访问能量函数的情况下，训练扩散模型以从目标玻尔兹曼分布中生成样本。WASABI利用Wasserstein梯度流最小化其扩散模型生成的分布与玻尔兹曼目标分布之间的KL散度。该方法建立在诸如朗之万动力学等经典采样方法的底层原理之上。然而，将Wasserstein梯度流应用于扩散模型极具挑战性，因为其更新需要计算模型自身的对数密度梯度，而这通常是难以处理的。我们推导出了一种实用的训练算法，避免了计算这一梯度。一旦训练完成，WASABI无需对能量或其梯度进行进一步评估即可生成新样本。在丙氨酸二肽系统上，WASABI的性能超越了目前已报道的最佳基线，同时能量评估次数减少了约3.3倍。它在相互作用粒子系统基准测试中也取得了极具竞争力的性能。
tldr: WASABI提出了一种通过避开模型对数密度梯度计算、利用Wasserstein梯度流训练扩散模型采样玻尔兹曼分布的方法，显著减少了能量评估次数并提高了性能。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于成功将经典采样方法背后的Wasserstein梯度流框架拓展至扩散模型训练中，并推导出一种切实可行的算法，巧妙地绕过了模型自身难解的对数密度梯度的计算。这显著降低了分子模拟等物理场景下昂贵的能量函数评估成本，展现出较好的理论深度和实用价值。
motivation: 从玻尔兹曼分布中采样在物理、化学和生物学中至关重要。将经典的Wasserstein梯度流（如朗之万动力学背后的原理）应用于扩散模型训练时，更新需要求解模型自身的对数密度梯度，这在通常情况下是难以计算的。
method: 提出了WASABI方法，仅需访问能量函数即可训练扩散模型。该方法基于Wasserstein梯度流最小化生成分布与目标分布之间的KL散度，并推导出一种实用的训练算法，避免了直接计算模型自身难解的对数密度梯度；训练完成后无需再评估能量或其梯度即可快速采样。
results: 在丙氨酸二肽（alanine dipeptide）测试中，WASABI超越了已报告的最佳基线模型，且能量评估次数减少了约3.3倍；在相互作用粒子系统基准测试中也取得了具有竞争力的表现。
conclusion: WASABI提供了一种高效且实用的扩散模型训练范式，仅需能量函数即可高质量拟合玻尔兹曼分布，在显著降低能量评估计算开销的同时达到了领先的采样表现。

title: Extremal character spectra of finite projective systems
authors: Shitao Li, Yang Li, Gaojun Luo
abstract: Let $\mathcal M$ be a finite spanning multiset of points in ${\rm PG}(k-1,q)$, and let ${\rm Char}_{\mathcal M}$ be its character function. For $1\le r\le k$, we study the maximum number of distinct values attained by ${\rm Char}_{\mathcal M}$ on the codimension-$r$ flats under a total-multiplicity budget. The spectrum is subject to two natural upper bounds, whose extremal cases lead respectively to $r$-maximum character spectrum ($r$-MCS) and $r$-full character spectrum ($r$-FCS) systems. We establish the existence of $r$-FCS systems in a broad parameter range, and solve the size-constrained extremal problem completely when $r=k-1$, including the minimum-cost multiplicity profiles. For $1\le r<k$, put $M_r=\qbinom{k}{r}$ and $B_r=\qbinom{k-1}{r}$. The minimum size $ν_r(k,q)$ of an $r$-MCS system satisfies \[\left\lceil\frac{\binom{M_r}{2}}{B_r}\right\rceil\le ν_r(k,q)\le \binom{M_r-1}{2}+\frac{q^k-q^{k-r}}{q-1}.\] The upper bound is at most $\binom{M_r}{2}$, strictly less when $r\le k-2$, and exact when $r=k-1$. Its proof applies positive additive labelings to the complement of one flat, whose trace is empty while all remaining traces are distinct. For $r=1$, we improve the known upper bounds on the minimum length of such systems. We also develop global moment identities and local flat-incidence bounds that impose strong structural constraints on large character spectra. Under the projective-system correspondence, complementary character spectra are the support-weight spectra of $r$-dimensional subcodes.
zh_title: 有限射影系统中的极值特征谱
translation: 设$\mathcal M$是${\rm PG}(k-1,q)$中点的有限生成多重集，设${\rm Char}_{\mathcal M}$为其特征函数。对于$1\le r\le k$，我们研究在总重数预算下，${\rm Char}_{\mathcal M}$在余维$r$平面上所能达到的不同值的最大数量。该谱受两个自然上界的限制，其极值情况分别导致$r$-最大特征谱（$r$-MCS）和$r$-全特征谱（$r$-FCS）系统。我们在广泛的参数范围内建立了$r$-FCS系统的存在性，并在$r=k-1$时完全解决了尺寸受限的极值问题，包括最小成本重数分布。对于$1\le r<k$，令$M_r=\qbinom{k}{r}$和$B_r=\qbinom{k-1}{r}$。$r$-MCS系统的最小尺寸$\nu_r(k,q)$满足\[\left\lceil\frac{\binom{M_r}{2}}{B_r}\right\rceil\le \nu_r(k,q)\le \binom{M_r-1}{2}+\frac{q^k-q^{k-r}}{q-1}.\]上界至多为$\binom{M_r}{2}$，当$r\le k-2$时严格小于，当$r=k-1$时精确。其证明将正加性标记应用于一个平面的补集，其迹为空而所有剩余迹都不同。对于$r=1$，我们改进了此类系统最小长度的已知上界。我们还发展了全局矩恒等式和局部平面关联界限，对大特征谱施加了强大的结构约束。在射影系统对应关系下，互补特征谱是$r$维子码的支持权重谱。
tldr: 本文研究了有限射影系统中字符函数在余维平面上的极值特征谱，建立了r-FCS系统的存在性，解决了r=k-1时的极值问题，并给出了r-MCS系统的尺寸界限，还发现了与编码理论的联系。
ai_comments: 这篇论文深入探讨了有限射影系统中的字符谱，通过引入r-MCS和r-FCS系统，系统地分析了其极值行为。研究不仅解决了特定情况下的极值问题，还提供了重要的尺寸界限和改进了现有结果。此外，与编码理论中子码支持权重谱的联系揭示了其在应用上的潜在重要性，为进一步研究提供了桥梁。所采用的方法结合了组合学、代数和几何思想，具有较高的理论价值。
motivation: 旨在研究在总重数预算下，有限射影系统中字符函数在余维r平面上所能达到的不同值的最大数量，以理解其极值行为。
method: 1. 建立了在广泛参数范围内r-FCS系统的存在性。2. 完全解决了r=k-1时的尺寸受限极值问题，包括最小成本重数分布。3. 将正加性标记应用于一个平面的补集，其迹为空而所有剩余迹都不同。4. 发展了全局矩恒等式和局部平面关联界限。
results: 1. 在广泛参数范围内建立了r-FCS系统的存在性。2. 完全解决了r=k-1时的尺寸受限极值问题，包括最小成本重数分布。3. 给出了r-MCS系统的最小尺寸$\nu_r(k,q)$的界限：$\left\lceil\frac{\binom{M_r}{2}}{B_r}\right\rceil\le \nu_r(k,q)\le \binom{M_r-1}{2}+\frac{q^k-q^{k-r}}{q-1}$。4. 上界至多为$\binom{M_r}{2}$，当$r\le k-2$时严格小于，当$r=k-1$时精确。5. 改进了r=1时此类系统最小长度的已知上界。6. 全局矩恒等式和局部平面关联界限对大特征谱施加了强大的结构约束。
conclusion: 在射影系统对应关系下，互补特征谱是r维子码的支持权重谱。

title: Near-Optimal Second-Order Convex Finite-Sum Optimization under Individual Smoothness
authors: Xinliang Zhang, Lesi Chen, Zonghan Li, Jingzhao Zhang
abstract: We study the stochastic second-order oracle complexity of solving smooth convex finite-sum optimization with $n$ components. Very recently, Tsedenov \& Kovalev (2026) showed that the minimax optimal complexity under averaged smoothness and convexity is $\tildeΘ(n + n^{6/7} ε^{-2/7})$ by establishing nearly matching upper and lower bounds. In this paper, we show that individual smoothness and convexity provably enable further acceleration, where the lower complexity bound is $Ω(n+ n^{5/7} ε^{-2/7})$ under this stronger assumption. Then, by establishing a novel second-order self-bounding inequality, we design a new Taylor-corrected lazy Newton method, which can lead to a better complexity of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n + n^{5/7} ε^{-2/7})$ by applying the optimal Monteiro-Svaiter acceleration, matching our lower bound up to only logarithmic factors.
zh_title: 近似最优的个体光滑性下二阶凸有限和优化
translation: 我们研究了具有 $n$ 个分量的光滑凸有限和优化的随机二阶预言机复杂度。最近，Tsedenov & Kovalev (2026) 通过建立几乎匹配的上下界，表明在平均光滑性和凸性下的最小最大最优复杂度为 $\tilde{\Theta}(n + n^{6/7} \varepsilon^{-2/7})$。在本文中，我们表明个体光滑性和凸性可以被证明实现进一步的加速，在此更强的假设下，复杂度下界为 $Ω(n+ n^{5/7} ε^{-2/7})$。然后，通过建立一个新的二阶自界定不等式，我们设计了一种新的泰勒校正惰性牛顿法，通过应用最优的Monteiro-Svaiter加速，可以实现 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n + n^{5/7} \varepsilon^{-2/7})$ 的更好复杂度，与我们的下界仅在对数因子内匹配。
tldr: 本文在个体光滑性假设下，通过提出一种新的泰勒校正惰性牛顿法，将二阶凸有限和优化的复杂度从先前的 $\tilde{\Theta}(n + n^{6/7} \varepsilon^{-2/7})$ 改进到 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n + n^{5/7} \varepsilon^{-2/7})$，达到与新推导出的下界匹配的近似最优结果。
ai_comments: 本文的主要创新在于证明了个体光滑性假设能够带来二阶凸有限和优化的进一步加速，并提出了一种新颖的泰勒校正惰性牛顿法来实际达到这一改进的复杂度。通过匹配新的下界，该方法在理论上具有重要意义，对优化算法的设计和分析提供了新的视角。
motivation: 之前的研究在平均光滑性下取得了最优复杂度，但本文旨在探索在更强的个体光滑性假设下，是否能实现进一步的加速，从而获得更好的复杂度界限。
method: 通过建立一种新颖的二阶自界定不等式，设计了一种新的泰勒校正惰性牛顿法，并应用了最优的Monteiro-Svaiter加速技术。
results: 在个体光滑性假设下，推导出了 $Ω(n+ n^{5/7} ε^{-2/7})$ 的更低复杂度下界；同时，提出的方法达到了 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n + n^{5/7} \varepsilon^{-2/7})$ 的复杂度，与下界在对数因子内匹配。
conclusion: 在个体光滑性条件下，通过提出的泰勒校正惰性牛顿法，实现了二阶凸有限和优化问题的近似最优复杂度，显著优于平均光滑性下的结果。

title: Exact Theory and Optimal Stepsizes for Stochastic Gradient Descent in Smooth Convex Minimization
authors: Benjamin Grimmer, Qining Shen
abstract: This work considers the design of stepsize schedules for stochastic gradient descent in smooth convex optimization. Throughout, we assume that gradient noise is conditionally zero-mean with bounded variance. Among problems with dimension $d\geq N+1$, we provide an exact worst-case analysis of the expected suboptimality of stochastic gradient descent's final iterate. Our analysis applies to any (potentially nonconstant) schedule of $N$ stepsizes in $[0,1.5]^N$. Here, exact means that we provide a matching objective function and noise distributions where our guarantee is attained. Whenever the variance bound is at least $Ω(1/\sqrt{N})$, our theory provides the minimax optimal stepsize schedule for stochastic gradient descent and proves its uniqueness. These optimal stepsizes monotonically decrease, ruling out any accelerations in expected final suboptimality from fixed fractal schedules observed in the deterministic case.
zh_title: 平滑凸最小化中随机梯度下降的精确理论和最优步长
translation:
这项工作考虑了平滑凸优化中随机梯度下降的步长调度设计。在整个过程中，我们假设梯度噪声是条件零均值且方差有界的。对于维度 $d 
geq N+1$ 的问题，我们提供了随机梯度下降最终迭代预期次优性的精确最坏情况分析。我们的分析适用于任何（可能非恒定的）在 $[0,1.5]^N$ 中的 $N$ 个步长调度。这里的“精确”意味着我们提供了匹配的目标函数和噪声分布，使得我们的保证得以实现。只要方差界限至少为 $Ω(1/
sqrt{N})$，我们的理论就提供了随机梯度下降的极小极大最优步长调度，并证明了其唯一性。这些最优步长单调递减，排除了在确定性情况下观察到的固定分形调度带来的预期最终次优性的任何加速。
tldr: 针对平滑凸优化中的随机梯度下降，本文提供了最终迭代预期次优性的精确最坏情况分析，并推导了在特定方差条件下唯一的极小极大最优步长调度，发现最优步长单调递减。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提供了随机梯度下降在平滑凸优化中最终迭代预期次优性的“精确”最坏情况分析，这意味着其理论保证是紧密的。此外，它推导出了在特定条件下唯一的极小极大最优步长调度，并发现这些最优步长是单调递减的，这对于理解SGD的收敛行为具有重要意义，尤其是在与确定性情况下的加速现象进行对比时。这项工作对设计高效且理论上最优的SGD步长策略提供了坚实的理论基础。
motivation: 论文旨在设计平滑凸优化中随机梯度下降（SGD）的步长调度方案。
method:
本文对维度 $d 
geq N+1$ 的问题，提供了随机梯度下降最终迭代预期次优性的精确最坏情况分析。分析适用于任何 $N$ 个步长在 $[0,1.5]^N$ 中的调度。通过提供匹配的目标函数和噪声分布来证明其精确性，并推导出极小极大最优步长调度。
results:
1. 提供了随机梯度下降最终迭代预期次优性的精确最坏情况分析，并证明了其精确性。 2. 当方差界限至少为 $Ω(1/
sqrt{N})$ 时，提出了随机梯度下降的极小极大最优步长调度，并证明了其唯一性。 3. 最优步长单调递减，排除了在确定性情况下观察到的固定分形调度带来的预期最终次优性的任何加速。
conclusion: 在平滑凸最小化中，随机梯度下降存在唯一的极小极大最优步长调度，这些步长单调递减，这意味着固定分形调度无法带来预期的加速效果。

title: Stochastic Rayleigh-Ritz Ascent: Global Linear Convergence under a Spectral Gap
authors: Jonas Bresch, Oleh Melnyk
abstract: We consider the adjoint-free random-plane iteration algorithm for finding the top eigenvector of a matrix proposed in (SIAM J. Matrix Anal. Appl. 47 (2026), 1349-1374). Unlike standard methods such as the power method or gradient descent, the above algorithm lacked linear convergence guarantees in the presence of a spectral gap. In this paper, we establish explicit spectral-gap-dependent global linear convergence rates in expectation, providing quantitative guarantees for the empirically observed convergence.

title: The Quartic Gap Between Quantum and Dequantized Algorithms for Linear Algebra Is Tight
authors: Shouvanik Chakrabarti, Dylan Herman, Junhyung Lyle Kim, Guneykan Ozgul
abstract: Quantum algorithms for linear algebra that access a matrix $A$ through quantum random access memory (QRAM) prepare quantum states proportional to the solutions of linear systems and related problems. Dequantized classical algorithms, when given sampling and query access to $A$, return sampling and query access to an approximate solution. Both kinds of algorithms use a number of queries that is polynomial in the normalized Frobenius norm $ρ=\|A\|_F/\|A\|$ and does not directly depend on the dimension. For linear systems at fixed condition number and accuracy, quantum algorithms use $\widetilde O(ρ)$ queries, whereas the best dequantized algorithms use $\widetilde O(ρ^4)$. We prove that this quartic gap is tight in the worst case, up to a logarithmic factor. For every constant $κ_0>1$, we construct dense linear systems with condition number at most $κ_0$ for which sampling from the solution within a sufficiently small constant total variation distance requires $Ω(ρ^4/\logρ)$ classical queries but only $Θ(ρ)$ quantum queries. The same separation holds, for errors below smaller thresholds, for positive-definite systems, least squares, ridge regression, matrix powers and square roots, imaginary-time and real-time Hamiltonian evolution, and sampling from the top principal component. Our results therefore show that many quantum algorithms for linear algebra, achieve a near-quartic speedup in the worst case, over classical algorithms with sampling and query access. All of these classical lower bounds follow from the same framework, which is based on a lower bound for sampling from distributions that depend on a fixed set of Fourier coefficients of an unknown Boolean function.

title: Empirical Evaluation of Quantum Kernel Methods for Classification: A Comparative Study with Classical Kernels
authors: Ronak Bhalgami
abstract: Quantum kernel methods are the most concrete near-term proposal for quantum machine learning on classical data, yet published benchmarks disagree on whether they outperform tuned classical kernels, and the disagreement cannot be resolved from the literature because the comparisons are not protocol-controlled. We argue that the obstacle is one of measurement, not theory: the usual setup fixes the quantum feature map's data scaling while grid-searching the classical kernel's hyperparameters, recomputes nothing per fold, and reports cost in simulator time. We therefore treat the comparison itself as the object of study and impose three controls. The bandwidth is tuned on the same grid budget as the classical $γ$, the kernel is recomputed inside every fold from fold-fitted preprocessing, and cost is counted in hardware circuit evaluations. On top of these we run a factorial design of 324 cells in which dimensionality, training size, class separability and data structure are explicit covariates, together with four standard datasets, a shots-versus-gate-noise ablation, and a cost sweep. The dominant effect we measure is not quantum: tuning the feature map's bandwidth is worth 0.120 accuracy on synthetic data and 0.339 on real data, exceeding every quantum-classical difference we observe. Tuned quantum kernels are then statistically indistinguishable from a tuned RBF on all four real datasets. The advantage on synthetic data is confined almost entirely to data generated by the feature map itself, and it shrinks with dimensionality (-0.0045 per qubit) while growing with sample size. Finite sampling costs an order of magnitude more accuracy than gate and readout noise, and a fidelity kernel needs $5\times10^{7}$ circuits at n = 10,000. Protocol variance is thus sufficient to explain the field's contradictory conclusions.
zh_title: 量子核方法在分类中的实证评估：与经典核方法的比较研究
translation: 量子核方法是基于经典数据的量子机器学习最具体的近期提案，然而已发布的基准测试在它们是否优于经过调优的经典核方法上存在分歧，并且由于比较缺乏协议控制，这些分歧无法从文献中解决。我们认为障碍在于测量而非理论：通常的设置是固定量子特征映射的数据缩放，同时对经典核方法的超参数进行网格搜索，不重新计算每个折叠，并报告模拟器时间成本。因此，我们将比较本身作为研究对象，并施加三项控制。带宽与经典γ在相同的网格预算下进行调优，核在每个折叠内从折叠拟合的预处理中重新计算，成本以硬件电路评估次数计算。在此基础上，我们运行了一个324个单元的因子设计，其中维度、训练大小、类别可分离性和数据结构是显式协变量，并使用了四个标准数据集，进行了shots-versus-gate-noise消融实验和成本扫描。我们测得的最主要效果不是量子效应：调整特征映射的带宽在合成数据上带来0.120的准确度提升，在真实数据上带来0.339的准确度提升，这超过了我们观察到的所有量子-经典差异。在所有四个真实数据集上，调优后的量子核方法与调优后的RBF核方法在统计上无法区分。在合成数据上的优势几乎完全局限于由特征映射本身生成的数据，并且随着维度增加而减小（每比特-0.0045），随着样本量增加而增大。有限采样导致的准确度损失比门和读出噪声高一个数量级，一个保真度核在n=10,000时需要5×10^7个电路。因此，协议差异足以解释该领域相互矛盾的结论。
tldr: 本研究发现，通过严格的协议控制，调整量子特征映射的带宽比量子-经典差异更重要，调整后的量子核方法在真实数据集上与调整后的RBF核方法无统计学差异。实验协议差异足以解释该领域相互矛盾的结论。
